text: At first, the game is actually quite fun. While it is fairly different from the adverts, it does feature a similar gameplay structure abliet with a base building aspect. The main issue is at first, the game is a perfect balance of leveling up and grind, the one builder is a little slow but it's nothing major. However you then hit a very sudden and steep grind. Heroe level ups become a huge wall, the levels too, costs skyrocket and, it begins to push a P2W agenda in otherwise a great game.

This is a quite easy to play and addictive game. A lot of people say it's pay to win, but what isnt these days. Like me, you can play casually for free and find some fun within it. There definitely is a pay to win structure but only if you're a serious player and competitive. You can only be levelled by stronger, or pay to win folks once a week, but can counter that by a protective bubble which renders you unable to be attacked. The community of players is great. Easy, slow grind is there.

A very slow paced game where spending money is the only way to progress at a normal pace. After a short while the missions around the outside of my base were shrouded in a mist & were inaccessible which is still the case today. The ads say it plays like the ads which is simply not true, I seriously doubt it has a 4.7 rating as games on Google Play do seem to have suspicious ratings compared to the reviews.

Definitely a time investment and long term game. The minigame in the ads is a small part of the experience, but if you like war strategy mmos this is great. Love the seasons with new activities and styles, always incredible when you find an alliance that matches your vibe. They have recently reduced prices after feedback too (at least in the uk?) which is an amazing change for those willing to spend, but it is not nescassary by any means

A very slow boring war game; unless you are spending some serious money. Example, I am f2p and yet I am still in top 6 power in my alliance and they are spending a lot of money. Probably more 'pay-to-play' than most games of this type. And there are no adverts, even for a bonus; despite what said elsewhere.

updated review, game community can still make or break this game for you as a player, its the games biggest draw, and Id love to see them play into this more, monetization is still awful, but has improved slightly, still able to buy everything in game, fro. resources to heroes to tech giving a massive boost to payers and leaving f2p far far behind. the worst part is passes you have to buy twice to get the full thing, rather than buying the more expensive tier and getting it all.

The game would be much better without all the excessive 'building' that you MUST do to continue playing the best part of the game... the actual 'fighting' part... the 'war' part. and why does the game ALWAYS take so long to load, because it 'updates' EVERY time you open it. The basics of the game had the potential to be great, but it is just way too overloaded with unnecessary rubbish!!

DO NOT START THIS GAME!! Save hours of your life for something that counts! I've now played this game for nearly two years and spent quite a lot on it. The developers have now lost the plot unfortunately. Season 5 is extremely boring and everything decent in game is pay to play. Play mechanics are repetitive. The seasons are clown shows with very little guidance about what to do and why. I'll be sad to leave my alliance aft 18 months, but playing this game is now a complete waste of time.

the game definitely is not what is advertised but it's really fun. The biggest issue I guess is that if you want to progress quickly you need to spend money. Progress through the game is very slow otherwis. Lack of ads is great. A few things would improve the game quite a bit: 1. make doom walkers searchable 2. make tasks/trucks searchable for plundering 3. remove tasks/trucks that have reached the plunder limit. 4. a chat search function or an ability to pin and save messages for yourself

Amazing, fun game the level finishes abit to fast and game is very fun and easy. I wish it had low/medium/hard options. but im nearly Level 20 and not a Single Ad! there are ads if you want bonus. Otherwise this game is true to its advert. it's so so fun and very addictive. I just played constantly and can't stop. better than anu other game of its type this game should get 7 ******* Ratings!! It's Free no B.S Definitely worth it a great way to loose track of time fast!! THANK YOU DEVELOPERS!!

Absolute garbage. It's a far cry from what is advertised. In fact, I'd accuse it of false advertising. I'd report it to google, but that's even more convoluted a process still. The game that is advertised is but 5-10% of the time you'll actually spend on this game. You'll waste time building bases, and "heroes" and such rubbish. It's a waste of time.

I don't get it. Weird "game" for weird people. Best as I can figure you "win" by spending as much money as possible to upgrade your army and\or as much time as possible collecting free power-ups via boring autobattles or tasks. there is very little skill involved, it's more like a military 'football manager' type game than the shooter shown on the ads. There is zero fun to be had and throw into the mix that many of the other players are, shall we say, highly strung and a little bit divergent.

Yet another predatory and repetitive build, recruit, kill the enemy, slow grind, join an alliance, pay to win game. It looks nice in the ads and you do play mini games, as advertised, but they are a tiny part of the game. If you don't have oodles of spare cash to throw at this game, don't bother. Getting pummelled daily, by much stronger pay to play enemies, will only frustrate you.

It's been good fun so far. No ads but prompts to buy stuff. Edit: ok so I played this game for over 6 months. The game ad is for side mission to clear zombies, the game has different servers and each server will have a different season like 1,2,3, for which you need to prepare for the next one as they get harder. I made it to level 70m power with my clan and I have made some good friends from it. However I stopped because it can take up so much time. Started 18/08/2024

overall, the game is advertised as something it's not. The icon of the game is actually showing a minor very small and increasingly insignificant mini game within a larger one. This game is a resource grinder /tower defense type, but with one sinister trick, the higher level you go, the less competitive you get. this is because you have to pay to play as resources become more scarce, upgrades become more costly.

I bought some items in order to upgrade a character only to find out after I purchase that despite what's shown, the character can't be upgraded yet. I applied for and received a refund (4.99). They removed 1000 diamonds from my stash on the 1st day and blocked my account on the second day. Tried to strong-arm me into repaying the 4.99. Buyer beware. They advertise features that you can't get. Un-installed.

Complicated Base building. I did not get this game to build a base and have annoying restrictions on when I can do certain things and when I can play the real game. I hate this. Too complicated. I just want to play the game. Let me play it. Building the base is not playing, it is just annoying stuff you added to make it appear like it's worth money. You need to simplify this to a level select, and that's it. I choose a level then play.

My first time play this game. At the beginning, it was fun and exciting. As a player, you expect to beat the game, so once when you're into it, it's kinda hard to get out because you kept on putting money into it and hope to reach the goal. Every time when you try to step up, you ended pay more. They sell you a little packages cost $5 dollars don't do anything, like given my money away for nothing. By 3rd week end, I've already spent more than a game console. Too expensive for a mobile game!

The only thing that isn't that bad about this game is the fact the ads didn't lie. The only thing it didn't say is that it's a mini game and so hard that you don't need skill to beat it but luck. In the main game you build a base and get cards to beat bosses, but to do so you must use money. To make things worst a daily mission is to "make an in-game purchase". Not the worst game but not the best. Also this game broke my phone.

Its predatory. Wants your money. Nothing like the ads. The community is just as bad if you end up in a server with super competitive people. Very very hard to be free to play if you want a chance to keep up with those that do spend money. If you don't take this game seriously and treat it as background noise then thats what it can be. Eats up your time if you aren't careful.

Fun Game -BUT! - It is Pay To Win! You will need to spend at least $5-10 thousand dollars to compete with the higher level players who may spend over $30k. These numbers are not exaggerations. If you want to play for fun and spend, I would suggest a budget of $1-3k, this is entry level to be able to beat FTP like myself. The game constantly demands spending throughout and runs like a casino in ways that tempt you to spend.

The game cannot be played in offline mode. I specifically wanted a game I could play in areas without cell coverage or wifi. I cannot understand the reasoning for this restriction, other than forcing players to see ads every time they play. Well, in that case I'm uninstalling and giving 1 star - I was unable to play even once when I wanted to.

This is not necessarily a P2P, but some wise purchases can help. You shouldn't need to spend more than $10 and it's not required. If you look to some of the big alliances they'll have their share of f2p. This platform appears to be generic. You'll find numerous other games with identical play but different textures & dialog. Look for a good alliance through chat. Edit: the makers really don't want feedback as it's nearly impossible to find a way to do so. WS: clouds & bldg indicator obscure hqs

This game is one of the worst examples of pay-to-win I've played. The balance is terrible, and the absurdly expensive in-game items make skill matter far less than spending money. It's no surprise that so many players have abandoned the servers, turning what should be a multiplayer experience into an empty and boring grind. If the developers keep prioritizing monetization over fair gameplay, this game has no future.

This game is huge & takes up a lot of GB on your phone. Been playing almost a year now and I had a lot of fun. I reached Base Level 20, I have over 1 trillion in food, iron & gold. (maybe I'll come back later)Before I left, I invited players to invade me & plunder my booty. I gave it away as much as I could because I didn't want my booty going to waste. the game never ends, they're always coming up with new ideas, which is refreshing. but I want to play other games. So,go plunder some booty. ✌🏻

I love this game. But new players are being thrown to the wolves, not knowing what to do. Having to ask many questions becomes a chore and adds frustration. Make a detailed beginner guide. So by the time a player reaches at least lvl 10 HQ, they should be familiar with the game. The same thing with events. Have tutorials on events in the game so it's not so difficult at first. Please lower costs of the so many things that need to be purchased in order to progress. Be fair to everyone! *Please*

it's P2W. Can't keep up with whales and can't make any progress without spending or waiting years. There's no balance. Every Friday, at 2200 Eastern, server resets. It's all out war. Your only choices are to shield for 24 hours or face annihilation by whales from other servers. You'll never be able to win any decent items this way. Rank? You can forget it. Stay away at all costs.

If you look up the definition of hyper-monetization, this game is the perfect image of it. While the sliding guys around "exists", it's only just enough to skirt the boundaries of false advertising. Once you get to the base building, as a free player... you will hit that paywall or you will be waiting literal days for one upgrade. Want that fancy base skin from a limited event? Be ready to fork over $400 for it... Yeah nowhere near worth that.

This game is very well made. Tons of fun. It always has something for you to do in the game. Whether it is going to war, battling each other, farming, or simply collecting nonstop rewards, its all there at your fingertips. Definitely worth you trying it out!! One of my top fave!! you wont be disappointed. It takes about 30 minutes before you get in the real gaming action. But well worth it!

Trying to find a game that just lets you play the mini game and this isn't it. I was able to play a few rounds and then suddenly it's into some sort of world building selecting things for farmland and who knows what there's no instructions and I'm not looking for steeper strategy as they keep talking about in the replies to negative reviews. These bait and switch games are despicable and sadly this is yet another one in a very long list of them. Why can't somebody just make the mini-game?

The game is not a fair game and it's barely as advertised. i have played it extensively. i have not spent on it. no matter what you do, players who spend money will enjoy the game more than those who do not. they will have access to faster growth and power, regardless of strategy. it's is a fully Pay-to-Win experience. when you feel you're about to catch up, another paíd option becomes available and the gap increases again. it's common to find spenders who achieve 4 months worth of growth in 1w

Starts off really fun and great. The game really draws the player in. However, like Clash of Clans, you only get so far before progression slows to a painful and boring speed. Unless you pay for all the "deals" progression is incredibly slow while at the same time the player is getting constantly attacked compounding the issue. Great game for a short period of time and if you have the time it could be fun.

I've been playing this game for 2 years! It was a distraction at first and then it became a social thing to stay connected to friends! Now it's evolved into a part of my life! It definitely started out like another Money Grab by the creators of Top War. BUT, they actually changed ALL OF THAT! They scaled back the push for purchasing, they made purchasing packs MORE rewarding, they've hidden the components that are geared towards purchase success behind multiple layers... Download this GAME!

Be prepared to be let down. Like the many other games like this that false advertise. It's another base building game. They get you started with the initial game you want to play but then it devolves into a boring base builder with to much going on. I feel like I'm spending more time collecting useless stuff than actually playing the game.

this game is basically a bullying simulator. there is no way for weaker players and alliances to defeat stronger players and alliances so it is just a giant hierarchy of punching down. on the plus side you can play free without seeing a single ad and can advance almost as far as the big spenders, albeit at a lower rate. it also has a nice chat translation so you can communicate with players around the world, and there are lots of countries that play.

I have to say, I'm very disappointed with the devs removing the affordable packs. Everything is gone basically and they only kept the 50 and $100 packs. Those small priced packs really helped up my account and my teams accounts. I don't see much account advancement without being able to spend. I hope they are replacing this with something good. I really do. I cannot afford to throw out $100 in one go. Drone parts are hard to get as it is and now we can no longer buy them unless we spend big. 😭

I really like this game at first and I really didn't mind spending money on it. couple of weeks ago they made some changes to their game packs and they removed the one for $0.99. they're explanation was we removed it to cut down on spending. That's the most idiotic thing I've ever heard because they have packs for $100. since they move the 99 cent pack I have yet to spend any cash and I doubt they'll ever see another penny for me I'll just play for free. cut your own nose off to spite your face

Great game but only problem is the arms race which takes too much of personal time as you need to log in every 4 hours to do the task otherwise you'll miss the rewards. The once a day "switch" of arms race schedule daily is not enough it needs to be atleast twice a day so we can still be competitive in this game , get a good nights sleep & still have time for daily chores or activities with friends and families. I feel the longer I play it becomes so stressful and a waste of precious time.

The game itself could be pretty good, even with in game purchasing. The flaw is rich bullies speed big money and just go around destroying everything without game moderation. I plays to relax, not build something so rich sociopaths can have fun destroying my stuff. *yes, you can spend money to fend off the big players but that just means the person who waste the most money on the game wins.

avoid this game at all costs. if you don't pay you have no chance. if you don't join an alliance you're also out of luck. very complicated and sloppy building and development design that is hard to navigate. you build up for weeks only to lose it all to a player 10x levels hair then you when they raid you. the advertising part of this game is a very tiny part of it after level 15 or so. save your time and money. no clue how their reviews are so high on here.

This game is pay-to-win and I don't like microtransactions at all, but my time playing this has been fun. With the free items you can get to lvl 15 base level, but only if you prioritize building the base first. Find a good guild/alliance to play with because most of the time is more spent with them than solo; being in a good alliance will passively boost your level as you help each other. One last thing is that several options are also time-gated, that would help boost your materials fast.

pay to play game period, minimum of $1,000 a month minimum to actually play. there gonna say pay is optional you can play without paying. lol what a joke , this isnt a "game" its a app where your strength and base are based on the amount you spend. ALL side events are money based, special weapons are $20 each character to open, season is $5 a week plus $25 for the season ticket. overlord is pay to get pay to upgrade, there is no way of earning nothing. advertisement for this app is a lie.

The game doesn't reflect the meaning of "war" at all. You wait for weeks just to participate in a war, and some wars last only 30 minutes! The decorations are very poor and overpriced; even a child could design better ones. Event timings are terrible, with some events starting at 4 a.m. The support team has no real solutions. The seasons are repetitive and become boring very quickly.Stupid game, don't lose your money and time with game

1 day of playing: it's cool, no ads is great. 1 month of playing: This game is as pay to win as they get, you can climb up free but play VERY slowly, and I mean the bases and stuff take WEEKS to upgrade without your wallet. It's fun until you hit the hardest part of the paywall. GOING INTO SEASON 3, You can no longer compete as a free to play player, the worst part of the game, 3v3s, you wont be able to do anymore bc your power will be too low (trust I even spent a little) not that you'd want to

I've played this game for 10 months, and it's clearly pay-to-win. Players who spend money progress quickly, while free-to-play players are left behind with a very slow grind. The "free rewards" are minimal and don't make much difference. The game seems more focused on making money than providing a fair experience. I've decided to uninstall it. If this continues, the game may eventually lose many of its players.

I downloaded this game looking for a deep alliance-driven strategy experience. While the game starts with fun casual mini games and an engaging loop it quickly evolves into predatory pay to win trap. Strategy is technically part of the game which strategy will never overcome players willing to empty their wallet. Upward mobility is not an option for low spending or free to play players. There are multiple layers and types of payments that are constantly being pushed out.

The game is fun and addicting but too many updates, system errors and corrections. If you complain it takes days to get a response. Ordered a package for did not get what was stated descripion asked for refund took 3 days for response. Got money back from Google and then they charged me gold bars in the game. They have the control of the game not you. They can do anything they want even when they mess up. Last War is all about them getting paid not you having fun!!

while the game is entertaining here some things I wish would change 1) ranking system where players fight other player closer in rank (not a lever 75 vs 150's. it's annoying to keep losing all my grind when I have no chance anyway) 2) having a limit on the amount of times the same person can attack a base. I get it, you beat me 3-4 times but 11 times is excessive and how am I to defend after the 6th time and I have no troops

The gameplay is genuinely enjoyable but the monetization is built on a trap most players won't see until it's too late.You are locked to one server. That server will eventually become politically toxic - it's inevitable by design. when it does your only escape is abandoning your account and everything you spend on to create another account in another server. The game creates urgency to spend early. The server system ensures that spending can become worthless overnight. play free or not at all.

Where the game was initially enjoyable and fairly reliable, the unbalanced pairing of opponents started to sour the experience. To make matters worse, the purchases stopped working correctly and you would be charged without receiving anything. This happened on two separate occasions and customer service didn't resolve either issue and I had to resolve through my credit card company. They had the nerve to point out two separate purchases so buyer beware. Don't play

last war is a fantastic game but also one of the most frustrating game you have ever play, let me explain the developers are extremely good at making you spend money on the game. This makes the game frustrating for most of the free to play players. if you pay you will win and we aren't talking about 40 bucks a month, no no those packages go up to 170 $. it's promoting gambling and money over skills. mean you can be the best players if someone just spent 10k on that game you will never win.

this game just becomes super annoying. the more you progress the worst it gets . you have to wait days sometimes to upgrade things. if I play a game I just want to play it not come back every couple of hours. I understand the making money part of it but who wants to play a game for ten minutes and come back 24 hours later to play for ten minutes again . don't waste your time on this game we'll unless you don't have a life

Worst Customer Service Ever! I never received a $50 item I purchased. I've been arguing with support for a week, providing proof of the missing items, but they send conflicting reports, ignore the evidence, and refuse to acknowledge the problem. I'm ready to give up and take the loss. If you are planning on purchasing items, I highly recommend you use a payment method that lets you dispute charges.

The game is very very very provocative in it's way of pushing you to spend, which in-turn makes you want to spend less due to its very predatory nature... and moreso, many of these offers are not even very rewarding and fair, especially the way that the game leans back and forth with being pro minimal spender and whales.

great game! starts out simple but it slowly ease you into your commander role. Before I realise it, I was govnerning like a Pro! balancing military and economy needs and there are still ways that we can go back and enjoy the simple parts of the game like Amour Truck explorer and Frontline breakthrough.

If high-level players are going to be given rewards, then that’s fine, but low-level players should also receive something. Today my friend received a lot of rewards through mail—his level is 28—while mine is 18 and I didn’t get anything at all. At least low-level players should be given something; this is really unfair and quite disappointing.

This game is not for free players F2P. It seems great & fun the first month but you will regret it soon once you figure out you have 3 options: 1 spend money 2 get literally crushed by any medium spender 3 uninstall. Free and big spenders play all in the same warzone, you can imagine how wildly unfair it becomes, the huge gap is even clear starting from the early stages of server and it gets worst. ps: risk of financial ruin is very real. Don't call me commander.

non existent customer support I've been playing the game for a good few months now, it's fun, not totally what's advertised, but still fun🙏 the people I've met are amazing. however the support for developers is next to none..... I desperately need help and have messaged and have been ignored, so if you want a game that's fun great download ..but seriously if you mess up, don't expect any help or support from the game

I wish I would have never downldaded this game. It was so fun when i started playing, it no longer becomes competitive in later seasons. I have sent the support team messages daily about this, it's very exhausting as they won't do anything to address the issues.

Ladies & kids, be aware that if some guy decides to send you disgusting messages, IF there is a single spelling mistake in what he sends, you can't report him or his messages, because their AI doesn't detect any concern. And magically, the game's Support Team is unreachable. It very heavily relies on AI for issues and it's so bad and useless for actually helping its users. Ladies and kids beware of Last War, it is not a safe game.

I have been playing this game for years and it is probably the funniest thing I have ever played. The only problem is that you almost have to spend at least $100 a year to keep up with other people. Also the game isn't hard to learn it it mainly straight forward with what to do, but after you play for a while you can learn shortcuts and what is best to day early on. TIP: On your 1st account spend no money and ask people in your alliance and even in the world chat what they're buying.

this game is fun but extremely expensive if you have so much money that you can spend hundreds thousands building an account that can be turned into nothing by some wealthy maniacal maniac.. that literally destroyed the gameplay for everyone on the server.this game is for you...stupid enough to start another account only to find that they tripled the price from just a few weeks ago. these games are extremely fun and addictive. id never recommend anyone to get involved in this one!!!!!

I like the game, but you have to do something better when someone keep attacking other people in the same server for months! I talked to support center but they didn't do anything to him! this ignorance will make us delete the game! imagine one person force 100 players to delete the game, and you don't do anything to him!

BIG SCAM!!! If you have been spending time trying to get in the line for buff (aka the secretary of building or else) to build or research with less time, you will find the developer calculates time based on original time rather than the speeded up time that thanks to your hard work on upgrading and building things. Quitting this game as they make the thing building time from 4 days to 8 days after buff which is nonsense!!

This is for server 165, which has absolutely zero chance of being highly competitive. The algorithm for transfer seats is severely broken. The game counts 100 small players the same as 1 large player. In reality, 100 small players can't make a dent in a large player and this just motivates servers to kill off all of their small active players. Shameful

The game is very addictive. I think if you purchase the 5th protein farm, it should be permanent, not weekly. The same goes for the 4th squad. If purchased, it should be permanent, not temporary. Some of the red dot notifications are not populating.

insanely repetitive and boring gameplay loop. super tedious too. like has no one gave any thought to valuing the users time? same collect action split into 20 buildings? I thought something was broke so I looked it up and it nakes it easier after you tons of hours in. How bout I just opt out now and find something else? lol

Excellent game. If you're looking to spend, certainly better to spend the budget earlier in the game as that will position you well for the seasons ahead. Customer support is fantastic, they're quick to respond to any concerns or queries. Only issue is season matchmaking - it is far from balanced and competitive. This is something LW need to address promptly, however, given the amount of money the big alliances/servers spend, it's not surprising to see their groupings heavily favoured.

Excellent game just a fine experience 👍 and just good for a long term game . Just be careful of unnecessary ad and just make it the upgrades a little less sudden and just overwhelm people and make the things a lot cheaper and tell people to be ready about expenses and the stuff you know.

DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME AND MONEY ON THIS GAME!!! Spent 2+ years playing this game and spending a lot of money. Had to reinstall on a new phone and they lost the connection to my Google play account and are completely unwilling to give me access to my account again. This company will take your money and keep you from getting what you put your money into.

It's Turned into a Pay to Win Game now. Prepare to spend $$$ if you want to succeed. I have Accounts on 4 Servers and they are constantly pulling back rewards and Resources making it impossible for newer players to ever compete with Money Players. I used to really enjoy the game but now it's just a Cash grab at best

only about 2 percent of the game is as depicted, the rest is building a base and buying time... not as advertised in the endless ads that pop up... Uninstalled.... and accidently clicked and sent an email to play on PC... so I suspect my spam folder will soon give birth. update, no endless spam, but in response to the developers reply.. if the game is so great, origional, and addictive... why not show something more than the special ops which are a statistically insignificant part of the game

I have played for over a year the game is a fraud. They rig every aspect of the game. They also allow players too cheat and they also hook the players up that spend a ton of money. If you dont spend they make your game harder and harder to keep up. The game is ran by very very greedy people and they definitely cheating players out of their playing experience. And im going to hire a pro to hack into this game and prove a point. If I have to hold the game hostage I will. I have shut down games b4.

Toxic experience to "free to play" or "low spenders". Devs will say success for free to play players requires strategy. They couldn't be more wrong. You can have thousands of ftp players who are helpless against 1 player who is spending money for the majority of events. There are no mechanics that benefit free to play players no matter what strategy they use.

Do Not play this! You will absolutely devote your entire life into this game! You will end up making close friends and family with an entire community out there, from all over the world. You will learn multiple languages with the translation tool. Bom Dia by the way! You will end up meeting some of these people in real life and starting long term, loyal and safe relationships. You will build skills that can be utilized in the real world: communication, multitasking, organizing, & hosting!

This game is designed into annoying players into purchasing packs they don't need. I contacted support to enquire about relocating / removing a promotional object for an offer I didn't need as I couldn't do it myself. They refused to help, said it is what it is and the only way would be to purchase this unnessary upgrade. Borderline extortion.

Try not to pay too much attention to all the negative reviews. This game is MASSIVE. What they show in the preview is a very small part of this game. Best thing to do is to get into an alliance so it's much easier to grow. The game does seem a little money hungry at times but there are alot of FTP (free to play) accounts that are thriving. Just be consistent and its pretty fun. Been playing just over a year 😬

Scammed out of in game resources. Sick of in-game errors, then contacting support to be told there are no issues. Other players received 200k+ of skill medals back on the recent Scarlett upgrade. Mine at the same level, I get 1k back. Total joke! Half my alliance have the same issue. Just a scam to get you to buy more in game packs.

The game is good but it needs to fix one issue. I wanted to make a purchase using the GooglePay app which is installed on a different device. This is not my main device, just an old phone that I use as a gaming device. The " + Enter UPI ID" option fails. The error says - "Something went wrong on our end. Please try another method". Please fix this at the earliest.

It is like the ads, slide the guys to shoot the dudes. I just wanted to play that, but it's attached to one of those base builders where you have to upgrade your village to unlock new levels of the game. Have I not built enough bases? I quit, I just wanted fast fun.

As a PC/console player, I am baffled at the state of mobile games. This game tricks you early, but after a month or two, you will realise it is just a predatory cash grab. Your skill and teamwork do not matter. Combat between players is based on your wallet. Whales spend thousands for massive stat boosts that no amount of gaming talent can beat.
