this game contains unbeatable levels. they have a youtube video to show that when they edit the game it can be beat. but since you cant edit the game. tough luck. it was this simple little thing that made me hate this game.

OMG!!! This is another bait and switch game. the reason why its popular and has so many downloads is the ads. unfortunately maybe 15% of the game is the lane shooter that was advertised and even that doesn't play or feel like the ads. they openly LIE in the ads that this isn't a lie, but it is mostly a base building game. Don't download this gsme if you are looking for the lane shooting style game, because you won't get it. Bait and Switch game!!!

I have already unlocked Kimberly without buying her, but still I can't move her out of the way so I can't maximize the space on her area. Please don't wait for me to purchase her package cause I'm never going to do that. So please, please, make an update to let us remove her vehicle on its place without paying cause we already have her.

Game is not as advertised at all, it gave me aids of the eyeballs. I downloaded the game to play what was advertised but was not what they advertised. Played decent amount of time and did not get gameplay as advertised.

Am still wet behind the ears when it comes to this game. Everytime I think I got it something else pops up with a red dot. I have about 60% understand understand control but I still need lots of more time to figure it out. so far so good. I use it on my lunch hour to keep my mind fresh and clear. I love this game thank you..
Only giving 4 stars because if you truly want to advance to compete you need to buy at least 2 items. Other than that, I really enjoy the game!

Meh. It was entertaining for about 90 days. I would probably still be playing it if, not just my own server, but one of the rotating presidents of my server randomly started farming me. Also, I got a peek at season 1 and it just wasn't for me. Still, I definitely give it two stars. It advertises as free and I never paid a penny. I would definitely say it's worth a 90 day trial. Just don't get overwhelmed.

It's NOT a farm game. Depending on the server and the alliance you join, it can be regimental and political in nature. It is a strategical game that involves building, but it is way more war based and pretty real to life since you're dealing with real, live people.

I have been playing this game for more than 7 months now. I m in 1972 server currently in S1. I can guarantee once you join a active alliance you will be hooked on . you connect with hundreds of people here from different countries different cultures, Its so addictive i can tell you. If you are planning to download better give the game few weeks then only you will get the real taste our of it. and special thanx to Last War Support Team for constant support and continuous improvement ❤️

I didn't expect much, but after seeing this ad over and over, I thought I'd take a peak. The levels start off super easy. Like, I think I played 10 or so missions and eventually realized that not touching the phone was apparently enough to beat the missions. Literally plays itself. In between missions there's a weird sort of base building thing it has you do, but it's super overstimulating, and it tells you where to click over and over. Not a great experience, wish I could stop seeing the ad

This game, Evony, and I'm sure there's more. They're all bogus. If they simplified the levels to just the shooting sequence, to see how long you can last, it would be great. Instead there are these little side tasks and building upgrades that complicate what I'd thought would be a simple fun game. I fell for the relentlessly annoying ads. Never again.

This is another one of those build-a-base/city/fort strategy game that markets itself as an action/shooting game, but the shooting part is very simple and repetitive. Also, I was 10 minutes in the game and still hadn't found anything like a "Settings" page to turn of the sound and music. Unacceptable in 2024! Only pro: the game seems well made, not glitchy, and the graphics are OK.

It's fun at first, but then it becomes frustrating if you don't dump a lot of money into it. The game allows other players who are far OP to ransack/raid your base and trucks over and over again. It should be set up so that if you're within a certain range level, you can only raid other players within the same level range, up or down. Sure, you can level your base and heroes without spending money, but it is a much slower process, made even slower by the griefers. I un-installed it.
I like this game, but I miss the settings to keep the system clock visible on top and Android control buttons (like back) on the bottom. That would help a lot.

This game is not what you see in the ads. It only exists for "micro" transactions, most of which are $9.99, and multiple that are $99 and this is pay to win. I want to reply because they did. It is true that there is gameplay in the "Special Operations that is similar to the style of the ads. You will get 5 levels of this play for every base level. Around base level 15 upgrading takes over a week of real time. I played for about 3 months and got about as far as I think you can without paying.

Gameplay is bad. It's ad ridden everywhere. And the app manages to force you back into it after you lock your phone--pulls you back into it. The purchase options will greet you every time you turn it on. And the growth of your base is useless. There's no reason to grow it when the game is super easy. Also, if you can't beat something, it's purely due to the leveling system, because as soon as you get to the necessary level, the game is easy again. Don't download, it's a waste of your time.

Why not just give us the game that's advertised? Just wanted a fun little pastime shooter game. But most of the "game" is building and repairing things. Silly little puzzles. Spent far more time trying to figure out how to get back to the action. Got frustrated with it quickly and gave up. Oddly, it must have started off great, since all the early reviews are 5-star. Classic bait and switch.

Edit: I've played the game a bit more and still isn't for me. I think for me it's just too involved. I'm usually short pressed for time and having to put extra effort into fixing buildings, upgrading weapons, manually leveling up commbatants, etc is just too much effort on a 10 minute break here at work. Game has potential and I can see where some may like it. Just not for everyone I guess. ------ Looks neat in the ads but actual game is boring. Just can't get into it.

This is a base game. I've played too many in the past to know how it works. It sucks the players into a loop of tasks to level their base with quick progress, but it slows down over time and becomes a near-impossible feat. Years after the game's release, players are going to have to spend money to dream of catching up to dedicated early players. I swore never to play another one after Mobile Strike. Gameplay does resemble the ads, but it's still a little different.

Game play isn't as advertised. Initial start up is what you see in ads, but very quickly becomes a different game entirely. Not worth the time if you aren't interested in "strategy" games of the same type. Edit: I DID try the game. Your ads like many others are misleading, and do not represent main game play. It switches to an entirely different genre after you get your HQ to level 3, and just becomes another bog standard survival strategy game that does nothing we haven't seen before.

The YouTube ads showing a strategy scroller are deceptive. That does exist within a small part of this game. However, in order to continue those types of puzzles, one must continuously level up. This isn't so bad, but there is a player vs player (in and out of teams)aspect to this, and the mechanics are such that higher level players (and teams) can easily prey on lower level players. Of course, you could continue to make in app purchases to get around that, but it's not economical.

Unbearably bad bait and switch. Like others have said, the main draw to the game is the shooter with options to upgrade based on what side you scroll. After a few days, you literally can't play that and instead have to do a bunch of other boring upgrade tasks. Also, do not listen to their response saying you can play the "Special Ops" mode. You can for a few levels before it's locked and you have to do the same boring upgrade tasks. Terrible.

I agree with other reviews and players are saying about this game. It's literally 95% managing a base and upgrading your units if you're able. The developers are very heavy with forcing pay to win features on almost every page. It's not really like the ads. That's just special operations that you can only do five times per HQ level. They are short 30-60 seconds levels. One of the strangest "games" I've ever played.

hyper aggressive ad campaign and poor game. I only downloaded this because I was forced to go through a minute and a half worth of an ad about it that was supposed to be a 30-second ad. I used to stop watch. it was pretty neat. so false advertisements aside here. it's not much of a game, more like a brain dead. move your finger on the screen simulator. I had to play "game" 11 minutes before I was able to mute it in any meaningful way but I was also advertised purchases before that happened.

The ads on YouTube say it's a game based on the fake game from the ads. This is a only partially true. It's just another generic base building game (with everything slowed down by the usual timer and resources) that just happens to include shooting zombies. Even worse, everything about it is designed to get you to spend money. Less than 10 minutes in, I was shown that I unlocked a hero. When I went to collect, turns out I'd have to pay real money if I wanted to actually unlock her. 0/10

The game is drastically different from the initial 2 or 3 hours of gameplay. Initially you advance at a very fast pace, but as the levels progress, the enemies become very tough to beat, you would to level up by atleast 10. And to do that it would require atleast a week or 2. Also the gameplay isn't remotely what is shown in the ad. Majority is spent doing chores like farming, upgrading, training etc. Most of the gameplay is automated, even kids game have more interaction.

The game is constantly disconnecting, even after uninstall reinstall. My home wifi is stable, the game is unstable. It's next to unplayable. Not to mention the number of micro transactions, there are so many. You can not get legendary heroes for free. They need to add a way to limit who can join your rally. You should be able to block players under a certain power from joining when you are trying to fight a big monster. It's almost impossible to kick w/ rejoining. There are no ads at least.

Last War Review: ★★★☆☆ Last War closely resembles its advertisements, providing an engaging gameplay experience that matches what’s shown. However, it falls short in depth and originality, making it feel repetitive over time. While it has potential, it needs more unique content to keep players hooked. Overall, it's a decent game but with room for improvement. Solid 3 out of 5 stars.

The ads for this game are very dishonest, because the gameplay is only like that in concept. However, it was still pretty damn interesting for a while. It's really a base-building game (similar to Boom Beach). Due to the character designs and post-apocalyptic setting, I actually found myself playing longer for the story; but like with all free-2-play games, the story stalls pretty early on and you're left doing a repetitive series of endless quests with very little to no narrative development.

It would be easy to improve this game. The running back and forth game that we are all looking for DOES exist in here, but it's like a mini game. And you can only play about five levels before having to level up. This would be FINE if they let you replay the Special Ops levels, but you can't. Once you defeat a level, you can't play it again — you have to go through the long process of leveling up before playing again. Pretty cool game, but just letting us replay Special Ops levels would be great

The tutorial is like the ads and after you play 5 games of tutorial, the game asks you to rate it. (What you see in the ads is the tutorial and also it is also a minigame within the game). After that it turns into a timed, base building, competitive war game. It turns into a wallet battle (p2w) with top alliances. This was not what I was looking for. I was hoping this would be a game I could play quickly when I'm taking a break but ends up consuming hours of my time. I had to uninstall.

It was awesome game. Until you level up and then whale took over. If you do not follow their rules, they will attack. If you look at them they attack. Then will take you minimum 1 day for high level troops to heal. But they attack all at once, your troops die. Then it's almost 2 days to get your troops trained. It became impossible for me to level up and complete. If you love spending money to win. This game for you. Edit: doesn't work when running kit of points and getting hit right away.

Misleading. I tried it because the advertisements showed the ability to shoot positive walls and increase their effect. This seemed broken and potentially possible to create a large army in seconds. I was curious and gave it a shot. It does not work that way, and it hardly resembles the advertisements. It's a limited time base builder with mini missions that are thrown at you with hardly any coherent story or polish. It's a cash grab with lackluster mechanics.

The ads show a what is considered a mini-game within the game. The majoring back and forth collecting powerups and troops is not the main game. And when you are finally able to level your base up enough to actually do those missions, level 40 is insanely, ridiculously hard. It got to the point where I checked online to see if I was missing something, but no! There is nothing but complaints about it, and you're stuck. Save yourself the time if you saw the ads. It's basically a different game.

The game was fun initially, with a lot of fast progress, and gameplay similar to the ads. After that initial phase, the game gets VERY boring, where you have to get resources, wait for buildings, train units, spend money, upgrade heros, just so you can get 4-5 levels of gameplay similar to the ad that got us all in before you have to upgrade, which takes a LOT, just to get again the same. I'm level 65 on my heros, have spent 30ish bucks on it, and I'm bored out of my mind. Shame.

Microtransactions are very greedy. You need to spend hundreds of dollars on each item (individually) to acquire base skins, drone skins, and other necessary elements to stay competitive. If you don't pay you just get steam rolled. You have no ability to fight back and it's just too easy for someone to buy everything. Bugs, lag, and stability issues are frequent. Everything is an upgrade and limited time items are converted to another item to prevent you from getting the top event prizes. Leave

Designed to make you get addicted and spend money. Main game mode makes you think you're doing something but you're not - if you upgrade enough you win, short bursts to keep the dopamine flowing. If you start to lose, all you need to do is upgrade your heroes by building up your base, can pay to speed up build time. Operation Falcon is more fun, but there are a couple of levels (13 and 16) which get ridiculously difficult. Either bad design or difficulty spikes so you go back to main game.

This is my first review of any app. This game could play much better if in-game items could be exchanged for items needed. There is a constant abundance of many items that just stack up in your inventory. If they could be exchanged for items needed instead of having to earn currency in the game, it would play much better. For example, if I could exchange coins, steel, and food for puzzle pieces, upgrade ore, speed ups, experience points, etc. Developer response proves you didn't even read it.

Over half a gig for a game that speed runs you through a ton of mechanics. Twenty minutes of a tutorial and most of it was tap and wait for something to finish. IDK if the game is fun beyond this point because the guide missions were either gain or lose something instead of actual decisions. The game has bugs where the bullets shoot to the left making it impossible to deal with the right, and enemies can run behind you which you can only shoot if they're the last ones.

You should include more screenshots. Not just the part people will actually enjoy. The build a base, train soldiers, level up portions are boring & time consuming. I saw a commercial suggesting the game was different. I'm disappointed. 🙄 EDIT: Thanks for responding. I only like the advertised play. Which lasted about 60 seconds then to base build mode & that wasn't fun. Some people may like that. I still suggest you add that to app screenshots for transparency. Feels intentionally misleading.

I have played this game for about 5 months at the time of of writing this review. The ads are mostly false. There are various modes in this game, and the mode that ads are closest to is Frontline Breakthrough which is no unlocked at the start of the game. This game is huge time sink, and an even biggier money sink. 99% of the time, you will lose to people who've spent more money than you. I would say more, but can't due to character limit. If you heavily dislike P2W, AVOID THIS GAME!!!

I played this game for a decent amount of time; daily for about a month. What you see in the ads with the math and the waves of zombies is like 1% of the game. The rest is just mindless leveling of buildings in your city. It's fine if you want to just tap your screen when you're bored, but there is absolutely zero skill required for this game which makes it pretty boring. ** Edit ** Sure, the difficulty increases, but the solution isn't more thoughtful gaming, it's just mindless leveling.

Mostly as advertised, but it will last for couple of days, top. It is not the main gameplay, just small mini games. All progress is tied to base upgrades, which starts to be long and boring after only two days. Regarding mini games, mostly you ability to win is tied to hero levels, not the correct decisions. With weak team I can't even collect some powerups. But with strong one I can just watch doing nothing. So, two days, goes to garbage.

It's not really a game. It is more of a entertainment and money begger. You have little choice on what to build, everything takes forever to build, your troops need to be upgraded every couple of stages, and for that you need to upgrade more and more your base. The graphics are nice, the concept is not too bad, but the game is just another one of its time - banking on its players desire to progress to get them to pay for speed ups and upgrades.

I was going to give this game a 1-star, but so far it is the only have I've played that is like their ads; however, the difficulty of breakthrough is ridiculous. I have played games were the solve was difficult, these are near impossible after just a few levels. This is also one of those "pay-to-win" games. Once you get to a certain level, you're fighting against the map, unless you can buy 1000s of shields to make yourself invulnerable. Uninstalling until breakthrough is fixed.

The ad portion is just a small sample of the game. But the games full concept is nice. More than what I expected. My only problem is that a whole clan can that's at the top can keep attacking lowe villages repeatedly, forcing them to relocate multiple times in a day, losing tons of resources. They fix that, and this might be a more playable game.

I downloaded this game before and it is absolutely nothing like this video. You have to build a city you have to power up characters. There's no puzzle or skill to it. It's all about playing more and more and more until you have to do one or two things paid to level up or wait. Ridiculous amounts of time for it. Either way it ain't worth it. The ad actually looks interesting. The game itself is not. Stop the whole zombie thing we're all over it. Your ad is soldier vs soldiers and the game is not

Fun at first but very P2W. Once you get to Lvl 10-11 everything slows to a crawl. You can't win battles unless you upgrade your heroes, but you can't do that unless you have enough resources. You can't do that unless you add buildings to your base, but you can't because you have to upgrade each of your buildings first! And you're capped at 1 build slot unless you buy more, so you'll wait DAYS to make any progress. It's all so they can push you to buy "speed up" items. Artificial Timers: The Game

This game is stupid. It's slow moving, micro transactions are anxious greed. Build time, as has been referenced. AND NOT ACTUALLY WHAT THE ADDS SHOW. It's a weird zombie theme. 0/10. They responded, suggesting I "play the full game." That's hilarious! I played it, it's terrible. If it played like the adds, I would have kept playing.

Let's get into it. The game is NOT as advertised, Homelander's actor aside. In the ads, he plays an entirely separate game. Simple. Fun. What this game is, is a zombie base builder with minor components of what is advertised. Even then, you don't get to enjoy the freedom of choice. The red minus troop number zones are, actually, impossible to turn positive. They take minimal damage compared to the barrels they really want you to destroy to level up troops in a level. Dang it, word count limit.

It's just a click simulator, I feel like I'm watching a cutscene but I'm able to click around. The game failed in my own perspectives. It could be a good start for you and maybe release a different version later on. But combining that first part of the game where you shoot mobs and get move size or guns was really fun. Turning it into a normal strategic game about building and farming resources is just a lame thing to do. My honest advice is to separate the two and work on both separately.

The game's pretty okay, but the player base is weirdly toxic. There's some good people in the game, but because it doesn't take a whole lot of skill and you can pay to win, it attracts a certain type that really detracts from The Cooperative gameplay. But if you need a tiny little bit of power in your life, this is the game for you I would have avoided it but the ads are slightly misleading. The moving back and forth and shooting piece is in the game, but only very occasionally.

Game is VERY pay to win. For example, when you unlock the second tech research building, there is no free way to obtain it. Only $13.99 Next, you can only upgrade one building at a time. But if you pay 2.99 you permanently can upgrade two buildings at a time. These things have significant effects on the gameplay/combat, as your power level gain is pretty limited (compared to those who pay for these things) Can straight buy your way to max tier heroes, or grind and be stomped on all the time.

Very expensive game if you want to progress. Exclusive heroes and base skins cost a lot of money. Starts out as advertised, but there is an underlying base building and weekly objectives to the gameplay. You'll need an alliance to progress, but then get sucked into the competitive side of the game and want to spend lots of money to keep up with your alliance and acquire and develop heroes. If you have money to waste, then sure, try it. Edit: Thank you for listening to my feedback! 4 🌟

Disappointing. Game is advertised as some kind of shooter and looks fun. Turns into a base building slog where your building times get into the hours and days unless you pay to shorten them. The interface is complicated, I guess to confuse you into spending money. When you get back to the game you thought you'd be playing, it's kind of fun until you get to one of the horrendously designed levels that are impossible to finish. I'm personally done with it and wouldn't recommend anyone get into it.

This game is absolute trash. It's too busy and there's no instruction on what you're doing or what the pieces you obtain go to. It's a mess with no flow to the game. And just wait until you get to Level 16 on Operation Falcon. You go from many beatable levels to this impossible dumpster fire of a level. No matter how many strategies you try, you can't pass it. Don't waste your time. No ads but with 10000 different tasks going on, who has time to watch ads. It's just a messy cheap app.

Not like the ads at all. Even though the whole point of the ad is "this is real". Basically a city builder, with something almost like the ads. Not fun for long Edit. Thanks for the reply. No, what you show in your ads IS NOT IN THE GAME AT ALL! there is no gun upgrades. There is no "gotta shoot this snowball". It's a trivial version of what's shown in commercials. You can actually not move your characters left or right at all and still win.

The ads you see, as many mentioned, are such a small part of the game. It's like a minigame within the game. The rest is like any other city building game you play. You have to wait time for your building to finish, upgrade things, blah blah blah. It's boring. What got me to finally just uninstall was level 13 of the wave based game. It's virtually impossible. And the devs made a video tutorial to show how to win, which clearly wasn't actual gameplay. It's peak gaslighting and just bad business.

Ads for this game are misleading. The main game is nothing like the ads. Only a very small part of the game is like the ads. After 3 days of play, you've pretty much reached the end of continuous play. After that, it's long waits to upgrade buildings enough that you can advance in the game. Requires active internet connection for all play. I can understand requiring a connection for some parts of game play. However, it doesn't allow you to do daily maintenence without an active connection.

I got this game for the shooting levels, with the power ups, like in the ads. Once you get past the early stages of the game though, those shooting levels become very rare. You spend all your time building your base, and running errands. The base building is rather bland, and the side missions they give are quite boring. This game is not for me.

It's the game from the ads, but not as it's advertised. Icame across this on youtube ads which showed rolling levels requiring little skill and basic maths to increase your troops to shoot zombies, this is it, this is that game. BUT, that's only a small part of the game, and it bevels that down to as little as possible early enough. The rest of the game is about painstakingly updating your base, heroes and troops. Progress slows to a crawl unless you are willing to sink cash, which people do.

Not like the youtube ads. It's really an idle game with the mini game you see in the pictures in between. The game you actually want to play is way too hard with out constant upgrading which requires an egregious amount of resource. The only two ways to get these resources is waiting around and... you guessed it, BUYING WITH REAL MONEY. The game you wanted to play is a small portion of the app that's a tease, a reward, for waiting around and spending real money. It could've been fun. It was not.

Just Another Bait & Switch! If this game had actually been what the ads say, then it would be top-notch. But it's more about building and upgrading and spending money. You spend very little time engaged in game play, actually battling and choosing sides, and more time with world building and having to upgrade, and being coerced into chatting and inviting friends. How about just giving us what's advertised, and nothing more? Such a disappointment!

It's addicting. I want to call it a scam, because it high key feels like it. Free to play, but if you don't, spend money, you will miss out on most things and become useless. It gets you hooked thinking you'll fight zombies and do math, tapping all these things for instant gratification. Once you feel like you're top dog, they take it away by changing up the game to make you completely on the same level as others. Save your time and money. Hope you don't fall for it like I did.

Feel like a reskin of all those standard base building games where things take real time to complete unless you pay real money for it to complete instantly. The "run and gun" gameplay seen in ads seems to be the progression mechanic, a "minigame" that allows you to unlock stuff for your base. Not bad necessarily, but as someone who's played the Walking Dead Zombie one, it just feels a little same same. Was hoping for a bit of a different experience.

If you're here because of the ads, this is NOT it! It has very different gameplays compared to what's shown in the ads. Or if there is, it is a special or bonus game only. If you're good with that, then this is a good game to play. The game also becomes more expensive in it's game purchases that there are times where you'll just be left waiting for the upgrades or level-ups to be done without actually getting to play what you came here for.

This game is officially mid-tier for me. It could be way better but the micro transactions is ridiculous. First thing the game always do when it loads is blast you with one of the special packs they are selling. Most of their events are behind a pay wall and the ones you don't pay for are confusing. Arena is locked, and everything is grindy. Hella GRINDY!!! With that being said, if you want to play as a casual fan, it's fine. If you are playing to invest some time into it, be ready to spend.

Captivating. But... With bugs. Also misleading advertisement. It's more a strategic game. With less than 5% of the promised game. With many mission you'll not be able to complete... Unless you pay. Pay for extra resources, to speed up building smth, ...you name it. Unlimited options to pay. The good part - no ads from other games. The bad - passive aggressive tech support. I've reported bugs & got denial - no problem, no evidence & it's your problem. No Fair Pay - so you can experience betrayal

Really bad implementation of the game shown in the ads. You have some small battles as seen in the ads but then you go back to your base and have to do some lame base building. The battles are mostly with the same backgrounds and too short. Overall disappointing and there will be a point where you have to spend money to keep up with the levels. Unistalled the game again.

Not a bad game but not exactly what's portrayed in the ads. At the very least they do utilize the mechanics shown in the ads, which is more than most other games that use similar ads do, but it's not as refined and there's a lot more of other content that isn't shown. I really only wanted what the ads showed so I was pretty off put by all the additional content which just makes it so long, repetitive and boring to progress.

close, but not like the ads portray. gameplay is locked behind upgrades at "the base" and once you actually get into the game there aren't blue banners that increase the shooters you're with, usually it's just a new weapon or a "recharge". sure, there are the red banners that you can shoot to increase the value of, but 99/100 times you're not going to be able to get -170 to a positive number. you have to "upgrade heroes" at this point—else, the gameplay is incredibly easy, no skill involved

As others said, this is typical bait&switch game. At the beginning you get to play the game from ads where you run with a squad of survivors, shoot zombies and choose sides with basic math skills. Super fun. But then the game moves to boring slow base building and tries to make you pay for speeding things up. You can occasionally play the advertised game, but not often, because you can only play it certain amount of times for each level, and it gets harder and longer to level up as you progress.

I put up a review for this game, but jumped the gun. At first it was so fun with no ads and great game play, But quickly becomes a money pit. Also forces you to join an alliance, which I don't like. I don't play often enough and they complain if you don't play constantly. In 2 days, it quickly became a serious money pit and I hit a brick wall when I would have to spend serious money for the "wood and food" to continue to upgrade buildings that allow you to keep playing. Very disappointing. :(

Like most, the fun dies off very quick. There is very little gameplay here and after 14 days playing I spend most of the time upgrading, because if you don't there is no game to play. I did purchase packs regrettably, thinking it would enhance the game. I was wrong. Like one person described it, it's purely a pay for play. Which I don't mind spending for a good game, but not one that has no real gameplay strategy and spending 90% of the time having to wait HOURS to upgrade skills.

I have to go with a two because of the marketing technique. The game isn't terrible, but it definitely isn't the game you thought you downloaded. I installed this for the simple mini game, but that mini game becomes such a small part of the actual game just a few days into it. Being lied with constant ads is very unfortunate; especially the "games you thought were fake" ad. The auto running game this pretended to be was what I wanted. Not another base building simulator with a small mini game.

The game is cool and fun to play. The reason for the 3 stars is the extremely long time it takes to build/upgrade. If you plan on playing this game w/ no money or minimal money spent, I wouldn't waste my time. Taking 2, 3, 4+ days to upgrade a building or training soldiers is wild. You spend more time waitin for upgrades/training than playing. I feel the building/training speed could be decreased so ppl spend more time playin rather than waiting. Will change my review if this improves.

Grinding game with a few fun levels like the ones you actually see on ads. When you reach stages 96-102, you're almost stuck, with nothing to do but wait patiently, or forced to pay to accelerate things. I was patient, but when I tried the breakthrough challenge, where you have to beat 5 levels IN A ROW! So without losing once. Even after hours of trying, it was impossible for me to win level 5. Like you need to play 100 times to memorize the pathing. Way to kill or waste time. Uninstalled.

Nice game, but like others said after 2 days or so it gets tedious. The upgrade timers are just too long and take out the fun of the game. I also expected a simpler game. I thought I'll just run the troops through levels shooting and going through the upgrade gates. In the end, this is something where you need to upgrade a base, harvest stuff (for no clear reason) and upgrade heros etc. I'm just not into that.

Edit: Generic trash reply by Dev. That's an uninstall. "Oh, its just like the ads" - every ad they have. It's not. It's false advertising. They did everything they could to make it look like the ad while having it be completely different. Levels in the ad are 30 seconds long minimum. Levels here? 5 - 10. You can't amass an army or anything. When you're done that, you get to play a population sim game. Nothing like the ads. Deceitful, but the game makers are already aware of that.

This game is excellent as a strategy game. However, I had a very poor customer service experience with this expensive game. The in-game packages are misleading, and the refund policies make it nearly impossible to get a refund. Additionally, the game includes gambling elements like loot boxes, which can encourage excessive spending, especially among younger players

Misleading ads and money grab game. The ads showed dodging game from zombies. At the beginning, you get to do this to expand your base. Now, you have to upgrade it, wait a lot of time to level up or you can spend money to jump ahead, just to play a little bit of what you came for in the first place - control your player to dodge zombies or actually shoot zombies. 90% you just grow resources, click on bunch of stuff to kill them - like Farmville. Definitely misleading.

Misleading ads. All the corridor run is a minigame. The bulk of it is totally different and not shown. Bait and switch. Ignore the incoming dev response saying "what's in the ad is in the game!" Sure it is. But you have to wade through a generic, micro-transanction laden click-fest to get to it. And even then it only appears every once in a while.

It's fun, but what I don't understand about these types of games is, why limit your players to how much they can play? Have had this installed less than 24 hours and have 100% run out of things I am able to do until a timer runs down on a building. Only gets progressively worse with these games. Don't you want MORE playtime on your games? I should be able to play a silly mini game to wind down for an hour if I want to, but limiting levels and energy is an instant-uninstall within 24 hours.

The game is fun at starts once it becomes completely clear that it is a heavy pay to win game. As an example when there was a single pack to buy I held a top 10% position, as more packs arrived to purchase, some at over 100EUR, I slowly started losing ranks, ending in the bottom 70%. The Front line portion is fun, but there's multiple glitches, in particular level 16, where you need luck to go through.

I thought this game is going to be a game where you can idly play, some "braindead" types of game you know. But there's surprisingly a lot of mechanics. Heroes, bases, foods, irons, etc. You might be into this type of things. But I just see this as another layer for people to pay for some "progress". This is not the game that I wanted. But clearly a lot of effort was put into these, the art and models are great, animations are surprisingly nice too. But, this is just too much for me.

The ads look super fun. I knew the game would be a clickbait hole, but I still gave it a shot. I knew better, shame on me. As suspected, there is very little to play, just a crapton of "story" and items to collect, crazy complex overworld for what could be a very fun arcade experience. Maybe it gets better, but it's not worth my time to find out.

Last War is a blatant cash grab. Progression is unbearably slow unless you spend money, and even then, the rewards are disappointing. I bought two packs hoping it would make a difference, but it still wasn’t enough to feel like I was actually progressing. On top of that, the game bombards you with ads, making the experience even more frustrating. The concept had potential, but the execution is all about squeezing money from players. Definitely not worth your time or money.

At first, the game is pretty fun. But then comes the endless grinding to upgrade heros, your base, and fight in wars where you are hopelessly out-gunned. This game literally stops any chance of combat until you grind and upgrade, which of course costs $$$. If you choose not to pay-to-play, then you can wait weeks for buildings to be constructed, heros to gain enough points to advance, and weapons to develop and upgrade. This Chinese game is a plot to bankrupt American players. Enough w/ P-2-P.

It's just another game dominated by people who spend the most money. Build buildings, train troops, and gather resources. Only to have another player in minutes destroy everything. Then it takes days to get close to where you were. Upgrading buildings takes days to complete at higher levels, so plan to spend money or wait. The gameplay is fun, but the ads that lured me to playing were misleading as to the type of game this is.

They got me. It's pretty fun at first, then the GRINDING dude. I'll save you some frustration and a few bucks: you will make progress for 3-5 "blocks", then you will get stuck with an enemy that is way too strong. You will go back to the world map and grind your buns off gathering exp and upgrading various structures for 3-36 hours until you can level up enough to beat the guy you're stuck at. Repeat for life I guess. If you are open to spending a LOT of money, I think this game could be fun.

You won't get very far without pulling out your wallet. Like other freemium cash grabs you eventually hit a wall where you have to make a choice. Either pay for content or continuously lose. Thankfully this "game" presents that decision fairly harshly about 30 minutes into gameplay. There's no question if leveling something would help. No, you have to spend money to continue to clear levels. That alone is why this "game" deserves one star. Other than that it's mildly entertaining at best.

You don't really play stages with only soldiers clearing out paths as depicted in the ads. You do play a version of that which requires you to earn/buy heros and they drive the squad forward. So, in short, the ads claiming the game devs created a game based on fake ads are themselves misleading. It was a little fun to start but it gets boring quickly unless you start spending money. It's a game that tries too hard to be many things but ends up being none. I wish there's a version like the ads.

Very difficult to make progress without spending money. I bought a few basic packs to speed things up. One week ago, I was looking at a pack, went to payment page but didn't buy it. Came back a few hours later and $21+ was deducted from Google Play account. I thought it was a glitch. So, I went back to that page. They deducted same amount again. $2.12 left on my account. I wonder if they kept stealing my money every time I was looking at that pack... Useless Customer Service. Filthy thieves...

Actual game play is quite fun. But the game very quickly turns into a grind fest. Oh you want to play? Just wait 2 hours to upgrade this building first. Cause of course this is a base building game in disguise. And of course you can skip the wait for actual money. If i have a few minutes to kill i should be able to play. Not inn 2 hours because i have to upgrade a base to spend my earned points. This just feels like a chore.

Game play loop is too short for what it is; a lot of bloat added wherein the devs are trying to create a progression system like clash of clans, and it just doesn't work. Just let me mindlessly shoot stuff for a while. The core mechanic works really well, I just can't enjoy it long enough to justify opening the game before I get this lame "story". You could still leave that in, just make the levels longer and you've got yourself a pretty decent game.

The gameplay shown in the ads is only a small part. In reality, this is a game in which you build a base, and the ads only show minigames. Most of the time is spent doing necessary building, which is just click-this click-that and wait. The publisher responds to other reviewers that they will take the feedback into consideration, but in reality, they won't.

As a longtime player, I can say that the newest ad where the soldier is shooting from inside a compound has absolutely nothing to do with the game. The old ad was at least a periodic mini game within regular game play (though it's not fun and is my last favorite part of the game). The newest ad is a COMPLETE LIE. The game is still worth playing, but it's not what you're seeing in the new ad. I have played for several seasons, and I'm disappointed in the dishonesty.

Doesn't really even play like a game. Just a repetitive idle clicker as you can rarely ever lose. I've been playing this for about an hour, so if I haven't gotten through the tutorial levels still, then I'd wonder when does it end? I just want a simple arcade-type game like this, but without the constant micro transaction bs and ads galore... What has happened to mobile gaming is just sad at this point... Response: I appreciate the response, but I could never find these other game types...

Fun for the first few days, but then you only get to play the levels like in the ads every few days, then less and less, as you need to keep upgrading your 'base'. For a game that purports itself as being exactly like the ad, it's not really. EDIT: developer responded saying yes the game play is different to the ad. Which is fine, except its billed as being '100% like the ad'. Don't waste your time.

The game is 50% scam. It kind of has gameplay like in the photos and YouTube ads, but only very briefly, and it's such a small and temporary part of the game. The real game is about base building. Please bring back some of the advertised portions of the games, maybe to another campaign mode or to a zombie hunting mode and I'll revisit my opinion. But as the game sits, the advertising isn't completely honest **EDIT, I will add 2 extra stars since they added a new game mode that is more honest

Game that is somewhat fun, different than ads, and has whales that spend a lot of money so they can bully you (destroy your base). You really have to like building a base and the grind (building upgrades take longer and longer the better you get). There are a lot of people that spend a lot of money on the game, and they can just destroy you in the game. Also lots of bugs(like spending in game free gems and not getting items as well as from fight zombies). Customer support non-existent.

it's overall a pretty solid game. the lack of ads is very much appreciated!! it makes it a pretty enjoyable experience. however, I wish the wait times to play more of the soldier levels were lower. 18 hours feels like a very long time, and maybe 2-4 would be more appropriate. I'm also saddened at the clear use of ai for many of the character assets :( I understand animation and art are expensive, but the game would be so much prettier if it had real art, even if it was in a simpler style than ai

The battles aren't bad, a quick little time killer that can be fun. But the base building is over done, by far. I didn't take the time to read anything because I thought the game was a simple rail battle. So I'm building and upgrading simply to get to the next battle, clicking as fast as I can. But, the battles can be fun.

So, there's a daily task to perform an in game purchase. Need I say more? This has to be the most aggressively monetized game I've played. Buy the monthly pass, pay for VIP ranks, pay to build more than one thing at a time, etc. It's ludicrous. I'm fine with in app purchases on some levels, but just wow. Super pay to win.

It's crazy that the ads for this game are all about how "It's actually what's advertised!" when it is in fact, not what is advertised. The ads show a simple fun looking game. This game is about building a base and working with your team on an overworld map. When you do actually do the battles advertised, they suck. You play with hero units, not a giant army. There's some army growing stuff, but it is NOT as advertised. If you want to press a bunch of meaningless rewards, go ahead and install.

Had fun in the first few hours, then got invaded 11 times in 3 hours that I went working. The game has "Tencent micro-transaction formula" written all over it. Want faster building? One click to spend xx dollars for that. Want instant revenge? One-click to spend another $9.99 on instant resource or something. Sorry but I fell for this type of micro-transaction black hole 10 years ago and never again. The game is advertised as an "endless runner" but in reality is more of a base management game

Bait and switch. It's marketed as a fun, arcade style, side scroller. It's actually a base building game. Collect the resources... just like Farmville. Click. Click. Click. Collect all the resources on your tile map. You do a few of the fun scrolling battles and then have to wait. I've been collecting resources for a week and haven't gotten to play the actual war part. Then other people start attacking you and you have to rebuild. Pay money and you can advance though... waste of time.

2.5 out of 5 stars. Lots of possibilities, but overrun with pay walls. You can play it for a while and have fun. But you will eventually run out of ways to do much of anything without paying money. After about lvl 10 the many different avenues of game play grind to a halt, and the "pay $X to speed this up." options overtake the game. You can still play, for sure. But you have to wait hours or even days to build things or collect resources just to play a few minutes. Then it's hour/days again.

It's a good game at first, but I had issues after level 15. I was not able to receive the alliance gifts into my inventory. I tried contacting their support for a full week and did not receive any responses all. removed uo, reinstall, linked account to email and still the problem persisted. Also, this app is really good at selling upgraded so be ready to spend money if you want to advance. I do not recommend this game based on my experience.

Game's not as advertised. Ads represent small%of what game consists of. You'll need to spend at least 1k to compete with the "whales." Why? Leveling up power wise is the crux of the game. Level 1 to 30. In order to increase your level, you must first increase the levels of other items on your base. These items can take several weeks to upgrade before you can advance to a higher level. There is an option to pay for things to upgrade items called speed ups&or diamonds. Discord&world chat TOXIC!

I tried this game after I saw multiple ads claiming its gameplay is "100% like the ads" and that it is not fake. After trying it, I can say it's 100% NOT like the ads. It's not a shooting game but a city building game that incorporates the shooting missions that we see in the ads, but they're maybe 5% of the actual gameplay. It's a shame the developers are spending so much money on paying random people to claim that it's "the real deal" when it obviously isn't. False advertising at its finest.

Basically a very close copy of "Fleet Command", if you know that game. Has a lot of the same elements and mechanics. Just with a few differences and a greater variety of tasks, which is refreshing. Overall fun for a while, but comes with pros and cons and gets time consuming after Lv10. Expect a complex base building and leveling game, where you create a military command with heros to fight in various tasks and events in an alliance of fellow players.

Falsely advertised. This is not the game that's in the ads. It's just another build, spend, fight alliances game like a million others. The bits of the game that even remotely look like the ad are mostly automated and have very little input from the player. If you like city builder games, it's got lots to offer there, but it's certainly not what's advertised

Horrible game. I bought some packs that included gems and exp points to level up the heros. Well, I got the gems but not the important exp points. You can't find anything in the game for support. Had the play store refund the purchase. Upon doing that, the gems were returned. That part is fine since I received my money back due to not getting what was advertised. The game then restricted access to the game unless I remade the purchase that failed to deliver 100% of the items advertised. 0 stars

The early game is fun, but at some point you have to join an alliance, mostly to keep high level players from sacking your city without a shield, but also to get the resources you need to upgrade. Once you do join, it's kind of a daily grind in multiplayer, your alliance vs another, vs another server. I ended up quitting at level 20 because I don't want to pay, and the times to build and research were taking actual days to finish. It was a second job, having to login every day to keep up.

It was fun for 2 days. Aparently, the game is not like the video ad. Only 20% of the game is like that. You have to complete mission upgrade buildings and different other stuff that have a timer on. That's not why i downloaded the game. I want to play and enjoy the game like the ad you showed me. Stop trickling people into downloading a game that is nothing like the advertisement. You need to pay a lot of money to progress.

Ok graphics. Starts the game as advertised, with soldiers running on a road killing zombie. The phase is just like any other building games + heroes. Wait or pay for building completion. Nothing really new with this game. I have seem thousands of such games. Stay away from this game unless you really like the theme, not bother spending a lot of time not-progressing and spending real money.

Don't be fooled. It's a base expansion game with the shooting scroller as a side part. You can't even replay the shooting levels. The base expansion doesn't tie INTO the shooting scrolling aspect. Level 40 is glitched. The YT videos have them falling like flies, but the zombies have much, much, much more health. There's also twice as many in game, than as depicted in the YT videos. Just play until level 40. Dont spend money. It doesn't boost the part they advertise.

Like others, I enjoyed the game at first. Soon though,it became apparent that in order to advance a bit quicker than a glacier, this is certainly a PTW game. What's worse is quitting the game for the night, then waking up to find your base in flames from being attacked by a stronger player in a different time zone. Happened to me in "Warpath", so this lesson cost me a lot less to learn. I immediately uninstalled it.

This is your typical pay 2 win game. F2P won't have a chance. The base building is a grind, and doesn't matter, since there's no level restrictions on who can hit you. When you have someone with a level 20 base hitting a level 10 base 4 times in a row with no break, burning down everything you built it takes all the fun out of the game. Everything in the game is based around getting you to spend money. You see it from the very beginning. Could be a great fun game, but it's not currently.

TLDR: Chatting on Android is broken and it's designed to make you spend money, chances are you'll abandon this game before getting to level 25! Interesting at first but as soon as you get to level 15 everything changes for the worst. Spend a little money and it gets slightly better but then the same thing! At this point it's basically do something wait a day do something wait a couple days. It's designed to make you spend money not keep you in the game, $100 ads upon login is a bit much.

As others said, the advertised gameplay is just a tiny portion of the game, so if you're here for that you'll be disappointed. It's primarily a war game between player alliances and city building. Sometimes items you buy for events are expired while the event is still active (referring to a recent music event and their "solution" was pretty bad). In game customer service is slower than a glacier

Only worthy of 2 hours of gameplay. There's a "build queue" you can buy, but in reality it's one more builder, pretty cheap at around 1.25us, but if you want a third one that handsome fellow is 10us, this is the most blatant false advertisement I've ever seen, from the prices to the misleading names of objects. The idea of city building is a time scam meant to ruin what could've been a fun game. After 25 lvls of "zombie running" there is a pay wall that would take a week of upgrading to pass...

Starts off as a fun little battle game then dwindles down to nothing more than a build your own little village game pretty quickly with none of the games that drew you in left to play. Most people I've talked to can only reach level 42, including myself, then it's unbeatable, no moving on, you're stuck at that point. The Youtube tutorial is inaccurate to the actual game and it is unpassable for everyone after that point and gets boring pretty quickly.

Every other review is telling the truth. Its a bad cashgrab type game using AI created images as bases for all character portraits. You will not succeed if you don't pay money, because the gameplay after the tutorial phase is just a contest of who has the bigger wallet. On top of all of that, there are misleading "deals" which prompt you to buy things that you ultimately didn't want, such as the "builder queue pack" which does not grant a new build queue slot but instead gives a booster unit.

This isn't the game in the ads. It's a city builder. No thanks. Edit to respond to devs: No, you didn't show just a part. Where in the ads you walk around shooting zombies close to you, in the game you stand in a single unmoving area, can only slide your character left and right, while a couple of columns of zombies come at you. That's like going to a buffet and being told all they have is warm milk to serve.

Boring waste of time. Ads are extremely misleading, and constitute about 1% of how you will be spending your time. This game is essentially a glorified version of cookie clicker, except with multiplayer elements, where the role of the non paying player is to be trounced by those who are dropping 1000's of dollars on the game. In addition, they violate Google's policy of not asking for 5 star reviews by popping up a window titled "5 Star Review" while asking you to review the game. Do not play.

Not the lane shooter it says it is. That exists, but is a tiny portion of another of a million Base-builder "wait hours for things to build or else spend money" games that exist right now. Hits basically every stereotype. Lane runner takes no thinking at all and basically plays itself, and either your troops are strong enough or they aren't. If not, grind or spend money. Could be really fun, but it leans so hard into the pay-to-win thing that it's probably not worth your time.

They will call you "Commander" and apologize. I wanted to play the left/right multiplier game in the ad. You get to do that RARELY. Most of what you do is collect "Heros" and upgrade buildings. After about 15 minutes of building your pase, you get entered into a multiplayer world where pay to win is the expectation. It's a beautiful expression of addiction mechanics in action. But it is not a good use of time. I am NOT a "Commander", Rivergame.

Just your standard boring base builder with some run and gun elements. Don't let the commercials fool you. What they show there is not the main part of the game. You'll spend the majority of your time building a bad base, and waiting for timers. Just more of the same. There are much, MUCH better run and gun games than this. And you don't even have to wait for timers or build horrible bases in those. I'm so tired of misleading ads. This one is absolutely egregious.

The game is built for clans (called alliances). It's a zombie survival theme game with all elements going and leaning towards alliances. The content that is shown in the ads is behind near impossible levels. And even then you won't really see the same game. Also, if you download this game for only to play the part you see in the ads, be prepared for way too many other elements. Been playing for about 2 years. None of the pictures I've seen once and I'm a pretty high level in the game.

Starts great but a few hours in and your wasting your life waiting. Progress stops unless you wait. Don't waste your time. Edit: it is clear this is a pay-to-play (eventually game) and I support that, but what will pull in more customers is if the pay-to-play stuff is still a hard grind (a choice: pay to save time or hard grind). People (like myself) will eventually pay to play to save time not because it is the only choice.

More like evonyy, less like the ads. I like the concept but the servers are full of people who will destroy your base while you are sleeping. So all your efforts get destroyed overnight, even if you paid to make the advances. Not the game I was wanting out of this. Wish it was more just like the ads. Not a casual play game. More a life consuming game.

Quickly devolves into a freemium model, and the gameplay becomes a grind... Not what I was looking for, the first few battles are accurate, but then after they get you, they make it a world building game and a time waster, I get that the developers need to make $$, but I feel scammed. Like I said the first few battles are just like the depiction, but then after they hook you, they turn it into a game, where you have to build your world. I just sank hours into this game. And I didn't realize it.

A great way to waste your money and time. Like most mobile games, they just force you to tap your screen to make you feel like you're accomplishing something or doing something worthwhile. It says a lot that the name of the game is featured in brackets [Last War] as if they have taken a template for a simple game and attached a new name to it. Immediately they invite you to pay money in order to make "progress" in building your camp and actually name as initial purchase because they expect more.

Two huge problems for me: 1) I don't WANT to be in an alliance, and I want to be left alone. I downloaded this game for a solo shoot/basebuild game. Unfortunately there is no way to avoid being scouted or attacked by other players. I HATE PvP games online. 2) The game is boring. The entire draw of the game for me was to be able to shoot. Unfortunately I'm almost all base building now @Lvl22, there's very little action. I'm a veteran of 4x games, but this is practically all farming and boring.

This is a classic gotcha game. You make "alot" of progress at the start, then it becomes a nightmare of waiting hours and hours, days and days. This is a core mechanic of the game, the developer will never change this. This is also a exact copy paste of other games just like this. It's plagued with microtransactions, every step you take it'll ask for money. It's insane. This game is good for the first few hours, then drastically becomes worse. Cash grab off fake ads. Queue the default response.

Typical, pay to progress and conduct meaningless tasks to build a town. Complete opposite of the advertisement. This is probably the best version, as some of the mini games somewhat resemble the advertisement. That's not a redeeming aspect, but it's the reason for the second star. No puzzles, compelling storyline, or outstanding graphics. Just a completely meaningless waste of time and money, which could become very expensive, very quickly. Just avoid this and all games like it.

Pay to win kind of game. Strong community but would need to ultimately spend to compete. If you like being passive and following orders from others, this is the game for you. Game support is good, relatively polished, game mechanics are mostly good. Geared towards paying players, there's a pyramid, the more powerful you are the more you get, meaning the more you need to pay to stay in those arenas.

Great game, but it's exclusively a paid to win game. If you're not spending money, then the game puts you in a very unfair advantage. As a free to play player, you do not have access to top tier characters. The premium service that they sell also puts players at a significant advantage. Don't bother playing if you're not going to spend money. The developers needs to balance the game for the free to play player.

Pay to Win survival game Every single feature such as buildings, training troops, powering up heroes to name just a few all have a pay to speed up feature. There is nothing in this game that cannot be bypassed by tossing some money at it. The advertisement doesn't even mention any player vs player content. Your base can be assaulted when you're offline. Oh but hey, you can pay for some limited protection so atleast there's that. If you don't mind paying, you will enjoy this game.

Fun at first.... Then it becomes all but useless to play unless you want to spend hours "building a base" to upgrade troops and "heroes". I haven't found a simple game like the ad shows. I was looking to kill time here and there with this game, not be concerned with troops upgrading and everything else. Certainly not what the ad promotes. This is after a couple months of near daily play, so I gave it a decent chance

Starts out strong but as you progress you have less to do as you run out of resources or in-game currency. Only by buying stuff can you progress further. Was stuck unable to play for a few days waiting to gather resources to play just one level. After the developers reached out, I will edit my review. Rather than address my issue about the game grinding to a halt at a certain level, they said to participate in events and activities to progress. They fail to realize that I was doing that as well.

Despite the advertisements for this game promoting it as "the real game shown in the ads", its core gameplay is not how the game is presented. I have played for around an hour now, and the main mechanic here is base building. True, the "horde wave" gameplay is present, but it's only used as a mini game to clear more space to build your base. As others have said, there is a very clear pay to win system here. The game itself is alright if you enjoy base builders, but it is not as advertised.

Just not what you thought you downloaded. We downloaded it to play what we see in the ad. I put about 8 hours in and still haven't seen what we see in the ad. It's like an off brand clash of clans. It's kinda cool at first but then you get time gated when you finally run out of all the currency they give you. At that point your stuck and can't even play anymore. Waste of time, can't be that hard to make the ad.

Has a lot of rules of engagement that involve hidden data that you need a crystal ball to find. If you don't, you face serious negative consequences to your game play due to clickish attitudes amongst players. Also, if you try to purchase bundles, you'll frequently get an error message and can't make the purchase. Finally, there are advertisements all over the net, with actors claiming that game play is identical to the advertising vid. THIS IS FALSE.

I keep getting attacked in a row, no idea what to do. nothing to click to defend myself. I patiently waited to collect everything that I need to progress and now some player is killing all my troops and I have no idea what to do? also I installed the game to play the obstacle track, which there is really little of. you basically just have to log on regularly, collect resources and wait for buildings to be built. also the rock track was super boring. I only did it to remove the red dot.

Koreans claim to get 50% off everything in game compared to their counterparts. The game is pay to win and they don't have to pay as much making it extremely imbalanced. They cry racist if you point this out. The game is not like the ads. Its a base expansion game where to collect resourses and have to fight eachother to get ahead. This would be ok if it was a fair fight. The red and blue tiles puzzles is a very small portion of the game. Its a mini game you play a few times.

Warning ⚠️ if you want spend A LOT of MONEY and have a moderately fun time then this is the game for you! You would think that for how much money they make with all the in game purchases, they would have a game that ran smoothly. Think again, this game is nothing but bug after bug. Lag on high traffic times. Finally don't expect customer service to do anything to help you out if your game is glitchy, that is if you're able to even get them to respond to your request. Consider yourselves warned!

This game was fun until someone came along and conquered my base without any provocation from me. I wasn't even playing at the time. I had stuff building, which takes a 1-3 hours at the level I was at, and I don't want to waste money or resources to hurry things along. I've got time. You already have to pay small amounts to get by, which was a pain enough but one I was willing to tolerate. Until I come back to find base gone, stuff stolen, pay game to restore me. No f***ing way. Canceled acct.

Absolute scam game. First of all they advertise it as simple game where you go thro levels and kill zombies. Then you get sort of mini games with killing zombies, but it is just fraction of time and after you reach higher levels, it is just grinding. You have to pay a lot of money to be good. Horrible game!!!! I'm sick and tired of games that show a completely different game in its ad than what it is!!! This game is a rip-off. You can't progress in it because higher lvl players treat you as a farming tool than actually farming locations on the map. This game is a "build your base up" type of game. Not what they show any of their ads. There is very minimal game play like they show in their ad.

It's Pay To Win. It's a fun game with cool players and different types of play, air, land, fire, defense. The characters are cool looking and fun to play, but I've been stuck on a battle for over 2 weeks. Every time I lose at that battle it recommends I buy an upgrade. That makes the game unplayable and unfun. I honestly would spend money on the game if they didn't force you too, but they ruined it for me. It was fun too. So sad.

Bottom line, this is a strategy game. My problem is that the strategy part is not advertised. I downloaded this for the shooting portion. At the beginning, u get to play a good chunk of it, but it quickly becomes a wait and see game if you don't want to spend money. On another note, thought I might used this to get into strategy game but I hardly could find anything about the basics of it. Edit: giving it one star. Advertised part becomes quite scarce as one proceeds through game

So the aspect of the game that's advertised, the one that they're screaming from the mountaintop, functionally disappears after 2-3 days of play. From there, it's a painfully slow level-up game (to unlock another handful of simple math levels that fall over, then back to the grind), or an outrageous money sink. $25 per month for the most basic in-game advantage package?? Are you guys actually out of your minds??? Predatory, manipulative, and worst of all, boring. Do 👏 not 👏download👏

It takes a few days to realize you aren't actually doing anything in this "game." Click click click. Pay to play. Never stood a chance against big spenders. Then when you accidently purchase something and request a refund, they force you to purchase the same amount of the refund in "credit score points or you are blocked forever. I really don't mind to pay some money, but the war games the way they designed, they shd provide better server with better connection. Instead of, I've been keeping dropped from the game so frequently, especially when I was at war, after reconnecting, my base already on fire. I'm changing my review. First review was a low score due to getting stuck waiting for days for your camp to produce enough resources to level up, just to play 2 or 3 levels. But now,after giving it a couple of days to build up, when I opened the game, I had hardly any resources at all because my camp was destroyed and looted. A camp... or town, that with its level up system and days of waiting for not only nothing, but to lose, is the worst part of the game. Uninstalling this pile garbage.

Buggy, lack of explaination, sudden turn off of shield. No where to read up on anything related to the game, a fire that wasn't expained etc. The only text is the "pack" that rich people can buy. It is more like an insurance product than a game. Starting minigame is just a hook, behind it is just a normal RTS game in the middle of the ocean, where big whale see who can throw more money

The game is entertaining, but be prepared to spend A LOT of money if you want to do ANYTHING in the game and actual progress. Some games are pay to win , but its also a pay to progress, have fun and get anywhere. Its fun at first building up your squad ,but then it hits a point where you either wait 2 days for things to be upgraded or play for 4 weeks to get enough material to build up one character. if you really want to progress they sell OP characters for 27.99. wish I never started

I've logged over 200 days (184 consecutively) playing this game. the advertised part of the game, shooting zombie hordes is the smallest part of this game. You quickly reach a point where a NEW zombie shooter event "as advertised" is only available on one day a week. The rest of the game is base building, resource gathering, skirmish games, and ways of pay to win at every turn. For a long time I played thinking I needed to reach a certain level to access more of whats advertised. Never happened.

Just another Game of War. If the multiplayer aspect were cut out, it'd be decent game, but it's the same ol, 'build your base up so some whale can come in and flatten you.’ the ads show nothing of that side. For the simple scroller game mechanic seen in the ads, each lvl is maybe 15 seconds and they're a busy mess lol. Just stinks every game has to be Game of War part deux somehow.

Another build a castle/fort/town garbage game. All I want is the gameplay advertised. There's some very short levels of what is advertised and then you have to build your fort and farms and whatever else before you can play more levels. I don't want to build a town or a farm, or join a guild. I don't want any social interaction with other. I want to move an army down a path with upgrades and downgrades to unlock or avoid, like what is advertised. Don't waste your time with this garbage.

The game is not as advertised. there is a small segment that has something similar to the game shown in the thumbnail and ads, but that is roughly 5% of the game and the rest is pay to win. The Last War AI will respond to my comment saying something like. . . "explore more of the game, the mini-game shown is in special ops" . . or, something similar, but it's bull. it's a very limited mini game that doesn't even match the game displayed in the advertisements and thumbnails. do not download

I was pulled into the game with the adventure gameplay ads. The game is more than that. The game is simple with many layers of complexity related to the items, events, PvP and PvE battles.. The system will make you feel like buying in-game items with real money is the solution to your frustrations. After playing it for 3 weeks, I'm done with it. Mainly the whales in the game keeps picking on me as a noob who don't know how to play it. I don't recommend this game to anyone.

After giving it some thought, this game is only worthy of a 2-star rating. First of all, this game wasn't exactly advertised just as most other games are. This is not a simple and easy game as it escalates in difficulty after a few levels. I believe the levels are glitched to be impossible to beat. I purchased a game pass hoping it would make the game more enjoyable, but even with over $30 spent, it didn't improve the game. I hope I get my refund.

This is a game designed to annoy you in order to sell you stuff. The majority of the game is grinding out resource gathering and leveling up buildings to gain access to the part of the game that is advertised. Because the grinding takes awile, the devs hope you'll be inclined to purchase various power ups to speed along that process. In short, the game is total garbage, a scam, a rip off, misleading advertising, and just not fun.

Pay to play. It takes longer and longer as you progress, by level 5 or 6 it gets tedious. By level 8 HQ you're getting raided non stop by higher levels that spend a lot of money. You get crushed, you can't progress, it's no longer fun. Unisintall. I'll bet half of all users uninstall the games within 5 days. This is the business model now, minimum 20 dollars a month or get constantly killed.

Not like the ads, ironically. Sure, there is part of the game that does. But most of the game is your standard "You have to build this, recruit these heroes, Join this guild etc. etc". It's just like all the other games that claim they are something they aren't. I ended up uninstalling it. I'm tired of those kinds of games. They're all cookie cutter games offering the same thing and wanting your $$ for item packages you don't really need. It's kind of sad and disappointing.

Positive side, it's well done, fun to play for the first few days... That's it. Negative side... Takes way to long to advance in the game. Unless you spend money of course 🙄. And you have to spend alot if you don't want to get stuck. In a few weeks you'll have probably spent enough that you could have bought your self a way more fun game on your favorite console instead. Almost gave a two stars, but I felt generous, so gave a three stars.

Played this for a few months. Made it to level 27 (game maxes at level 30 and it takes more and more time to level up), and was part of a top alliance. The meta is simple - pay. Game is completely p2w at the top level, which was why I left. You can pay for pretty much anything or face endless timers. No way to compete. There's almost constant small little events you have to attend to get the paltry free resources which are the only way you can have some sort of edge over the other f2p players.

Game is not at all like how it advertises itself but I honestly enjoyed it.. until I refunded an accidental purchase and they locked me out of my account. There is a "credit score" system, where if you receive packs or anything from your purchase and refund said purchase, you MUST pay back the same amount as what you refunded since they are seemingly incapable of removing whatever you received from your account. An absolutely ridiculous system and I refuse to support them any longer.

Not as advertised, if you like mobile RTS games you will probably like this one. With that, the map is way over crowded, I would enjoy it more if I could just play without dealing with my base getting attacked. So once I reach a point where I can not store enough resources to upgrade due to getting raided by much higher level players, then I will be deleting this game. Also, the cost of base protection is way too high, so it makes it not worth even considering as an option just to play.

great graphics! excellent in action game play! then you go to sleep, everything you spent time learning to do and building is ripped away by other players, not zombies. if you are an adult with responsibilities, it takes too long to rebuild. If you are an 8 year old, have at it! if you have tons of money you can throw away on an app, you will be happy too.

Don't start this game unless you want to pay thousands of dollars to keep playing. The game is highly interactive but there is really no story or purpose or end... you just keep playing until you dont want to invest any more money into it. There is no end to upgrading anything as well. Too many moving parts- I found myself more exhausted than enjoying the game. I've slowed down a lot and i have also stopped spending money. Its also really buggy, especially the survivor section.

Be very careful about this game. It is predatory and uses many tactics of gambling to keep people on the hook and spending. At some moment the game will look like a second job: doing *daily* tasks at *specific* times or your progress will be too slow. A lot of the events feel like in-game appointments... If you haven't installed it yet, better choose a different game to spend your time.

Edit: the new ad specifically mentions it is the game shown rather than something different ...but it isn't. This should be illegal. It's not like on the screenshots, it's a base builder.
