Standard Tencent strategy, it's the same with Evony. In many other businesses, this would be labeled as misleading.

I always wait a while before reviewing any game. This game is completely pay to win. EDIT: Pay to win isn't the right way of stating it. Pay to play is more accurate. If you're good at this game, making progress can come to a fast hult as everything you do after can take days. You need to be at a certain level to make progress with a stage. To get to this level you need to upgrade a certain building that depends on other buildings. These buildings can take hours to upgrade.

The gameplay is not like the ads. You only get to play the ad gameplay every dozen levels and the rest of the gameplay is closer to clash of clans. You need to pay to get the most out of the gameplay. If you don't purchase items, characters, gold, ect you will be outpassed by all the other players in the lobby and eventually need to reset because you are just a resource farm for high level players.

Cash grab..it has potential but basically it continuously ask you for money in order to progress. If you don't spend money on it then your experience it's basically doing 1000 all identical side missions over and over again. UPDATE: it got worse. I'm at a point where you can play only for a few minutes a day(less than 5) because the supposedly free game currency became so expensive that is impossible to gather and play for more than 5 minutes without having to pay real money. Deleting the game.

The part of the game that's being advertised is only a small and negligible aspect. For the majority of the time, this game is about logging-in a few times per day to grind resources and complete tasks by tapping on various icons. Every now and then, your base gets raided from players who've spent hundreds of dollars to pay-to-win. And if you think you can do the same, be alarmed that the increase in your strength can only be unlocked through gacha mechanics. Overall, a miserable experience.

Oh goodie, another Pay to Pay game. Otherwise known as a Pay to Survive. It is NOT Free to Play. It is free to play the tutorial phase. The tutorial phase only. Not even close after that. Invariably you (the whole server) will run up against not less than 1 "Whale" that appears in one of three forms. A simple cheater, a Dev sponsored team, or a Dev bot team. All of them identifiable by adding up how much a regular player would have to spend in order to have the stuff they do. And once yo

Pay to win, or P2W in short, game with close to no tactics. It's a numbers game that favors those who are prepared to use money on the game. The mandatory PVP makes the game a pain to play and clans and players can just bumrush you and destroy your base in a matter of minutes. Nothing new, nothing great. The only thing I like is the GUI and the art style. Other than that I'd advice for you to not waste time and money on this game. Also, not quite like the ads you've seen so clickbait ads aswell.

I was excited when I saw that it was actually the game that so many apps had falsely advertised themselves to be. the first while is a lot of fun, but in a single day you get to a point where you can't move forward without upgrading buildings. You can upgrade one at a time, you might needs 3 or more upgrades before being allowed to make progress again, and the builds take half an hour, prolly more later on. They do this because they want you to pay for convenience. This is just another scam.

It's a nice game, but it's set up in a pay to win way. I played for 10 days, and the update times for your base are becoming ridiculous. Everything scales endlessly, there is kinda no point to look forward to, just more grind. The UI is deliberately confusing and overwhelming to achieve the effect that you need to buy stuff. Alliances are also weird, with the top ones dictating what to develop, what to rush, etc. If you are not in one then you get attacked and bullied. Not a great experience.

Can’t Play with Friends + Too Time-Consuming Very disappointed. One of the most basic features in any online game — the ability to switch servers and play with friends — is completely missing here. I only realized too late that I was stuck on a different server from my friends, and there's no way to transfer. Super frustrating. On top of that, the game demands way too much of your time. There are constant events and tasks that make you feel like you have to stay online just to keep up.

Game was initially fun. But after getting established and in an alliance, you find out that it's just a money spending competition. Part of the event tasks are to spend money buying a pack of diamonds. Most of the game requires spending money. There's events daily and resets daily. Ultimately it's who has the most money. I'm talking hundreds daily and even thousands of dollars being wasted here. The fun is immediately destroyed at that point. Learning the game and mechanics does nothing for you

Played it nearly F2P for around 3-4 months and while the gameplay can be fun, you'd better be prepared to spend hundreds of real life dollars if you plan on being competitive. There are weekly competitions between servers that amount to "who can spend more of their money", and it can get really toxic when you lose. The most fun part of the game, and the part that is most often advertised, is actually a very small part of the gameplay. Not worth the headache IMO.

another build your base game. Frontline breakthrough missions are stupid hard to the point that they aren't even fun. And lastly, I've seen a lot of money hungry games but this one is the worst! They will put hero's & research centers on your base, but you can't use them unless you pay. Some of the weekly missions are "make a paid purchase." everything in this game will try to get you to spend a lot of money

like many have noted. the game is advertised as a guy shooting down a straight path while collecting upgrades that make it possible to defeat ever more difficult enemies. that idea in and of itself is a great idea. if that was the entire game then it would get 5 stars from me. Unfortunately that is an increasingly small part of the game. yes the entire thing you got the game to do becomes harder and harder to actually do the more you play the game.

Wow! Fun 4 star game the first few days. Then it is downhill fast. It becomes a PvP pay to play very fast. It also slows way down after a few levels. And some of the fun features in the advertising completely disappeared. Then our server wasn't ponying up enough cash, so they threatened to shut us down if we couldn't compete with other servers.

I liked the game even though it doesn't match the ads, got up to base level 20 or 21 and decided to call it quits. I've requested to delete my account 2 weeks ago and it continues to be "under review". The in-game chat is managed by AI and my message on Discord was ignored. Hopefully I'll get a response through here. But to reemphasize to anyone reading this - the game was fun (to me) but it does NOT match the ads. EDIT: Bumping down from 2 to 1 star. Terrible/non-existent customer service.

This game is awful- made by the creators of Top War which received a 2.7. This game demonstrates their lack of ability to do this. I was looking for a game as simple and bland as solitaire, which is the only reason I keep it. This game will also fall to about 2.7 or lower. Same graphics as Top War with a much less creative style of play. Just horrible. They said, "How can we create a game to get their money which doesn't require much from us?" They made this.

This game isn't what it looks from the ads. Sure, there is SOME of that 'Temple Run' thing, but it is mostly a mini game series within a base-building Civilisation-type game that forces you to buy certain things (e.g. you get spammed to buy the hero Kimberley at the start for slightly over a dollar). Even if you try to ignore the base-building, the game disallows you from replaying the 'Temple Run' missions, and instead forces you to build your base if you want to play more. Disingenuous Tencent

You probably came here from a fake YouTube cringe ad. Don't install the game, it's a well-engineered money grab. 100% pay to win. As you level up there will be "updates" rolling out with "new heroes" and "new features", engineered to nudge you into buying limited edition packs to get them and stay relevant. New accounts are added to new servers, so that it seems like most players are at your level, which further enhances the pay to win tactics. A lot of well-thought money grabbing. !STAY AWAY!

Not as it appears. Once base completed there wasn't much to do except build and that will take days! A update came "alliance duel" U fight different servers. 5days an every day is a different type of activity you could say, End of dual you attack the alliances. BUT there are certain things you need for each activity and need to save for those days and well after a few weeks you can't seem to have enough so you buy... alot. It's a very EXPENSIVE GAME. You will need Deep Pockets to keep up!!

If you like the ad and game screenshots in "about" section, you have to know - that's a deception. It's not a run and gun game. Just only little part of it. That's a boring kinda strategic town-planning simulator. Most time you have to build up and look after your fortress. Soon after the beginning you're gonna discover here you go big online multiplayer interactive world and there is no way keep out and play offline by your own

***PLAYER BEWARE!!!*** Another pay to advance game. Game gives you a decent amount of time to play free. Once you hit a certain level, everything becomes impossible. You cannot advance with dumping ungodly amounts of money into it. Not only pay to play but their prices are ridiculous. Company could probably make a few bucks and lots of people would be happy and enjoy. But... once again... GREED!!!! Sad, could've been a great game. Response to developer... Nice computer generated response. Cute!

Was looking for a different type of game. Last War seemed interesting. I appreciated the quirky art style, the steady pace of the game and the developer's approach to keep me engaged. Been playing for a week - reached Lvl7. Today, my base was hit by a Lvl14 player twelve times. My troops were obliterated. It's unfortunate that stronger players see weaker/new players as easy targers. I'm not keen to start again. This has been a proper waste of my time. I have deleted my account.

This game sells itself as a scrolling shooter and that's like 1% of the game. It's mostly a fortress builder RTS type game. Which itself is one of the better ones I've played, just not what's advertised. I've been playing it for a good while now and have started to lose interest. Put it down for a couple days and just came back to find they've stuck ad rolls before some tasks. Unacceptable. It's already a pay to win game, don't do adds too. Fun while it lasted but I think I'm done.

Gameplay doesn't match advertisements/not what was expected. Edit: gameplay featured in the ads is only 2% of the game. This is a bad thing because that's the only enjoyable aspect of this game and you're time-gated from actually playing the fun part of the game. Suggestion: make the "Special Ops" mode a separate stand-alone game (or are devs too cowardly to do it?).

"real game based off the fake game ads" no it plays very different. Many troops, even as early as level 1, have auto aim that can track the barrels making everything so easy you don't need to touch the screen to win. Also, it's not endless like the ads, your guys don't change as a powerup instead you have an assortment, and each level is WAY too short. a year later: played for 10 min and it has the same problems, plus now it's worse because you're locked into a base building game no one wanted

4 out of 6 screenshots are representative of one small minigame within the game, which the game itself consists of building a base and waiting for timers to wind down, unless of course you want to drop money on it. Then there's the levels themselves which consist mostly of 30-60 seconds of "gameplay". Followed by more waiting for timers, because of course, no forced ads must mean an energy system! Hard pass all around.

Don't spend money in this game, it's all a trap. I learned this from Top War, from which this game is cloned. It's a base building game—not the crowd shooter shown in images and ads—don't trust devs who partake in deception. It will be kind of fun for the first day, and then when you build up a bit, the trap is sprung. Whatever you might have enjoyed early on comes to a halt when you get annihilated by other players and even story content (if you don't start spending money). Don't fall for it.

Watch gameplay on youtube. The pics in playstore are not of this game. That content is right at the beginning you get through all of it in about 2 weeks. it's a basebuilding war game. You fight your server unless your server agrees not to attack one another. Then you fight other servers. You will spend hundreds to thousands of dollars to make it worth it No joke. content repeats every week. Most quit after 3 months. High level upgrades take days to weeks. If you are free to play... run.

If someone just made a paid standalone app with just the content and mechanics shown in the ads forget the other basebuilding aspect. Just pure action, fun first, horde shooting. You would make so much more money selling that at 5 bucks a pop. Have a free version that shows ads every few levels. I hate what gaming has become. Especially mobile gaming. Its like you guys forgot that gaming should be fun and just care about $$$. Look at what the audience wants! I want what i saw on the ads.

Too much pay to play, too much penalty starting all over with troops if you're busy with real life. The game balance is really good in some areas and terrible in other areas. This game is designed for you to be a slave to the game. If you can't respond to things in real time you're penalized too heavily. It's a shame, this could be a 5* game with some of the mechanics they have if they figured out how to not take themselves so damn seriously. It's a game, not a job.

It could be really fun but it's monetization is insane. You get package on every 2 screens. 150$ for a bundle, 3200% saving! I have no confidence this game will even exist in the next year. Already 6 new UR heroes which are not available through tickets. You need to buy the battle pass and lucky spins to 'maybe' get the heroes. The whole premise of the game is really interesting. The community aspect is fun. It could be a really good game. They need to chill down on the money grabbing.

Another game where you hear ' let's build and improve the shelter get your wallet ready to explore and conquer'. So the ads are just to hook you with the real gameplay wich is addictive and develop the gamer gambling sides. If you are looking for just a simple fun game like the ad of the game leave you to believe, it's not, because it's all but simple it will make you pay and pay even more if you get hooked with the social side of the game.

I like the game but the cost to move forward is outrageous. Stamina to do anything cost way too much. We should be able to purchase stamina, telports and shields with our gold. not GEMS!! This game needs to implement gifting events . So we can exchange gifts with our teammates. It has potential but its very expensive if you're not free to play. (Which will take years) to upgrade if you are. After playing i have changed my star rating from 5 to a 2 for the reasons above.

I played the game for a while and made some in-app purchases to help development. Waste of money. The game will become frustrating when higher level players come and annihilate your base while you sleep. You can buy shields to protect your base for a period of time, but eventually, they run out. Good graphics, but I would not recommend it.

Glitches & full of pay walls. Initially I thought this was a march shooter instead of a civilization build, but I was wrong. This whole game is just pay walls and excessive ads. *Their suggestion is just more pay walls. If you want to play Farmville with extra steps, then you'll probably enjoy this game. But if you're looking for the game that they advertise, this isn't it.

First of all, this app is product of badvertising. You will able to play what you saw in AD for at least a few times. And after that, game is nothing like that. Every event, everything that is needed, money is a requirement. For free2play players, don't play this game. You'll enjoy just for a week and nothing more. And no, it's not a one-time payment, it's every day or every week. F2P players won't achieve even the lowest achievement of a spender. Not talking about a bit money, but huge amount.

What a joke of a game. Completely Pay2Win, with "packs" starting at $4.99 US and going all the way to $99.99 US. I understand the PVP mechanics but stronger players are allowed to absolutely destroy weaker players, creating a system where you're constantly punished for trying to progress. There is no check system in place to prevent this, so for example, a maxed-out player (Level 30) can destroy a beginner (Level 10) and there are no repercussions. Beginners can do nothing. Trash game!

Unless you're willing to pay, this is literally just a waiting game. You spend the vast majority of your time waiting for sections of your base to be built/upgraded. The game play shown in the ads is few and far between. You'll play a few levels and be stopped by either a boss that you need days worth of collecting xp to beat, or having to wait for your base hq to be upgraded in order to move on to the next 5 and repeat the process again.

Frontline breakthroughs lv 36, 40, 42-48 are extremely difficult to conquer. One would find the game to be bait and switch, because player ends up spending more time on city building instead of shooting barrels. The main disadvantage of the game is there is no way to queue the construction so that there is no down time. Players are easily hooked to pay for in-app add-ons which I have resisted quite well. no more $$$ from me. Last but not least, human players fight each other for resources. Sad!

I played this game for about a month and a half, gave it a real chance right? It was fun at first until they introduced the server vs server war. That's when my alliance decided to start getting "serious" about the game by establishing daily quotas and weekly growth expectations. It stopped being fun and started feeling more like a job than a game. So I said, "heck this noise, I'm out." Gameplay can be fun. But you really have to spend money in order to get anywhere.

I only downloaded this so I can write a review. Your ads that many come across in other games are super predatory. "Oh, look at this. It's so hard. Can you do better." It's clear the "game" played in the ad isn't actually being played. Even someone with no brain can see that. My experience with games that advertise like this is they suck and aren't worth the time, and that seems to be the case here, given many of the 1 star comments saying roughly this.

Nothing but a p2w game and rinse and repeat. Only thing that makes the game good is the other people but after awhile we move on and no longer play this game. You only play the mini games in the beginning after that need to invest some serious $$ to keep up with the heavy hitters. Edit: the only strategy i have seen in this game is to spend tons of money to become a whale and bully others.

It's a pay-to-win game. It's been a year, and I always wanted to pay, but I started the game when I was in a politically sensitive region, so my game version is incomplete. This has been bringing me a lot of issues. The translation isn't accurate, and the censorship is language-based, not meaning-based, so I use Google Translate a lot. I feel very excluded most of the time, so I've never paid, and support said they couldn't help.

This game is all about money, and support is straight garbage. They dont care if you lose anything, they throw some gems at you and call it a day just keep spending your money. The game is buggy and they expect you to deal with it. I don't recommend this game and its definitely not like the ads!! They include a subgame thats garbage to say its like the ads but the actual gameplay is nothing like the ads.

I'm a level 26 player, and this game is 100% pay-to-win. Strategy is minimal—spend hundreds or thousands of dollars, and you win. Free-to-play (FTP) players won’t have fun and will get bullied by big spenders. Buildings, research, and troop training take weeks unless you buy speedups. Essential heroes and gear are locked behind paywalls, making it impossible for FTP players to compete. If you’re not willing to spend big, this game becomes frustrating fast. Not worth the download or even trying.

Very enjoyable at first, but once you've completed the 100 levels around the base, the gameplay changes a lot to where it's more just focused on progression for the sake of progression and resource management, rather than the fun mini games that drew me into the game. The early game is great, but then it just becomes "click on this, click on that" and very little actual levels

Downloaded the game because of how it was advertised. At first, all the levels were as advertised. Like every game of there, that was very limited and quickly ran out. It's all about the "mission" and building the base, and now the battles are all automated. It's all about how strong your units are and the game does the rest.

Stay away. Haven't played this type game in some time and remembered why. This game allows higher level attacks on your base, like others do, but this one has no limits. It allowed 1 account to attack my base 9 times within 2 hours time, eliminating 2mths of growth. I'm an adult that doesn't need this stress so you've just lost any amount of money I would spend. It'll happen to you as well so play something else. You're welcome.

I'm leaving only 2 stars for many different reasons, this game is honestly good for the first hour but then quickly shows all of its cons. I first downloaded the game because of the ads making it look appealing, then I started to see that this game is trying to be like too many other mobile games like Rise of Kingdoms, Top War, and some of those tower defense style games. I feel like this game doesn't even know what style game it is. I would keep going but only allowed 500 letters. 😤

It's a well-designed game, but the ads aren't representative of the gameplay. The game starts as a third-person shooter, but soon switches to a time-consuming grind of upgrading your base over and over. I quit when I received a warning that upgrading my base to level 8 would subject me to pvp attacks. Don't waste my time engaging my attention on building resources that can be looted; that's playing dirty pool.

Not the game you think you're getting. The ads lure you in with a demonstration of a casual game shooting enemies in the road & expanding your troops. The actual game starts out that way, but it quickly becomes a base building competitive War game that requires you to be constantly online training troops, constructing buildings & performing hourly tasks. If you're looking for a game that's like a job, but without getting paid this is the one for you.

Terrible game. Game is hard to gain ground without spending money and impossible after a point. Best part is other players can attack and destroy the things you pay for. Requested money back through play store and got a small partial refund. Now when I open the game it has me locked out saying I can play after I pay back what I got refunded. This should be illegal. Don't recommend playing this game and if you do I don't recommend spending a dime on it.

So the game is nothing like the adds. the ads show a mini game that pops up once a week. The game IS FUN, but it's totally pay to play. if you don't pay, you fall behind and will get slaughtered over and over. the prices are absurd. 5 bucks will get you a pathetic reward. each hero needs to be 5 stars. it takes 5 upgrades per star. each upgrade takes 100 shards. 10 shards costs 5 bucks. do the math. that's only one example. some players are up to $5,000-15,000 spent just to be in the top 10.

Played it for about 1-2 hours. There are a few levels that are like the ads, but my experience was about 5 minutes like the ads, and the other 90% your typical base building/gacha mobile game, that feels exactly like every other base building game. Also the worst for me, there are still the 'run your army forward with math' segments from the ads, except they just... Removed the math. Instead of '+10' or 'x2' you just get some random power up for your hero you pulled from gacha. What's the point

Thinly veiled "gatcha style" pay to win hero collecting garbage. The entire game is built around catering to whales, who will eventually throw a temper tantrum and hold you and the rest of the server hostage if they're not given all of the power and special privileges. Like other reviews have said, the actual shooting zombies part is maybe 2% of the gameplay, but they hide behind it in all of their ads. Save yourself the time and energy, I would give this game 0/5 if that was an option.

I don't know how this has a 4.6 when all the reviews you see are 1 or 2 stars. The game is fun for a few days then it just turns into tedious tasks, and waiting to build things, unless you want to pay. I'm a week in and I can't even play the actual fun part of the game. I'll beat a level, then be too weak to move forward so I have level up every which takes days, and then I'll get strong enough to beat one level and repeat. The leaders are not active in alliance and it's boring and tedious.

Can be a good game to play as a f2p player but can quickly just become repetitive and stale with the same events to accomplish every week, same daily tasks, etc. Played the game for 3 months (got to HQ level 27) and mainly stayed for the people in the alliance which made the game fun. Otherwise it is just a building build and wait game. South Park had it right with "Freemium isn't free". They continually give you ads because they want you to pay. Would not suggest playing this game to a friend.

Super fun and engaging. My issue is with high level alliance leaders. I was "recruited" to the #2 ranked team. I thought that was neat. They pumped me up to feel valued. They encouraged everyone to buy packs. Then they cut people from the team after benefitting (only in game world, I hope). I was cut after spending money on upgrade packs. This seems wrong. Ultimately, this is just a game and I didn't spend an exorbitant mount. Moral of review, if you get "recruited", don't spend money.

Pros: First week is actually fun. Graphics are solid. Vehicles are great toon characterizations. The mini games are fun. Great way to use up 15/20 mins here and there. Cons: P2W. Typical structure that allows continuous toxic assault from higher ranked alliances and players against lower level players. (Please don't mention purchasing an 8 hour shield). Waiting 6+ hours to complete something is not motivating to log in and play. Verdict: Played for a week/Deleted

Misleading people about purchases is a huge no-no for me. Read about what you are about to purchase thrice, that great $5 deal might actually need another $20 to buy all of that loot. Otherwise, the game is 90% nothing like the ads, and I think I'm just about through the honeymoon phase as things are about to slow down unless I spend more money than a couple of bacon wrapped filet mignon per week.

I played for several months and regret it big time 😭. There are lots of reasons to avoid this game, I'll name a few... 1. You must make in app purchases regularly to compete. 2. The game is super buggy. 3. The in game chat is full of vulgarity, profanity, and breeds a culture of bullying. 4. What finally drove me away was a corrupt transaction where the developer actually stole from me (in my opinion)... Charged me 4 times for an in-app purchase I only made once! 😡 Stay away, honestly.

The in app purchases are insanely high priced. I can tell you right now you will be paying a lot of money to play this game. Servers are designed to be extremely competitive in a couple weeks. People become rude and runs of drama starts. If you're okay with those the game is addictive but things slow down a bit as you get further in requiring much now resources to build up levels. Consider yourself warned.

Another MMO RTS. I detest this style of game, and am sick and tired of every company out there hiding them behind ads that look like something else entirely, then responding with, "Well, the ad shows part of the game..." Give me honesty so I don't waste my time with it! You obviously know the actual game won't sell, or you wouldn't be so deceptive about it!

Lackluster This game is advertised as "the game in those fake ads" and they don't live up to that claim. Sure there is an element of the "fake ad" gameplay but it is overshadowed by the fact that this is just another grind-y, level up, base-builder. I have spent the past 3 days stuck on the same level due to the huge difficulty spike to prompt in app purchases. If it was just the "fake ad" gameplay then it would be perfect alas these devs are just predatory and money hungry

Not a game to be played for fun, but rather a product that tries to get as much money out of you as they can until you catch on to the scam. It's seriously so heavily monetized that I cannot imagine anyone on the team who made this was actually trying to make something fun and was instead solely focused on making money. It's a scam that tries to get small amounts of money out of a very wide pond. I don't like trashing things people spent time and effort making but this "game" is an exception.

1. Advertising is deceitful and not representative of the actual game. 2. This is so poorly developed with a huge number of bugs and issues. Prepare for nonstop apologies from the developers and a very frustrating gaming experience. 3. They push you to constantly pay for packs to level up. That's fine but the prices and the fact that the game has nonstop play issues makes it ridiculous to pay them. 4. Just don't bother with this one.

This is a war game with bases, troops, and resources. The game that's advertised to you is just a mini game you can sometimes play within a giant pay to win game. Want to play a game that's not correctly advertised? Want to play a game that costs literal hundreds of dollars to even compete a little bit? How about playing a game that constantly begs you to spend money for over priced items? If the answer to those questions is yes, this is the game for you! Save your time and money. Game is trash.

If you like the ads and the way this game is marketed, find something else. The most basic part of this game is the only reason I wanted to play it. It's a social, idle game to illicit micro transactions. The actual play of the game is poorly designed and the levels scale like garbage. If you want to play another "join a clan, spend your money, and waste your time" game, you might like it.

Completely different as advertised, it's just another basic, mass produced, and cheap survival game. There is a section of the game similar to how it's advertised but after about 10 minutes of playing the game, it gets more difficult to even play this part, the when you do it's short and too in depth for what it is, like the hero system is just straight dumb and to get decent ones you need to do the survival part of the game, but I can't even play anymore because the game can't tell I have wifi.

I have played for a year now. The game is not what the adds show, customer service (if you ever have any issues) respond to you with standard nonsense as if they have no idea about the game. This is a build your base over extremely long time periods , and you have wars , the real winners are the people that end up paying thousands of dollars to get the things you need in the game to become powerful. They keep adding things to the game to charge more money, casual players can't win.

I installed the game because of the ads, it's an entirely false advertisement. That is a minor sidemode that is also incredibally dumbed down. The main game is a afk auto schooter clash of clan esk games with clan battles. Also insanity pay to win. If you think of something you can buy it with real money. It has THREE battlepasses. The audio and translations are also poor and the art ai generated. It is a game where you click (or pay) to make numbers go up. That's it. Just play cookie clicker.

TL;DR Keep your money and time, stay away. Reviews only positive for in-game reward. I'll leave you an honest review. I wanted yo try it and hoped to like it. However, it's a base builder. One of those games that will cost more and more resources and time (or money) to keep playing. One of those games devs who actively don't want you to play their game and use it as a tool to make you annoyed and just pay cash. The positive reviews are just there because you get a special hero for reviewing.

Pay for play to the max. This game is very in your face about their want for your cash. In many cases, it seems near impossible if not impossible to reach goals without pay for play. Every aspect has a way to just buy your way ahead instead of playing. This game earns 1 star for how involved it is. There is a lot happening and plenty here to keep you clicking. At least there aren't ads for other games.

I love the fact that in the playable minigame in the ads for this game, the game cheats you. When you shoot the monster it's health will only drop to like 53 while you keep shooting it and then it kills you. I mean, at least you know up front that the game is rigged before you download and play it, or god forbid pay actual money into the game.

You go through 3 quick levels "like the ads" and then it turns into a classic slow city builder. How incredibly sad for a dev to mask what could be a decent game as a totally different game. Zero indication anywhere in the playstore or ads to what the actual game is. Makes you think how much they even care about their product and probably indicates they don't think their main product is even good enough to compete. I don't use this word often or lightly, but it's truly pathetic.

I want to play the game where you go back and forth with the little men and shoot the other people. I don't want to build a base, pay for upgrades, "upgrade my drill yard" I want to play the game I saw in the instagram ad. There's also no way this game is 4.5 stars they are clearly scammers. Read the actual reviews. Totally boosted by bots.

Absolutely disappointed. Nothing in the ads say anything about world building. The gameplay itself isn't even anything like what the ads show. The app is glitchy and lags causing trouble with shooting mechanics, it forces you to do the world building or you can't play, you've wasted my time. If i could rate lower than 1 star i would. Deleted after 5 minutes of gameplay. Your ad team should be ashamed of itself for deceiving people into downloading this trash game.

Fun game but highly predatory constantly pushes "deals" or "value buys" in your face with no way to turn those things off. It's game with pay to win mechanics that has a free to play option, which makes being able to participate in the events of the game impossible. By the time a free to play player is able to do anything, most of the people they know will have left the game and moved on. Would give less stars if I could

The game starts off really good, then the bugs start happening. There is no support for the game, you cantact them and you get a standard auto reply. When you start moving up in levels items you win or are gifted stop showing up forcing one to pay to advance with the team. Contacted support many times and never got a reply. I am glad it didn't happen once money was invested. I would not recommend this game to anyone.

The ads are just like the game! Not! Basically, it's a base building game with a slightly similar side quest to the ads. Reality its Upgrade units, upgrade base items, complete radar tasks, join a faction, and complete a bunch of daily tasks. It's been done 1,000 times with different face lifts. It's sad that this is what mobile games have become. It's just another cash grab game. 🤮

This seems to be nice game for anyone who likes long-term playing, as I do. However the creators are unfair to players who do not make big in-game purchases. The prices are insane, so to advance quickly costs a fortune. I've been playing for around a year and in crucial moments. where you could get a little advantage over some other players they serve so called "network connection error" which causes a loss of your position in the game. Thank you for explaining. I've got the compensation.

I like this game. It takes awhile to get higher up. Everything about it, more less have to pay your way to build a higher rank unless you have time to wait for things to finish. Can a game not cost so much money?? Overall it's a good game, but anymore you can't buy a game and just play it like it use to be. These days gotta buy your way through it.

Game is all about money. Don't download if you don't want to be stressed. Game is very unfair, you'll get attacked several times by overpowered players like your power is 1m then your attacker is at 20m. Seriously?! Isn't that bullying? And the game is way far from the ads. It's not fun when games are supposed to be fun. Horrible game, there are still some kind players but only a few, most of them are horrible players, horrible developers and aftersales & support.

Pay to win (p2w). Not even 1 star. Extremely predatory and includes "gacha" mechanics. The "gameplay" in the ads is limited to a very small part of the game. Eventually you'll be forced into an online battleground that's all based on how much money you spend. One player told me they spend $165/mo on the game and another said they've spent $5k so far.

Not as advertised. Don't download or pay to play!!!! It shows a zombie shooting game with problem solving, but it's just a base building game like clash of clans. So disappointed...more zombie missions would have really been popular but it cuts off at 100 zombie missions(as advertised) on the outside walls. No reason to build past base 15. Game over after 5 days.....

Game is a scam. The ads are clearly deceptive, they represent 1% of the game and that 1% is not replayable. The bigger issue lies with the scamming developers. The actual game is a decent base-builder type, but they have many in app purchases in the game to speed up your progress, and some of them won't work after taking your money. Customer support will refuse to help, and if you try to refund the purchase, they will freeze your entire account, and tell you to pay them or your account is banned

Game sucks it tries to get you to buy stuff every time u load it up with an ad and it has stuff built in all over for you to pay. Response to their reply. You know exactly what I am talking about. It's not a bug to be reported it's a feature you built in. You throw up a buy this or buy that every time the game loads. That the user has to close the windows before continuing. The thing to buy is different sometimes. Which indicates intention and bad practice. I am not going to report in game.

All these games are designed the same. You will make incredibly fast progress for the first few levels and then you will hit a massive difficulty that will take you days or weeks to make any real progress unless you buy a ton of their gear. They are intentionally made this was to frustrate people into buying. "Freemium" gaming is such a scam. I love the canned reply from the Chinese servers lol. What a total scam.

Obviously we've all seen this game as that add that comes on while we're doing something else. Decided to finally try and and it's pretty much exactly what you'd expect: a guided experience with almost zero skill required other than knowing basic addition and division. The mechanics are designed around getting you to return to the app more and more often while trying to tempt you into spending money on in app purchases. Would give a 0/5 if possible.

The advertisements for the game are deceiving, it's as if it were the only aspect of the game, which is what drew me in. I kept playing, regardless of not being a fan of the format. The game inserted a poor censorship mechanic in text that tends to favor those that speak Cantonese as a first language and any translations of common English words are censored (and even portions of words). The customer support staff is slow amd not helpful. They do no provide adequate responses to in game issues

ads are not the game. great job monitizing a game so players spend hours *or* pay to speed up the hours, just to get to the fun part of the game advertised. crazy. I just quit after level 10, because it's obvious the monetization tricks they're using. you can barely call this grinding. this is a planned model that's very successful in generating income, hence #1 top grossing. 🤮 I'm out. focus on the game we want to play, I'll buy that outright.

Only a small portion of this game is like the ads. I knew this going in. The intro portion, it's like all the other games. You're a little city that has to gather resources and upgrade various buildings, join an alliance, and hope you're on a server that doesn't have a power mad leader, who spent $$$ to be in first place.

Game isn't bad, but the lane part of the game isn't even what's advertised. If you're interested in the game because of how it's advertised, you're going to be disappointed. If you like war games with alliances and server battles with a heavy pay 2 win system, this is it. I would suggest the Devs to actually put in the mini games they falsely advertise to bring people in. Still going to play though.

It's a very time-consuming game if you dont pay, mainly who spends more money is the stronger player. However, i have spent just above 100$, a week after topping up they locked my account and wanted me to topup the same amount claiming my credit score went below a threshold, customer support totally ignores your reasonings when you contact them as they just focus to get you to pay more. Thank god i did not invest more. Not a recommended game as they try to get more money in unethical ways.

The game they advertise is not the game you get. Is fun for first few hours. Then, it is a constant grind and paywall to progress and play the levels they show. Some levels are so oddly specific and difficult they show a YouTube video on how to do it, and it still takes hours. Save yourself the time and frustration, and don't get this game.

A very expensive game if you want to be competitive, so unless you're prepaird to pay multiple thousands of US$, or be a minor speedbump, don't try this game. This is quite disappointing as the game has potential, but the developers are too greedy. They're going for max money in shortest time, instead of lower pricing and keeping players for, possibly, years. The game needs a large playerbase, otherwise it feels like a solo game, the older servers are ghost towns and will get no new players. 🙁

I enjoy the game. Although I spent a little money, you don't have to pay to have great game play. Getting in an alliance and engaging with others is necessary to get the best experience. There are a lot of game benefits to do so. The instructions are limited. You'll need to figure things out as you go, but that can be enjoyable. DEVELOPER- I wish there were more options to replenish Stamina through tasks or shops! Don't jack the diamond cost so high for multiple stamina purchases!

Another game that doesn't show what the primary game is about from the advertisements. This is about building your fortress and heros and collecting resources. Extra -1 star for lying about it in the ads. Are DEVs SO embarrassed about their game that they have to lie or mislead people to entice them to play? Is it because this is just another rip-off copy of 1000 other games? Would LOVE to see something new and different, not just in the ads, but in the actual game play!!

Limited zombie on road action. I've played 32 consecutive days so you don't have to! I installed after ads suggested it was an endless zombie fighting game where you upgrade your fighters and mow down bad guys on the highway. IT IS NOT. It's another castle builder/castle defense that has diminishing amounts of fighting unless you want to spend loads of real money to speed up progress. this game is made to frustrate players with a slow pace to turn them into payers. I'm over it.

I was late for nothing, eating cold noodles, arguing with my charger, and questioning every life choice I’ve ever made. Then I opened Last War: Survival Game, tapped a few buttons, watched numbers go up, forgot everything else, and somehow survived the day. IT SAVED MY LIFE.

Before you start playing, be aware that this game is far more aggressive than most freemium titles. I originally thought the spending pressure would be limited to the early stages, as is common in similar games, but it only intensifies over time. To make meaningful progress, you’re forced to pay for extras like additional builders, a second science center, season passes, and more. Even being part of alliance doesn’t help much — you simply can’t push into higher levels without spending.

Granted this has no ads. But it doesn't need them, this game follows the "Dark Pattern" style of gameplay. Meaning the more money you spend the stronger you will be, and since it deals with real wait times, you can either give them some money to get that much closer to the carrot. Or just be forever behind & lose pretty much everytime (unless you're lucky and with a big spender) Tech support isn't very good either. Much like the style of these games they don't listen to any suggestions or issue

This game appears fun on the surface, but the only real strategy behind is the game is a deceptive trap. The deception isn't in the mini game though, it's in the actual design itself as much as the fact that it's being tagged as if it's some kind of survival game. The minigame is as it appears, but this game is a war style pvp game where you build, upgrade buildings, research tech, and battle other players. Here's the catch though, it's designed behind engagement and micro transactions.

Same as all the others. Very little advertised gameplay. Just constantly doing things to level up so your army can beat levels. And some levels you can't beat at all without forming alliances etc. I just want to play alone and I don't want to wait 9 hours for something to upgrade. Within a week of downloading I couldn't get any farther, lost interest and uninstalled the game.

This game starts off just as advertised, a fun little scrolling zombie killer. It even stays that way for a few hours of initial gameplay. The game slowly starts becoming an uninteresting base builder with an overwhelming amount of upgrades, and the actual game gets time gated behind upgrading your base, which can take several hours, unless of course you're willing to pay to speed up the base upgrades. Very disappointing. Would not recommend it to anyone.

Same as Whiteout Survival. Core systems, gaming experience, everything is same. At the beginning, you grow up so fast and game slows you down after a moment and you need to pay for go further. Just a lil bit cheat for human psychology. You spent time and improved and you don't want to quit. Boom, you're in the trap. Do not even think to buy anything. Cause they show you the best version and max potential of heroes, but you need to spend more to get those stats. Game is not fun cause repetitive.

If I ever see another ad for this game, it'll be too soon. I never want to see this game in ads again. Yes, the little side-to-side shooting minigame is real. But that isn't what this game is all about. It's yet another base-building MMO where you can pay to get a massive jump over other players, and you're constantly at risk of being attacked if you spend 1 day away (once you progress far enough). I'm tired of getting ads for this game. I tried it, didn't care for it, and do not want to see it

This game spammed me with adds for MONTHS , super annoying. So I finally downloaded it to try. Lots of claims of "oh it's just like the ad videos come try it" yeah it's not. It's similar but they have added some cheesy progression mechanics and rewards system that make is nauseating. And are obviously only there for $. If you think you are getting a smooth running horde fighting game you are wrong this thing is cheesie. Adds and pics are misleading. Uninstall after 5 mins. 1 star.

This game is exactly what it advertises NOT to be. It's a base builder 1st and shooter "puzzle" last. There's artificial timers everywhere to try and push you into every money purchase option that exists. It doesn't even wait 5 stages before showing it's a lie and you would spend money. Another scam based upon the exact thing it claims to be against.

I wanted to enjoy this game that is "like the ads", but it's not. that is a very minor part of the actual game play. And as with most things like this, I leave the game for a little bit and get wiped out by someone I have no chance of defending against that's 5 levels above me and they want you to spend money and max protection is 3 days. So the parts like the ads are fun, everything else is why I'm uninstalling.

First off; no this game isn't really the one from the ads. It starts off similar but it opens up to a completely different game with the ad gameplay as a mini-game that you only do sometimes. The game itself is fun as long as you join a good alliance- that's why I'm giving it 2 stars instead of 1. The actual game gets great FEATURE support, but the actual support team will never once help you if you lose out due to a glitch; they'll just make excuses. The non-support is why I quit playing.

This game advertises as free, but once you play, you will realize it is just the opposite. Several players who spent 1000s of euros have quit this week due to "the new season". It turns out seasons are another way to get people to pay. If you are not ready to pay tens of thousands of euros, do not even install. The game has so many in-game purchases and many players buy them every day, you cannot compete at all. The game favors far-east countries due to server reset times, terrible experience!

it's fun for a little bit, but it's like MANY other games. The fun part of the game is very short then it turns into a time sink to build your fort, city, village, whatever. It really feels more like a part time job than a game. It's something I log in to to pass time, but it seems every time I do, someone has destroyed my base. I literally don't care. This is done on purpose as sometimes it is in game stuff attacking you instead of other players. All of this is to annoy you into paying money.

This game is the dumbest bait & switch I've ever seen. People came to play this because of the zombie killing minigame seen in the ads, but the more you play the more the game distances itself from that and starts becoming some base defender bs. So in 3 days you lose the interest of people that would actually be willing to stay and play and spend money on it, because now itscompletely different game. To make it worse your base gets attacked all the time by higher level players, theres no balance

Sucked in by an ad that is very misleading and a borderline flat out lie. You don't run down a path collecting different guns and troops in any part of the game I played. It's mostly just 20 second levels where you run into +xx and dodge -xx, then spend the rest of the time in the menu just clicking buttons to open boxes and upgrade stuff. Very boring.

What you see in the ad is a mini game within the main game. You can play for free, but you'll just be farmed by the people who pay to play and win. It's just another stats based pvp, server vs server, kingdom vs kingdom type game. Build your base, upgrade your base, train troops, yadda yadda yadda. Nothing new here that hasn't been done to death over the past decade.

Last War: Survival starts off great fast-paced, interesting, and rewarding but once you hit higher levels, the fun stops cold. It’s not exactly “pay to win,” it’s pay to play. Every upgrade suddenly takes days or even weeks to complete unless you spend real money, and the game slows to a crawl. On top of that, most clans expect you to be online constantly for events or risk getting kicked out. It stops feeling like a game and starts feeling like a second job.

Awesome game with one major drawback that sucks the fun out of it. Players who spend the money and control the servers rule and dictate the game to everyone else. Right now we have a powerful alliance who without spending thousands of dollars no one will ever touch and they run rough shot on everyone. How do u solve this problem? Maybe the game makers should make it more interesting by having the ability to combat even the players who paid the most from time to time in some form. So lopsided now

The demo is misleading. It's a lot of fun until about level 10 or 12, then pretty much downhill from there unless you want to pump money into it. What you see in the demo is about 5% of what the game actually is. If pay-to-play is your thing, get to 20 ASAP otherwise just delete it when it isn't fun anymore. Some alliances are so vicious it ruins the game

In-game purchases become necessary. Eventually, I made the smallest purchase I could as I was sick of waiting a whole day before I could do anything else ingame. The product provided was not as advertised. There is no refund option on the game, so I did it through google. The game them locked me out as it saw the refund as being on negative credit. The game is now bricked for me, so I have no choice but to either pay for an item I was lied to to purchase, or, uninstall the game.

I got about four or five games in which are advertised and then it makes you have to rebuild some base. it's all just some dumb RPG game. Don't waste your time. Just when it seems like it's going to be fun mindless zombie killing they try to rope you into some stupid garbage. They must be getting so much revenue off of selling your personal information when you download the app. please save yourself the trouble

Fun for a little while, but it doesn't last. The beginning of the game is quite fun with plenty of action. I probably played it for a week before it petered out. It progressively becomes a pay to win, with less fun gameplay and more "farming" which bored me right to death. I'll give it three stars which is probably generous.

honestly, I only play this because I'm in between games. this is nothing like the ad. sure, you play some instances like they advertise but for a game that has ads about playing a challenging puzzle game, it's a base builder. occasionally they drip feed random challenge levels but it's not as advertised and greedy for your money every event. decent idle game but don't expect to play a math focused puzzle game like I did. those moments are few and far between, unlike the ads

Not an infinite zombie shooter as the ads would have you believe. Just a side thing to lure you into an endless web of upgrading buildings,units, researches. It has alliances and wars. If you like that sort of stuff it's actually a well made game. 2 stars for lying in their ads and specifically saying that "we were sick of other games lying in their ads so we made this"

at first u get all the fun, beginner level , then it's impossible to beat enemies up unless u buy stuffs ( like €5 qday) and they play tutorial on how to defeat a certain level videos on youtube but it's not true at all .. in the videos 1 bullet will kill a zombie, in the actual game unfortunately the zombies needed more 🥴😒 very limited levels as well.. 10 levels then upgrade then buy stuffs and again and again ... not worth it anymore.. too greedy the developers of this game..

Yet another game that promises one type of gameplay that falsely advertises as another. Despite what the previews say, this is not simply about math and strength in numbers but about stupid base building and endless lead by the nose base upgrades. What you see in the ads account for about 1% of actual game play. Also endless micro transactions. Pass!

This game is total misleading. You can't win unless you play for an hour on 1 mission. The soldier doesn't shoot fast enough and the zombie don't die quick enough. They block you from shooting at power ups and by the time you collect the power up you are dead. This game is trash. do not waste your time because that is all this game is made for....making you addicted to try. Do not install.

Game is nothing like the trailers for it. The lane shooting makes up a very small portion of the beginning of the game, and sometimes weekly challenges. To be competitive and progress you need to spend money (pay to win). I myself got suckered into $2 here and $10 there. I removed the game after I tallied up how much I spent over 4 months, and I'm embarrassed at how much I did and immediately removed it.

To the gamers: this is a base grind with updates and a small linear map to explore. resources are unlimited because they mean nothing. lots to do in the first couple days. then you hit the wall at level 10. to the developers: balance was great till it takes hours to upgrade anything on your base. lots upgrade tokens for skills and raw materials for equipment manufacturing you will never reach. if you were to balance resources and XP this could be a cool game.

This game is not like advertised. Yes, there is a part of the game where you swipe left and right to destroy stuff but it is mostly an alliance city building war game. It is heavily reliant on pay to play as the best characters have to be bought or grinded out to get but by then, other players are way ahead of you. I am not sure about other servers, but mine had a bunch of toxic trolls. We used a discord channel where they just whined and were gaslighting. One person even stalked me.

DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS GAME!!! Developers' inability to resolve issues related to wifi and network connections make the game nearly impossible to play and enjoy. Also, games crashes nearly every time a "major event" occurs in the game. In addition to that, the countless numbers of bugs are infuriating. To top it off, it's one of the most "money hungry" games I have ever played. Do not download...and if you do, I wish you all the best

Pretty fun game to play when idling. Biggest letdown is the notification function. Doesn't even inform you when there are major happenings, eg. Attacks on your camp. Search most forums, and you'll find that it's a common complaint. Almost seems like a deliberate design by the mischievous developers to keep players logged on.

They claim they've finally done the game from the adds but they didn't... They don't tell you it's a base building gatcha game, progression is blocked by the buildings you build and upgrade, of course super fast in the first few hours and longer afterwards. Oh and I barely have space left to talk about the adds with those people playing terribly on purpose to trigger you into trying to do better (plus they got Homelander mixer into it). I genuinly don't understand the 4+ stars, still a rip off.

Not at all like the ads. The ad shows rows of bad guys nearing you w/ the # of hits needed to destroy. It looks like a strategic game of needing to make quick thoughts to fire at the right #'s attacking you w/ the assumption that clearing levels will level you up as it gets harder. It is more like a futuristic version of the recently renamed Rise of Castles. The ad merely shows a small part of the game you can rarely even play. Months of play and that small part has never looked like the ad.

As you may have read from other comments, the ads are misleading. The game itself is kind of fun but it's a p2w model. There are plenty of bottlenecks & paywalls to deter you from upgrading at a steady pace. Those bottlenecks will compel you to spend money just to keep up. It's not f2p friendly. The in-game packages are ridiculously priced. Imagine having a $150 package & 3200% tag on it, implying that the items inside are worth $4800? In events, even buying 1 $150 package is not enough.

This "game" is a pure Pay2Win thing. If you wanna be able to succeed you need to invest a huge amount of money. Several alliance member who were able to survive and compete invested several k into the game. If you choose to play it as a free2play game you will get wiped out pretty soon and be never able to catch up. More often, those that could support you won't see you as valuable form them as long as you don't invest money as well in that game. All in all not worth the time.

First time very bad experience with any game play. I am unable to login the game .. and it's been more than 12 hours now, even telling the support team abt ending of the sports event on which I have spent more than 20k in a week and I was looking to buy my first skin, but due to login issue I am unable to play, even worse i could not claim the other rewards Arm Race first price, dual vs ranking rewards, zombie siege rewards.. I have tried all to resolve the issue from my end.. but could not.

Just like everyone is saying - very misleading advertising. Shameful on the part of the developer and marketing team! It's just another "build your base" game. I'm very disappointed because I wanted to just run on a road doing quick math calculations and shooting things; that looked like a fun little time passer. I did NOT want a base, resources, build this to build that; etc. Mobile game makers really need to get over the obsession with that type. Make the simple game shown in the lying ads!

The premise of the game is fun, why 1 star? Because it is another pay to win with a billion micro transactions, you'll have to pay (a lot) if you want any progress. In the beginning, you can progress fast, but then you'll get stuck and having to wait a collective of long hours to upgrade anything is pretty much unplayable.

DO NOT download this. every ad I saw the audio didn't even match up. I'm pretty sure I'm going to hit a point that PVP is a thing too and I'll Uninstall if I stay that long honestly. and it's like 5 second levels and you go back to resource collecting until you hit a point you have to spend real money or sit and wait forever to upgrade. These games should be banned from the store. I get it people need money but it's gotten ridiculous.

bad Edited: That is impressive that devs care :). Well, as for me, controls are not smooth, game is laggy very soon, basically during tutorial runs when there is a lot of units on the screen. Animation's and "world" look weird., especially a "packed present". All in all, games feels really rushed and unpolished and made on demand to hype. The amount of ads I got for this won't let me give higher rating.

I downloaded this game thinking it a zombie fighting game but then after downloading it I realized you were fighting other players. I usually don't play games with other people but still decided to try it & had players quickly destroy 9000 men in my base after not paying attention to it for one day or two. I quickly realized why I don't play games with other players like this. I quickly deleted it and will not go back. I wrote this review so other people won't make the same mistake I did.

The AD is not a good representation of the game. While the general components are the same, the gameplay is completely different, the levels are short and rather boring. The enemy comes at you, not you running at them. Didn't make it deep enough into the game to see if it got more interesting/challenging. But definitely does not fulfill on the AD's promise.

The game itself is ornate and involved. Strategy and planning are involved and it is impossible to play without joining a decent alliance that knows the intricacies of the game. There are A LOT of in app purchases... wayyyy too much. Other players absolutely waste thousands of dollars for pay to win, which becomes obvious very quickly as you develop through the game. To top it off, the game ends up being political and "fairness" is not a thing. for this reason, it sucks, don't waste your time.

Gameplay is totally different than the videos shown, it's a buggy pay to play strategic game causing huge imbalances between players and servers, and when you do buy stuff, they remove buildings, but they think its OK because they let players know towards the end of the season. They push packages constantly on you to get your cash. It's a shame as overall, it's an enjoyable game, which does take time to learn. Customer service gives canned answers, shameful support.

The game is not as advertised. It is more like clash. It's very disappointing because after the initial levels, you barely do any of the stage clearing missions. They constantly try and get you to spend money to upgrade the base and troops. I would give the game an extra star if the old stages were atleast replayable, even without rewards.

As someone who spent a lot of money on this game, I want to share my honest thoughts. It was fun at first, but the gameplay quickly became repetitive and pointless. The game is slow, everything is overpriced, and the economy feels completely unbalanced. It’s like paying someone else to have fun with your money. Don't pay, the fun part is free. Save your money and buy a full game instead of falling into the freemium trap.

Any accidental or unauthorized fraudulent purchase cannot be reversed by their policy. Any dispute through your bank that results in any reversal will create a negative credit rating in the game. Your account is then extorted until you pay them. There is no return policy that benefits the player. Be warned I reached level 26 and an overnight accidental purchase that I requested to be voided the next morning was determined to be my problem. When bank reversed the charge my account was locked.

Pay to Play. They have such Mechanics in game,like wait unnecessary to upgrade the construction base, rare chances of obtaining anything, upgrading the costs fortune, you can't progress faster if you can't pay, This is money milking game, You can't go breakthrough Lvl 16. And the reply they always gives is some robotic response. Try to be considerate developers, don't be greedy. Implement a balance play. Would not recommend.

Lack luster, they focus more on the base building than the actual game play or strategy, it's buggy and let me win even tho i clearly lost but sent me through anyway, it's not difficult and gameplay is very short like 30 seconds at most, I want a strategy choice game that runs for as long as you can go, something like temple run but with the mechanics of survival and choosing upgrades to get you farther, this is nothing like that, it's a base building game with the mini game advertised. :(

Honestly, don't waste your time. Like most other reviews, once you get to mid teens you will just constantly get attacked by people who pay to win and are much stronger. There's no checks and balances and the game loves that because they try to get people to pay money to be able to compete. If you love to spend money on a game just to barely be able to compete this is the game for you. And devs, don't waste your time with your generic response. No one wants to spend points to just shield up

Game is really fun and like the advertisements in the early part while you're still building up your camp. The gacha in early game is okay, they give you enough stuff for free to keep you hooked. Once you get to end game, almost anything you compete for against others is solely based on how much you want to spend. All f2p people are left in the dust when faced with some artificial whale or an actual whale that will always win. Gacha rates are awful endgame, even for paying players.

The graphics are nice, pretty polished. The ux is cluttered, and there are tons of things to click on and lots of ways to spend money... BUT, the actual game play is boring as hell. It's so basic and automatic that it takes ZERO thought or skill. You slide your little people left and right, and THAT'S IT. You don't even have to think. You just move them to the blue lane. It feels super non-interactive for as busy as it is. Feels like a weak attempt to disguise the money pit it's drooling to be.

While the core gameplay of the game itself is reasonably decent, it does tend to become quite repetitive rather quickly. I really dislike all the side missions it includes, as they distract from the main game experience. Things like joining a team, undertaking global missions, and plundering trucks feel like unnecessary filler. I've had it for two weeks and it's time to move on.

Played the game to the point where I reached level 20, the game is not bad. I have put plenty of money into the game. The thing is that you need to put ridiculous amounts of money to progress and get stronger in order to have a chance in this game. In order to get legendary heroes you need to BUY BATTLE PASSES WITH REAL WORLD MONEY... THIS IS DISGUSTING. If you are willing to put a fortune in the game it is fun if you don't, don't even bother downloading it, MAKE IT MORE FAIR FOR F2P.

I like the game, but it's not at all what the ads you probably seen are advertising (only the very start and some mini game (events) are like that) Graphics are good (be sure to have the game on high settings. Otherwise, you also get a lower framerate) It stands out against rivals in the genre like RoK or Lords Mobile, in the sense that it's straight upwards and not vertical, like they are. Makes gaming much more comfortable and convenient in my eyes. It's fully P2W. Don't expect anything.

Gave it a genuine try, and it is lousy. Game play is wildly different than advertised except for occasional side games. Advancement requires significant investment (hours to days) or credit card payment. Every Friday, you are wiped out by larger competitors unless you purchase shields (digital extortion) using gathed resources or purchased resources. This game is constantly pushing for payments ranging from $4.99 to $99.99.

I've played this game for a couple weeks now and have read a lot of the reviews and developer responses. With that being said, this is 1000% pay to win, but 100% free to play. Meaning, you can play the game and not spend a single $, which the developers hide behind. But if you want to enjoy the game you have to pay. There is no middle ground. If you don't pay you will just get passed up by everyone who does until you can't compete anymore, and then It becomes completely unplayable. Fun game tho.

Uninstalled after a few minutes because after playing the relatively entertaining game for a few minutes, it just becomes a standard BS mobile game with clicking on things every so many minutes or hours and collecting 9 different types of currencies for no reason. It's confusing and boring. The game part is what you see, the rest of it is tedious and annoying.

Huge opportunity to have a great game. but they included a story world mode.. where it's just telling you to click this.. click that.. its very directed and pointless. It'll tell you when can and can't play.. just dumb. If they had made this an arcade game. Where you could just play the main section of the game without a ridiculous story mode.. then I'm sure they'd have a 5-star game. Give us an arcade mode and I'll give it 5 stars. Soon as I get directed to a story mode.. is when I uninstall.

Pay attention to the negative reviews for this game if you are considering playing-- they are pretty on target. Highlights to consider: 1. Not that similar to the ads beyond the first few levels 2. Incredibly pay to play, you will be farmed for resources unless you shield constantly. 3. Game is reeeeeally glitchy/ has significant lag 4. Customer support is not especially active or helpful. Even if you reach out with a glitch, they won't necessarily do anything to make it right.

Many events which are fun! However, the rewards for putting in so much effort and time are disappointing. Every event kills thousands of troops within minutes. It takes days and many resources to build back up. When good rewards are given, every couple months, there are limitations on amount of rewards you can collect. I have been playing this game for 165 days straight. I am about to quit like others.

Thought it was fun until... First, everyone who has been playing this forever just raid and pillage you, so you can never gain no traction to build. Developers should give new users at least a month of shielding your base so you can at least build up strength to at least stand a chance against all the players who have been playing since day one. Second, you can only get so far without putting money in. Luckily, I only spent .99 cents. The game had potential but isn't for new users.

Utterly boring base-building, PvP that is 100% pay-to-win. The gameplay you see in the trailer disappears after a week, and you are left with a simple base building PvP battler. You don't have to invest €100s but you will be crushed later if you don't. To respond ... balanced, that would only work if you only paid for cosmetics. Breakthrough, let us replay levels rather than wait days for thr next 5 levels.

if you're free to play, after the first couple of days it just becomes an app you open every few hours then click a few things then close. Then a few hours later, open, click, close. As others have said, what they advertise is maybe 10%? of the game. At the begging of the game you'll play a few of those types of games, then you'll get to a point where you're not strong enough to advance and need more resources to level up (then the open, click, close starts). Then get stronger, then repeat

First of all this game claims to be "like the ads". Nothing coukd be further from thr truth. This game is nothing like the ads. It is a base building game that is trapped in microtransaction hell. There is no skilled involved. You dont even need to touch the screen for any of the missions. Win or lose is based on how mimuch your base is upgraded or how much money you spent. It is another example of eveything wrong with the gaming industry.

Game feels it's as advertised until you hit level 4-5. Then it's 30+ min wait to upgrade anything, you're pretty incessantly asked to join an alliance. This IS NOT a single player game. I'm only level 5 and have already been attacked by mega bases twice. Game is not worth it. It's a PvP game plain and simple. You're going to end up either spending a lot of RL money or just quitting if you're wanting a single player puzzle like experience. Best to keep clear. Uninstalled.

Bit of fun, but further you progress the more it requires you spend money. Otherwise getting anywhere will take months/years. Money required to get comfortable would be around $100. Then I'm sure it will keep pounding away at you. It sucked about $20 dollars out of me before I put a halt on it, I have better things to spend hundreds of dollars on. All these games are the same.

Its a solid 2 because the mini gameplay is great. The rest of the gameplay is cookie cutter. There is nothing good to spend diamonds on except shorten time. An overwheling number of bot players, likely coming from the play and get paid cash farms. Bots are trying to steal your information. No way to report bot players. Mobs on map will not show up unless you use search function then all of a sudden there is one right next to you. Seach is a limite feature so when its up no more hunting.

The game is in general ok to play however the constant pay to advance pop-ups inevitably drove me crazy. A popular console game costs about 50€ or more but this game makes it seem you should pay that every day to advance. There are also pop-ups for every single advancement and claims made. So you just spend half the time clicking and tapping notifications away the entire time. very annoying. So annoying in fact I deleted the game after 5 days.

Any game that's part of the practice of draining our lifespan 30 seconds at a time for ad revenue won't get it out of me. The gameplay is like on the ads for about 10% of the time. The rest is like a lot of other scammy games where you just have a confusing and EXCESSIVE amount of screens, farming, currency items, etc. I played for 30 minutes and its mainly tutorials where they force you to build the base their way and keep clicking buttons to farm. Micropurchase like hooks aren't fun!

Like all games of this genre, it's play to win. Wouldn't be so bad but like all games of this genre, it's a waste when there are no player restrictions. These genre fails for one reason, no restrictions on players higher levels from attacking players of lower levels. It's a waste of money when a player is ten power levels higher than you and can't do anything.

The VS and server wars are not fairly matched. There are also too many abandoned bases, and we are starting to think that maybe that's why our server has been lacking new players. It's been difficult to recruit. It takes entirely too long to upgrade any of the buildings once you get to around level 20. It takes even longer to obtain enough resources to make those upgrades. While there is an abundant of rewards, the rewards should be increased in size. Meaning more payout.

the game itself it's good. the problem is the people who play. the server is giving them more and more power to decide over the players game and they, of course (as good humans), abuse it, making the experience really bad, the game frustration grows and you finally leave. as the ones who decides are, as in everything in life, the ones who pay more, they really kill all the vibe. conclusion: don't play if you, also i an online game, don't want to deal with annoying human beings.

The ads you no doubt were bombarded with that led to downloading the game are deceptive. There's a bit of the shooter scroller in there, but it's predominantly the bait to get you to download the game, then spend hours/days waiting for buildings to complete and resources to pile up so you can do a couple more levels or shooting, or you spend a lot of money to speed up the clock. If they thought people wanted to play a base builder that would be part of the ads. But it's not.

Constant ads and pushes to make expensive in app purchases. This is not a shooter like the ads portray, this is a base builder where a quarter of your screen will be taken up by flashing buttons to make purchases. The one part of the game that's like the ads is fun, but after 20 minutes of game play you have to spend hours grinding for the resources to build your base to a high enough level just to get 6 or 7 more 2 minute mission's.

It's 100% pay to win. Yeah, you could spend years, literally, but if you want to catch up to other players, you will spend a ton of money. The game itself, once you have reached the endgame, is boring. There are about 15 min of things to do after the server resets, and then nothing but a couple fights against the trash on the map.
