Stamina is VERY scarce. The alliance battles are PTW. You don't need strategy, just money. There's a reason it's #1 in top grossing strategy games. Sad game.

complete garbage definitely is not what it says it is .it'll get you playing it at first you might have 10 minutes in and then it's already aggravating .so I decide to spend $20 because you can only play so far and then you have to wait for a couple days before you can even win a battle against anything. definitely not fun after the $20 for upgrading everything and buying new characters there still too weak you still have to wait a couple of days before you can beat one battle..total garbage

OP PLAYERS ATTACK ALL THE TIME!! if you are looking for a game that you can burn time building a city and playing some of their games along the way, this is it. the BIG problem is that they have events where players 3x (OR GREATER) can attack your city, at any given time. the event actually encourages the players to attack other players. It's not cool! especially when there is no match maker prohibiting them from attacking you when they are well over double your strength. Uninstalling!

This game very nice. Every battle is a challenge. Everything building upgrades quickly up to level 10. It take days to and days of upgrades to have a strong enough army to go through to the next level. It becomes time consuming and frustrating. Your heroes upgrades, but it it is still not strong enough to go through to the next level. Don't waste your time and money.

Thisnis not even Pay2Win but Pay2Play: Basically everything is free. But if you plan to actually play in this life then you want to go for purchasing a second, third, fourth build pipeline. Or some other things. When you start the game feel welcomed by three or sometimes five purchase advertisements in a row. How about the tournament of the day? For just 30€ you can give it a try. See ya tomorrow. After a few days you will give up.

Fun at lower levels, as the time to build is short. Once you gain a few levels, things start to slow down. It takes way longer to build your base and train troops as well as harvest materials and unlock techs. The game gives you the option to pay for convenience, boosting build times to instant and etc. Not fun when you need certain buildings upgraded to progress and it takes hours, sometimes half a day or more if you don't buy the boosts to hurry building. Very grindy now.

Nothing about this game is skill based and thats what irks me the most. Its all a matter of having strong enough troops for the level which often means having to purchase additional characters, resources or having to wait snd grind for a long, long time just to progress 3-5 levels and get stuck in the same loop again. All the busy tasks you can do while you grind and can't beat a real level are incredibly boring. Just click here , click there , claim this claim that, just boring as hell.

I unfortunately downloaded this game after being spammed with ads non stop for several months. It follows the same mobile game formula where it lures you in with rapid progression at the start and then abrubtly slows down to try to tempt you to spend money. I sunk many hours into it the first day and decided to nip it in the bud and delete it. This isn't a game, its a formula designed to trigger addictive tendacies and suck money out of certain types of people. Steer clear.

I would give it zero stars if I could. The ad for this game is 100% a lie. After all the talk about how it's not like other games that false advertise, it winds up being the exact same thing. This isn't deceptive advertising. It's a flat out lie. as for your reply, 8 have no doubt you can find this as a mini game in the content. but when you advertise this as the game and then try to defend it on top of that, that's just deception and lies

Fun game to play in the beginning. However, once you get higher up it's money money money in order to advance. New exclusive weapon upgrade for heros, spend 20 bucks and upgrade now! No other way yet. Upgrade your heroes the faster you put money in. So, the whales who drop hundreds or thousands in a week can keep dominating while I am being engulfed at the peasant shrimp level 🍤 🍤

This game sucks. Completely pay to win. After 48 hours of building up your base, a player that paid way too much money can then just attack your base over and over again, stealing everything you collected over the last 2 days. Hell, it may not have even been another player that attacked my base, but an employee. I could see them hiring people to attack players in the hope that the p player will then want to spend money to get back what they had. No thanks. Congrats on losing another player.

Appears fun at first, but typical grindy manipulative mechanics filled game. It is good if you have self control and patience, not common in multi-player alliance driven games, and are there for the alliance aspect. Terrible if you want the game play shown in the most common ads, which I got to do a whopping 38 levels of before reaching my grinding and frustration limit, since that part is locked behind exponentially increasing progression requirements of the main gameplay, base building.

This is not a game, it's casino for your wallet. Every progress is restricted by: 1 - time 2 - luck of recourses 3 - level 4 - difficulty But if you pay, you can progress a little until another pay wall, and it's continues in same pattern. The grinding is lucked behind the same restrictions. You can grind a little until there's nothing you can do because the luck of stamina, level of difficulty. If you want to play games, just buy yourself Nintendo Switch, and start enjoying real games.

Fun to begin with. But the difficulty ramps up so fast you can't progress after a certain level. And the 8 hours you get to defuse the bomb to unlock that one character isn't nearly enough. You get all wires cut except one because the strength requires to earn the final wire cutter just isn't enough by the time runs out. It'sfalse hope unless you "pay to win".....

Timegated to push you to pay money to speed things up, as the in-game time skips either lose effectiveness the further you go or the gems run out quick, not to mention only having one builder unless you want to "rent" one for five hours using gems. Poorly balanced levels, with targets early in that have numerical values that aren't possible for a player to reach at that point in their progression, forcing you to take empty lanes until the numbers are in your favor. Stagnate or pay type of game.

The ads are still a lie. It's similar but it's still not the same. The tutorial takes WAY to long to finish before you're able to disable sounds. You're fighting zombies that you can't easily tell if they're dead or not and the game play from the ads is minimal and your primary game play looks to be more gear towards server tower defense. Disappointing.

It starts out fun and interesting with several different objectives to complete to keep the game exciting, but after you've played for a little while, the timeframes on which the objectives refresh for you to play the next level, build the next "thing", or complete the next task can extend from a couple of minutes to a COUPLE OF DAYS before you can play again... UNLESS... you buy something, making this just another "PAY-TO-PLAY" game.

It's a fine game. However, they don't show images of the base building part of the game in either the ad or the pictures which I find misleading. You do get to do the thing in the images but in between, you have to build a base, harvest resources, etc. There is also a hero mechanic which again isn't shown in the ads or images.

It starts ok and you're on a roll then you hit a wall and it's just a snowball of something not updated to make progress and you pretty much stay in a nomad state of buying diamonds to have supplies to barely get to the point of almost moving forward...... it's really just a scheme to buy diamonds..... You can't even get to point of enjoy playing the game.

This game is designed to extract as much money from you as possible with the flashiest most over the top way possible. Can't recommend sorry. When will developers start putting an initial price on apps and focusing on gameplay alone after that? The appstore and playstore are in a sorry state and need a complete overhaul. Bring back real gaming, there's a market for it.

This game doesn't live up to its advertisements or promotional images. It's cluttered with numerous in-app purchases and lacks substantial gameplay. The game mostly involves tapping to collect various items, whose purpose isn't always clear. There's very little engaging gameplay, and it's not enjoyable. The action sequences, like shooting, are brief—lasting only about 30 seconds—and are automated, so player input barely matters. In a nutshell, a basic game with a lot of tricks to make people pay

wasted potential! the game is fun for a couple hours until it ramps up the difficulty and keeps offering pay to win cards. There is a bunch of stuff to do and obviously upgrade, none of which is fun but needs to be done to progress. The part of the game they use for ads is fun but a very small part of the game and get ready to upgrade 30 buildings and heroes to get leveled up enough to stand a chance... or spend money and do it quicker.

I tried this through ad click bait, because shooting zombies seems fun and simple. But then this gets very misleading. Turns out into a world network where you have to build your base and get resources to do a bunch of stuff to play more. The zombie game itself are only a few handful. The world developing part looks so confusing and complicated. Save your time and effort and don't try this

I completely lost interest when it was the server vs server event. Those guys just have way to much power. It's crazy how much money they dumped into the game to get to that point. It made me feel like what's the point of even trying. 20$ pass every 7 days is also diabolical. I loved the game but I'm not trying to vs the other servers with that kind of power

Game isn't anything like any of the pictures or the videos shown. You briefly play an "endless runner" during the tutorial but it's not endless, it's only for about a minute each level and then you're done. It also looks nothing like the screenshots and is really watered down on the gameplay, as you pretty much have to try to fail in the tutorial. This is just another PVP base building game they want whales to drop a ton of money on, not an endless runner.

City building / wait to play. You have to log in every few hours, upgrade a building and wait for it to finish... or pay. Fun gameplay like the ads or store pics is only a mini part, called Frontline Breakthrough. All other fights are with "heros" and really dull. No skill required, lanes don't matter, they auto steer the attacks anyway. If you can't clear a stage then you just have to upgrade the base/heros, which can take days... or money. Borderline false advertising.

I waited 24 hours for explosives to go off and kill an npc. Nothing happened. The game doesn't run like others that actually play like they advertise. This game acts like another clash of clans-esque game where you pay cash to build what the devs call a "base". If I wanted a Clash game, I'd just redownload clash of clans! Or find something that seems more fun. Response to response. Don't use gameplay in adverts that makes it seem its singleplayer focused. Use the actual gameplay in the ads.

I've been playing for a few months now even thought it is NOT AT ALL what is put in the ads. You have to build and upgrade a base and OCCASIONALLY you donwhat was shown in the ads. But after playing for a few months this game is not only a money grab and extremely pay to win but because of that the whales rule everything. There's a bunch of bullying that happens in the servers and nothing you can do about it unless you want to spend literally thousands. This games is toxic af don't install.

I just don't get it. It has potential to be a good game but fails to make much sense. I downloaded it cause it says it's a stickman esk scrolling game. But only a small fraction of the game is of that. The rest is just base building. To get anywhere as far as actual progression you have to spend money. And it's not cheap. UPDATE!!! After being contacted by the developers my conclusion holds. They have no intention or interest in my review of the game. Or how to make the game better.

The screenshots of the game (what's shown in ads) is probably less than 5% of the game. And it's no where near what they show. Main game is building a base behind artificial time gates. You can play for a couple of hours before you are forced to a halt behind long build times and progress becomes non existent unless you pay for boosts.

The game itself is enjoyable to some degree. It baits you with an easy power increase and hooks you in the start, however it becomes really clear that its a pay to win type game, which is unfortnate. Many MANY of the good heroes are primarily behind a pay wall. The game sometimes offers a small portion of what is shown in the ads but that is limited to some degree as well. It has the potential to be a great game if they diminished the pay to win style.

Homelander didn't lie, it is a game, but the freemium stinks like every other game that pays more for advertising than it does on originality. It's become practically impossible to pass some missions because the "AI" is so poor and inconsistent you won't progress without $$$$ Survivors, Enemies and Allies are all obviously AI ripoffs of popular characters in games. The TF2 Medic is absolutely one of the characters and the zombies are from Plants VS Zombies. It's a fun timewaster though.

Wildly misleading. This is an app, so not "fake", just like that commercial says. But what they advertise is at max 5% of the game. I gave it over a month, and I often went days without getting to play a round of that running game they advertize. It's just another game from a generic studio pumping out several of the same game with minor skin changes. You spend the majority of your time scavenging around various (insanely inconsistent) screens just clicking to claim "rewards". Don't bother.

Money gobbling machine. Will start as a mindless game then turn into a p2p game, which will entice you to low value transactions, and then higher ones. My advice quit while you're ahead. The game is reinforced by other users that already spend 1000s and that will teach you the game and entice you to spend more. My opinion, not worth it, save your money

Not really what the adds were claiming. Sure the gameplay is there but is misleading. I just wanted to play the stupid shooting game but instead I get base building, guilds, Yada, Yada.. Oh and another thing; when you actually reach the gameplay that was advertised prepare for it to piss you off because the lane is often too small, I unintentionally bumped into the minus fences way too many times and during one stage my crew constantly bumped into the minus fences that was right next to the plus

This is a strategy game plain and simple. The advertisement with the single man getting power ups is a small portion of the game. There are articles and post all over specifically saying that this is the gameplay. While this is partially true, it is a small portion of the entire game. If you download the game because you got duped into thinking that that was the gameplay you're not alone. I got GOT too. I REALLY WISH THEY WOULD MAKE JUST THAT PART OF A GAME INTO ITS OWN APP AND GAME.

I was charged twice for a one time purchase! Now you're blocking me from playing because the second payment was refunded to me! This is insane behavior and I will not pay twice for the same thing! Shamefully to block me from playing now, unless I pay you??! After waiting all day and multiple attempts to get anyone from customer support to help me, no one is coming back to me!

Very fun game, well made. But the prices in the shops for passes and progress are just super overpriced. Especially since there are other games that charge single digits for battle passes, while this game is charging $20. You guys are trying to get all your money up front and that's putting me off. These prices got to come down. It's way too greedy. There's so many things to buy for $20 and higher in this game that it's crazy.

This game is fun to play as a city building game for a while. But too much of it is pay to win. There are some big spenders so overpowered that one guy can take out an alliance of 100 players. You can be a group of friends actively playing for weeks and cooperating. Then one guy comes and destroys everything because they've sunk $10k+ in this game and can insta build and insta level. Don't start unless you are prepared to spend at least a few hundred bucks to be minimally competitive

I don't have a problem with the costs. Its the rewards after the cost. The rewards should be way more if someone chooses to spend $100. Let's be real, You'll hardly ever come across another UR hero after a certain point unless you purchase from the daily sale. Developer kind of does force purchases if upgrading takes days/weeks after a certain point and only 1 building queue is available unless you purchase more. You'd never progress with 1 building queue or 1 research tech.

This is not like the advertised game. This is one of those build your base type of games. It has all the stuff I don't want in the game such as interacting dialogs, where I'm forced to read everything the bots say. I go through a story line & the guns are slow. Only a little time is played on a road fighting zombies bots. smh waist of time. Hate this game!

Dont waste your time everyone. It is fun for about the first week of playing then after that same thing in and out. Cant progress quickly without spending tons of money. In game players just demo your base ( they have money and top tier players to do so) dont waste any money or time in to this game. Dont belive the review i put??? Go on reddit and you'll see. Could of been good but nope on to the next one.

Eventually one of the many people who pays hundreds of dollars per week to buy all the power up will decide something you did offended them, and they will spend days chasing you around and attacking. It's not worth getting started in this. Also, the ads are 90% not what the game is. More like an iteration of Clash of Clans. And the text is super small. It's a shame they spent all this time on detail and it is too small to see.

The game's a little fun at first, but quickly devolves into endless complicated resource management. The videos that you see showing gameplay, are a tiny part of the game. You can play levels like that for a very short time and then you've got to spend a long time leveling up and gathering resources before you can play any more levels. Would be much better if they just had level after level of that kind of gameplay that was playable.

I am writing this out of spite. Now, I didn't play the game that much. I'd say about 10ish minutes, this wouldve been longer if not for the word limit. 💔 Of course, I came from the ads, and I will say, this game is barely anything like the ads. The levels are comically easy to beat, the title screen is a STILL image and 4 buttons (not even an intro with all the companies and sh), and the first "SSR" character you get is for fanservice. IT COPIES BRAWLSTARS STYLE FOR THE SECOND CHARACTER. 0/10.

The images are extremely misleading. 99% of the game is a wargame where you have a base and attack others/get attacked - same as many similar games. It is definitely NOT a single player game as it is tagged for some reason? It is also extremely pay to win, but if you expected anything else from a mobile game you only have yourself to blame.

The game is nothing like the ads. Big surprise. Even the ads that brought me here said "This is not fake, this is actual gameplay". It's not. There are so many games that show this same style of gameplay in the ads but then it turns out to be something completely different. Why doesn't someone actually create the game from the ads. You might make something people actually enjoy. Just a thought.

Another pay to win base building game. The mini game where you pick a lane to shoot zombies is locked behind base building progress walls or your characters need to be leveled up enough to kill the zombies so it doesn't matter what lane you pick if you havent been grinding to boost them. I would still say the ads that I have seen don't represent the gameplay fairly. Seems like a skin over "white out survival" half the time and I swear the "yes sir" from the tanks in starcraft 2 is being used.

Completely misleading! This game is a base builder, and the ad is not really indicative of the actual game. Money suck which is in no way like the ads. Typical first builds of the base are quick, then comes the day long builds, unless you buy premium resources. Also, the one part you signed up for (shooting stuff) is short and, again, not like the ad. Do not recommend it.

fun but just winds up being another generic game of recycled images from PvZ zombies to big helmet soldiers. the main ad for the game showed a style of game you only play once in awhile. most of the time you're clicking constantly on random stuff to build a base for some reason. got old after four days and I had no interest in paying real world money for any of the many resources you have to have to get by and be able to play the game you download this for.

I'm used to mobile games being very much skinner boxes, but Last War goes so far beyond. There is basically NOTHING to the game except continual flashing lights and constant meaningless gifts. I spent FIVE HOURS just tapping on whichever buttons flashed next, before finally coming to a point where I had to stop purely because of a time gate. Only a tiny fraction of the game had actual decisions or thinking; everything else was "tap the shiny". Ads are obnoxious and lie to a parodic extent, too.

The game potential and sucks you in with rapid progression early on. Then it quickly locks you into tedious and generally awful gameplay. This game gives you levels that can only be completed with a specific pathing. The devs must recognize the problem with this level design, as they LITERALLY give you YouTube links to show you how THEY want you to play. You can't play the game other than by their design, so look elsewhere if you enjoy a sense of agency when you game. Lastly, aggressive ads.

Eh. Just another tamagotchi. No skill needed but so much babysitting. If you get your base attacked, by someone Manny many levels higher, you don't get immediate defense! They'll just keep hitting you. I played for 1 week and already had the upgrades taking over 10 hrs.... So there's nothing to do most of the time. The ads look fun. Those are there but they are so unfair they suck the fun out. Just a big budget boring game.

False advertising. You get to do something similar to the ads for about 10 seconds, they only add this so they can claim it's not false advertising but it is. Like every ad that shows +/- type games, this is actually a base upgrade and world map PvP resource stealing game. You spend all your time waiting for buildings to upgrade for hours at a time, then someone steals your stuff anyway if you don't pay for extra defense stuff. No skill, no gameplay, just a cash grab.

Another game where what is shown as the game isn't even close or even in the game for more then a passing second. I like the non advertised game's ideas as another one of those idle games / card battle games ish. The in game ads are there but not as bad as some others. You play with and against other teams. If you aren't on for a day or two they kick you...

Do not believe the advertisements that say "this is real gameplay!" It's not. In fact the type of gameplay that they show in the ads, besides having significantly less graphic fidelity in the game itself, makes up a negligible portion of the actual gameplay. If you thought you were downloading a fun little game where you move troops back and forth while shooting hordes of enemies, I'm here to tell you that 99% of your time is spent doing other things. Also, the game is very much pay to win.

While the game does actually look and somewhat play as advertised, this is a micro transaction game to the max. The leveling up is a grind and the battles become pretty dull after a day or two. It has less to do with decision making on what to shoot down and more to do with if you level up your character. Which is locked behind time walls that require money to speed up and leveling which will also be time drains and or money spent. Overall it's ok, but still feels a bit misleading from as advert

False advertising I found this game from an ad. The ad was making fun of all these fake mobile games where the ads are completely different from the main gameplay, and explicitly said that this game was made to be like the ads. But it isn't. The advertised gameplay is only a small minigame portion of the game, and you need to get into a very complicated base building game to actually make progress. It might still be a fun game, but it is not what I was promised.

Takes forever to upgrade stuff. Sure, it's "free" to download and play, but in order to make it fun, you have to buy upgrades to make it go faster. I got to level 12 and gave up it substantially slows down. Every time you get into the game, they want you to do your "first buy" and spend money on a recruit. Very annoying.

This game started out fun and hooked me for a few weeks. I even made a few in-app purchases, which I rarely ever do. Eventually someone who's been playing the game longer with a stronger army will obliterate your base and undo all the work you've put into the game. At that point I felt totally robbed literally and figuratively.. Un-installed. Goodbye.

One star, because even tho the design and production are pretty good, the gameplay is NOTHING like the ads, AT ALL, there are even ads specifically denying this, but they straight up LIE. The actual game is a bunch of tedious resource gathering, boring levels where you can't choose anything, and overly complicated player vs player nonsense. Such a disappointment. PS the response to this review is a lie too, the option they refer to is also nothing like the gameplay in the ads. Blatant deceit.

Finally! A game that plays like its advertised!... for the first 2 minutes. Then it is exactly like all the other games. It's a trap. This is false advertising. I get that the dumb little mini game ( the reason I downloaded it) is not going to generate as much money, but quit lying right to my face!!! Turns out Homelander is a villain in real life too.

In the beginning they let you play lots of shooting levels like on ads. But as the progression goes, levels get so difficult that you have to grind on the strategy map for days (gathering resources and doing chores) to get strong enough to play one more level and then back to long and tedious grinding. They want you to pay a lot to decrease grind. So the game is 5 star game while they lure you in but at some point you simply can't play advertised levels anymore if you don't pay.

Game is interesting at first then gets super repetitive and you end up hitting a wall by their design where you cannot advance unless you wait hours upon hours to upgrade or you pay real life money to upgrade immediately. Not a fan. If I have some time to kill id like to be able to play the game when I want. Not have to wait 5 hours just to have 4 more mins of play time until I have to wait another 5 hours.

The game is advertised as a take against false advertisement where a developer made a game to be a playable version of the fake games often used for ads but the game is literally hypocritical. Its pay to win, mission based, a base builder somehow and has a scummy tactic at the beginning where you have a time limit to complete a set amount of levels in time or else a bomb goes off and kills a girl (who is depicted with ai art). Quite literally says "these bad mobile games are bad" when it is one.

Great game for awhile. Played for a week or so. It was a fun game. Then, the game started randomly crashing. Sometimes it would happen within 1 minute of the game loading. Once this started I could 15 minutes max before it crashed. This was a rareity. Eventually after several days of the game constantly crashing I uninstalled it for that reason. I love the game but couldn't handle it crashing that much

This is a server game. Bunch a people one server, then eventually you will battle against other servers. It's not a bad overall game. Things I dislike are the wait times and ability to upgrade or get certain heroes. You use stamina in the game to do tasks, but it takes 5 minutes to refill 1 stamina. You use minuim of 5 per task some go up to 20. Upgrading buildings get real lengthy. Feels like a big cash cow game. Pay to win game.

I wish the levels were longer. In fact, I wish the levels didn't end and the game just continued until you died from the difficulty despite upgrading to ridiculous proportions. It's the interruptions that suck. Three stars for being good at what it does but only 3 stars for doing the same thing yet again. Also, I just got a response to this review and wanted to see it posted but when I came here, I was given the option to rate and review, not the ability to view or edit, as per the notification.

I’m extremely disappointed with Last War Survival. The game constantly lags and is riddled with bugs that make it nearly unplayable. When I contacted support, their response was slow and unhelpful. Instead of addressing my concerns, they acted as if I was at fault and demanded proof of the issues. This kind of support is completely unreliable. Overall, the game feels like a waste of time and effort. I can not recommend downloading it; it’s a true disappointment. Save yourself the frustration!

This application an actual dumpster fire. All the talk of the game being just like the ad, but that ends and it forces you to play just another "survival" nonsense "game". It is honestly not even a game. You don't do anything game-like. You don't play it. You just "do" it. You press icons and wait for timers. Please don't waste your time. They paid a lot of money for the ads and sponsorship, and it's all just for a re-skin of every other "survival game" in the app store.

Highly addictive game with a strong social component. Last War's main flaws are time zone matchmaking issues, algorithm problems, terms of service violations, and poor customer service. Last War is a money pit. If you can't spend 75k or more, don't bother downloading. And even then, be prepared to be outplayed by those spending 150k. No balance whatsoever.

Do not get fooled by the crowd control game in the ads; that's just a little side game. The real game is a build and kill game where you are pitted against other players and are forced to play in order to bully others otherwise you will be bullied and whatever you build gets destroyed constantly. And there is no guide so you MUST pay just to protect yourself. What you are up against are jerks that are 30 levels higher and just pick on you constantly. NOT worth your time or your money.

This game started out fun and then it became a requiring you have to log in often to continue to upgrade or pay to do it faster. Only gameplay, like the ads, was the frontline stages but those became extremely difficult after a while requiring 100s of tries, made to level 48 and was never able to beat after 3 weeks. The video suggestions that it shows on how to beat the level is nothing like the game play. My troops move slower and shoot slower with less damage and zombies require more shots.

It is a Hero collection, base builder, the ads show half the combat, (pve) and spec ops. ads are more often the special operations missions, the other half is pvp and its a Real Time powers based combat with your collected heros. There's guilds and they're highly active and supportive. Only because the game is a solid easy entry into the genre is it getting 3 stars. Ads and app page needs to show the full game play not just a single mission type. 😒

I like this game, but other players take a lot of the fun out of it. The mini games and base maintenance are fun, but my biggest complaint is how often other players can pilage your base. There are shields to protect you, but unless you're paying real money, this is not a sustainable option. It's discouraging waking up every morning and seeing your base has been pillaged several times, and you have to spend the day grinding everything back.

The game is not like you sell it, oh and yea you more focused on that selling rather on the game. I just want to play the game, I dont want to upgrade my city for eternity because it takes time for research and building and be annoyed by other players as this is multiplayer. And because it takes eternity to build and develop it will take time until you can play again the zombie part which I came in the first place. 1 star because you dont deserve more

Frontline Breakthrough and Exploration Quest are the most enjoyable game modes, and the reason I downloaded the game in the first place. These 2 modes become unplayable because of the ridiculousness and difficulty of the levels. These modes don't become challenging they become impossible to beat. Even watching the tutorial help videos on YouTube makes no sense because the fire rate of my soldiers is way slower, and the zombies in the tutorial are far slower and less aggressive. Fix it, please.

The start is super easy and the request for review comes way too early. Edit: After putting a night into the game, this has turned into a time-gated base builder and social game that further time-gates the core gameplay loop that we see in the advertisement. As soon as I couldn't actually play the core gameplay loop because I hadn't built my base enough to go on the next mission, I decided to uninstall the game.

This game is barely like any of it advertisement that spam many social media sites/apps. It is just another "build" a base and endlessly upgrade buildings that take hours to complete. This is just a micro transaction scummy business model with some "loot box" mechanics built in. The game is only really worth playing during it's "tutorial" phase where it is most like that advertisements, assuming you thought that kind of a game could be interesting.

Downloaded it solely because the ad annoyed me, turns out it's a city building game?? Got sucked into that for a while, but progress just gets slower and slower while they try to make you buy things. It gets boring after a while and progress without paying for things has you waiting days to build a building... That ultimately doesn't further you much at all. It's a really terrible game.

This game is interesting for a couple of days. However, it quickly becomes very boring. They introduce impossible challenges you can only overcome by waiting hours while 1 "constructor" builds things to earn more points. Most of the gameplay ends up being about waiting for timers to finish. I don't pay, but seriously—why does it take six hours to upgrade just one building? You have to upgrade dozens of buildings!

Typical micro-transaction game. Constant predatory ads to buy stuff. Actual game is point and click rts, but the twist is that all the resources are bought with real money. You have to join alliances to not get constantly steamrolled, and even then, the pressure to spend money to "support" your alliance is real. You can gift in-game items and guess what, bought with real money! Enemies if any level can attack you, so you are often at the mercy of people often double or more your level.

This game lies to you at the beginning of what it is. Turns into a base building game and constantly wants you to spend money to build faster and upgrade. Also wants to force you to join alliances,and if you don't, you will constantly be attacked by high-level players raiding your resources and killing off your troops that takes at least a day to replenish. A constant stream of buy this,buy that game,hard pass on this rubbish.

Game advertises it is the game you see in the ads. It is at first, until it quickly devolves into a squad based sr/ssr hero collecting idle gacha game. Pretty fast the missions go from +20, x3 soldier mobs to attack +% and hero specific firepower boost barrels. You end up building a base that generates resources over time. Building starts resource limited but after level 4 becomes heavily time restricted. Oh and every opportunity, a screen pops up to spend money to buy the newest hero.

Beware! While I did enjoy playing this game, about six months in there was a charge to my credit card for 20 dollars plus tax that stated I bought a key pack (worst pack in the game) which I did not. I disputed it on Google play and it was refunded. Day later my game account was frozen stating my game credit score was negative 20 and the only way for me to access my account was to pay them 20 dollars. An account I had spent money on. Beware of this developer!!!!

Not a bad game, if you want to spend a lot of money anyway. This is a pay to win game, as many phone games are. If you aren't spending 💰, the down times for crafting become very long, very quickly. You also find yourself exposed as others see your weakness and raid any accumulated wealth you may have. While it has been a fun 3 days, I have a rule about not spending money on phone games.

The other reviews talking about the deceptive nature of the ads aren't lying - this is an auto-battler and base builder. I don't personally mind base management, so I stuck with it... I came to terms with the nature of the game and pressed on. Until the forced PvP obliterated my base and set me back days. All while I was offline no less. It isn't what the ads claim, and what it is, is terrible. This is an execrable, disquallifying design. I deeply regret spending any money on this.

Only reason I gave it 1 is so I can post this review. Play was ok but I'm giving this Zero because as soon as I installed the game I started getting ads. Almost Everytime I unlock my phone an add pops up, when I try to close the add it takes me to the play store. I uninstalled the game as soon as I saw the ads start. Now the adds won't stop no matter what I turn off in my settings. I'm VERY UPSET!!!!!! This has basically hijacked my phone!!!

The games starts off relatively fun, but once you get to a point, you are just waiting to pay again. The game is boring and drawn out way to long. If you want to check it out for a bit, it's worth a try but it will get boring to where you can't do anything until you leave up, only to play a 30 second game.... It's not worth your time... No surprise, I ended up deleting it off my phone.

A predatory nothing of a game. it baits you in with a small purchase in the beginning, painted in sex appeal. then it constantly offers you more ways to spend larger sums of money as you go. there is an upsetting number of different currencies and challenge reward page includes ways to spend real money. The gameplay is not fun. it is not a puzzle of how to survive the enemies. it is just click base upgrade button to make numbers up and now you can defeat the level. Get Slay the Spire instead!

No refunds. I made an accidental purchase and contacted support within minutes for a refund. Support said i had already consumed the items. I sent them pictures of all items in my inventory. Support responded "the rule of not being able to apply for refunds". I requested a refund from Google play and was granted a refund. My last war account was locked and the game only brings me a menu to send them money from $1 to $100. Greedy is an understatement.

it has elements of the advertisement those elements feel like an afterthought or rework to please people who wanted to play the simple game in the ad. The extra game elements that are used basically makes this game no different from any other co-op base builder game. find a guild and play your dailies. it's boring aside from the shooting parts.

So, this app is wierd. This game is NOTHING like the advertisement. Hooks you in with a simple idea. Nope. This is a pay for power creep over the games enemy level. Can't grind anything or go back and repeat stages. Every alliance kicks you out after an hour if you're not online every second of the day. They use bots and want you to click on shady links. Odd how this game has 4 stars yet I can't find one review with over 3 stars. Like they bought their review score.....

you don't get to run n gun - you build up a command base - like youre playing animal crossing... Keep building and leveling... When you can run n gun - it's actually fun, it's the long periods of leveling up that make this game 2 stars. That and some of the rewards you earn to help you build faster don't register to your account when you use them. Try CS and they take 48+hrs to tell you that they did. No they didn't, I can do basic math and my coin level never went up.

STAY AWAY!!! This is a great game with one giant flaw. If someone wants to destroy you, they can constantly, every single day, until you stop playing, beat you into the ground. I've been having a blast for 6 weeks. Today, a child with a massive bank ac 20k+ spent. Destroyed our entire server. My options are to pay 20.00 a day, every day, to bubble, move to a new server to start over and lose all money spent on game or stop playing. This is a massive issue that the game designers will not fix.

Unfortunately this game is a bunch of misleading advertisement, and customer support does nothing but gaslight you into believing otherwise. For example: their monthly pass, which is advertised for 30 days, only lasts for 29. I had purchased it two hours before server reset on 8/21, and it expired the same hour on 9/19 (because August has 31 days) - yet Customer Support claims this to be 30 full days, and will do nothing to support you.

Waste of time. More hassle than fun. Bot teams ND players always ready to attack the base unless you spend money. Base shield is expensive, healing rates are lengthy, after one stage you won't be able to grow at all till you pay. In summary, don't bother installing and wasting both time & money. There are better games out there. Hence "uninstalled".

This game is fun but sadly heavily pay-to-win. The purchases are optional but without purchasing, you are just a fodder for stronger players to farm on. Spent thousands on this game just to get wrecked by players who spends even more. Alliance members are leaving one by one due to this, while new content releases just pushes for more money-grabs, leaving a larger and larger gap between low spenders vs high spenders. I don't recommend playing this unless you're prepared to spend tons.

False advertising and refusing select individuals refunds. This game is a war game, not an endless runner game as advertised. If you purchase anything make sure you stay on the CS good side or they will refuse to refund you when you realize that this is scammy. Remember when fortnight got sued for insisting on purchases to progress in the game but then people realized they weren't progressing? If a lawyer starts up a class action against them, please contact me!

What do you know. The game running as saying it's not fake ads, are fake ads. Games play is nothing like the ads, no part of the game is like the ads. If it was there's about 7 games that have identical games play. Dodgy developers in it for excessive money without watching it by giving a good experience. Don't waste your time on a another clone of the same gameplay unlike the ads.

Misleading add campaign, corridor run is only mini game. Progression is artificial and slow without paying into constant micro transactions. There is no level range cap for fair playing amongst players. Game requires little to no skill to play. Cannot play it offline either. Gunna probably stop playing this game soon as it is too expensive and slow to keep up with. It gets repetitive and boring. Only reason I'm giving this another star is the graphics and interactiveness.

Most say at Level 11 it gets very slow, well, no. I would say after level 9 it will, it's a strong pay to win against a 15 second level, I mean look at the packs, biggest pack I saw last time was $100 Who would spend that much money just to pass a level thats shorter than an advertisement, yeah it's a bit accurate compared to the ads I saw, but let's be honest. This sucks, progress is a drag, there's possible power walls you can't pass so you have to replay if not spend to get stronger... Yikes

Run away! I played for most of a year. It is not a terrible game, but the people you meet will be the real value. However, it is pay to win. Not just a little pay. Some people have spent multiple hundreds of thousands of dollars. There is no way you can compete. If you have this type of entertainment budget, you can probably find something better. Why drive a goofy pixel tank when you could drive a real tank?

do not make an in-game purchase! I bought a one week pass $4.99.. the next week I was charged $24.99 not once but twice within a minute for a monthly pass.. I'm currently trying to dispute the transactions to get my money back. I cannot reach anybody who work for the for Last War. It is totally unacceptable to process a purchase that I did not authorize! That's stealing!!

Do you plan to play this garbage game? Please read! I'm playing this thing for over a month. There are a lot of glitches, lots of bugs, but no customer support, no response for long times and no solutions. I'm still waiting solutions for my inquiries. But didn't get response at all, some times they request screenshot for the situation that already past and then no response for a long time again. I'm exhausted, don't make suffer yourself by this game, go find another. They only know how to take

Starts out good. Fun in the early parts, building, killing zombies, mini missions. Then, when you get in the teens and a good size army, you get wiped out and destroyed by players way higher level every few days and literally can't do anything cause you have no troops. So basically a big waste of time. Not worth it. Pass this one.

Ads are simulated game play, and the worst kind fake bad play hoping you will want to prove you can do it better. You know I loved Galaxa when I was young, playing vintage arcade games. So take any generic mini MMO and skin Galaxa, that's what you have here. Locked progression, super basic world map, seen it a million times mechanics, and a constant cash grab for everything. It's not a good game, it's not original, it's tedious on purpose in order to pressure you to spend cash.

Too much superfluous B.S. The game, the shooting part of the game, is fun. But they put so much excess stuff, like building camps and roads and buildings. It's just too much of NOT what I downloaded the game for. Notice that when they advertise the game, they only show the shooting part... because all the rest is BORING.

this is literally the worst game I have ever played. it's completely mindless slop. I wanted the simple reaction based puzzle game shown in the ads and it's technically there but it's buried deep under so many layers of useless slop that it's completely unenjoyable. this game has no soul annoying audio and I'm like 80% sure it's using ai generated assets. it may be ad free but it shoves micro transactions down your throat at every turn. avoid at all costs. do not install.

Game is an actual scam, I tried my hardest to lose each round, but it was impossible to lose. It's just another scam city building game to Rob you of your time. I went until you weren't allowed to play the Game anymore until you have to build a tavern which will exponentially grow in time until it takes a week until you can play the game for what it's advertised to play.

Gets less fun the longer you play it. I am on day 36, there are no more zombie levels around my area. The game is now all about leveling up head quarters (now takes 2 days to upgrade, level 17) and other buildings and things so head quarters can actually be upgraded, and radar games are performed by the computer. I would say this game got increasingly less fun each day after about 3 days. I hung in there so I could give an accurate review. So, in short it's boring.

After seeing a hundred ads saying, "it's ACTUALLY like the ads!" I decided to try it. It's just a stick figure running in a straight line, making math-based choices to level up the squad, right? It's nothing like the ads. There's levels kind of like that, but it's not a casual game about quick math, it's build your fort so you can build up your heros so you can play another level so you can build up your fort. A few hours in and already several hours of construction between unlocking a stage.

Not like the ads. Misleading. The sections that do look like the ads and the screenshots have zero affect on the main gameplay which is some Farmville esque base building game. If you lose the "battle" sequences shown in the ads and screenshots, you can retry or skip. Skipping dumps you back to the main game the same as if you successfully completed the "mission". They don't show any of the base building in the ads or the screenshots. It's intentionally misleading.

Starts out great, then loses its appeal. The beginning of the game is great! Leveling up and creating the base, but after you start leveling up, it takes way to long to continue. It literally takes HOURS to level up the units within the base and takes a lot of effort to upgrade your team. I get things take time, but 24 hours to level up you home base...that's unplayable. Would be 5 stars if didn't take so long to level up everything!

Once again its just another city building game that they "fail to mention" in the ad. So, false advertisement, which isn't a surprise now days. If you do decide to build the city to play the "those puzzles," you need to build a team and play some other puzzles first. Well, those suck and the team needs the city to get better. You see where this is going. If i could give it zero stars and it count, I would, so it gets 1 star. It's totally a play to win game, of course.

Such a money grab. I was having fun with the game, but it got tedious with the wait times for the construction, so i bought an extra builder thinking that the purchase was account bound. NOPE. I had 3 commanders going on at the same time. If you want 2 builders, you have to purchase them for each commander. So, i requested a refund. I got the refund, but now, according to the game, i have a negative credit. So, unless i pay them, i am unable to play the game. Total BS.

The ads are lies. I wanted to run down the road and shoot stuff like the videos show. You spend very little time doing that, and the levels are extremely short. You spend 95% of your time upgrading your base and units and going in and out of nested menus collecting boxes of stuff you can never use up because it takes forever to upgrade anything. Absolutely boring, very little action.

Starts off with gameplay reminiscent of the ad and is pretty enjoyable, cumulating in a boss fight with a zombie dog. Then it became all about base building with next to zero explanation of the mechanics and resources. Maybe if I stuck with it there would be more of what I actually downloaded it for (the dodging and multiplication game) but I'm not going to jump through hoops to get to the gameplay I want to when I can just uninstall.

Misleading in-game offers. Like most free-to-play games there are many things you can buy to enhance gameplay but they are not clear on what you receive. Example: Initially you are limited to 1 building upgrade at a time. After paying to "permanently enable build queue" you'd expect to be able to queue up multiple upgrades. Wrong. Your "queue" will have a limit of 2, unless you upgrade again for 4x more. Not sure what the limit would be with another upgrade. Not going to find out.

Don't play this game. First, unless you are on a boss level, you don't shoot the enemy. You automatically lose. Next, the nice characters and etc are too big for the road so you'll lose most of them. Finally, it turns to a base game after completing the first mission. So yes the game has the basics of what they promised. The executionis horrible.

Firstly, the game has nothing to do with the ads. Secondly, it is a totally Pay to Win game. People pay for heroes and to get them strong and the events costs hundreds if you want to get at least something. I spend a few dollars, but some others invested so much that I can't even play anymore without getting my soldiers dead and bade destroyed constantly. I gave up!

The game starts out very fun but around level 11 it slows down like crazy. Everything takes sooooooo long to upgrade and it just gets worse with every level after that. The game is made in a way to get you addicted to it, so then you spend tons of real money on in-game purchases in order to speed up the process of upgrading. I don't mind in-game purchases for $1 or $2, but most packs here are worth between $20 and $100!!! Who in their right mind would spend that much on a mobile game??

The adverts for this game are misleading. And for a game of the strategy genre, this one is only really playable of you are prepared to pay a lot. The game limits resources, marches, hero shards, building upgrades, energy. You either have to be prepared to slowly chip away at progress over many months in frustration, or pay exorbitant prices to stay competitive. There are many other better options in this category of game.

If you were hoping to play something that looked like what they're showing in those YouTube ads, don't bother. This is mostly just a weird military base-building thing where you have to wait hours for progress to finish unless you pay hundreds of dollars. The actual gameplay where you're running down a road shooting at zombies is just a TINY part of this mess. Your choices don't have any impact on if you win or lose; the game already decides that for you. Pay up or lose the level every time.

The game started beautifully. But as I move towards higher levels, the time to achieve projects begins to stretch. It's now fallen into frustration. Instead of moving forward uninterrupted, I now have to stop playing for a days in order for the game to catch up with instructions. (And this is only level 20) so I can just imagine how much MORE frustrating it's going to get. SO... ,- I'm already tired of it and I'll uninstall, Too bad

Ads looked cool, so I downloaded it. Ads account for about 25% of the game. I gave it 3 weeks and about $5 to get an early boost. The various events are cool and keep things interesting, but it's not worth my time anymore. Make the attacks competitive, and the game would be tremendously better. There's no point in letting Level 120 pay-to-play whales attack newbie peons. Do better! Ciao.

this game is a money pit. a guy in my server (GT Alfagiftnolimit) has spent close to 1m (maybe more) and he gets beaten by people who've spent considerably more (eg; Wotizdiz, Valec, Prison mike etc etc.. you cannot compete in any way as a free-to-play player.. just not possible.. save your money.. buy a/another house

Good for about 2 days then it takes far too long to upgrade the buildings, heroes and skills research to be able to progress past levels (can take days to upgrade HQ). Constant attacks from other players deplete slow to gather resources with no way to stop other players from stealing your stuff (should not be attacked if not in an alliance). It is a clear design to get you interested initially and then try to get as much money from you as possible. Must be prepared to pay to win, and pay a lot.

Like many of these games nowadays, the game doesn't stay anything like advertised. It turns into the usual spend money to upgrade your base more than the next person so they don't kill/steal all your resources. What's pictured in the screenshots(advertised) is not what the game ends up being like. After you beat the first 100 levels that part of the game (the fun part) disappears.

I'm all for upgrading kind of games, but there is the element of grind. The ads shown are only a small part. It gets to a point where it's not about skill but how strong your characters are. Upgrading does take too long like others have said. Level 7 is where I started noticing I just had to login, select which building to upgrade and then stop playing until that was finished. Edit: Lvl 12 and the numbers to upgrade are all out of whack and not worth playing. The grind is painstaking.

It's not *EXACTLY* what it says in the sponsored ads. I mean, yeah: it is a shooting game where you move left and right, and you shoot these barrels and screens to power-up. But, in total originality: it's just mainly another one of those "world PVE/PVP" type of game. There's Heroes, Alliances, World, even Base-to-Upgrade mechanics that's (sadly) not expected to the Ad. Sorry, but what a letdown.

Complete garbage. Every other game like this gives you a shield when you lose a defensive battle. That's because developers with a modicum (that means small amount) of intelligence know if you lose a fight, then have no more troops, you're more likely to lose again. I keep getting attacked and can't even build up a decent defense. And the ads are dishonest.

In-app purchases are misleading, and support is terrible. I recently purchased a pack for $99 that gave the impression of daily rewards, but it only provided one day of rewards. I contacted support and was informed that it was a one time award. I asked that they refund me and claw back the items I received. Any reputable gaming company would offer some level of customer service, esp. given how much I've already spent to level up and they declined. Don't waste your time or money on this game.

If you're interested in playing the running games that are advertised, DO NOT PICK THIS GAME. The vast majority of this game is camp building and leveling those buildings. You will get to a point where you cannot beat one (or any) of the actual running levels without slowly and painfully or expensively leveling your camp. You will go days at a time without being able to play a running level because you have to level your camp to be strong enough to beat the level. Parasitic game design.

This should be fraudulent advertising. the game is actually a pay to win base building game that has been designed to separate you from your money ASAP, hence the marketing budget. The portion that you see on their ads is only even slightly similar to a miniscule part of the game and even then, that's a stretch. On the plus side, after playing this game I assume that all of their games advertised on YouTube are also fraudulent and don't bother engaging. Terrible, terrible product

Playing almost 1.5 years in this game. At first the first and second season is exciting but things start getting repetitive with just slight changes to themes for each season. and the pay to win becomes more apparent as the season progresses. the logic of how true strength/power is measured is heavily questionable at times. the majority of the time low spenders and free to play gamers are just entertainment to the high spenders. game was good in the beginning (season 1 & 2), but not anymore.

I'm done with this game. There's the most greediest game I have ever seen and played. The upgrade takes too long. the second research lab You had to buy with $10. Extra builders, you have to buy ten dollars each... Stay away from this game, and go to some other game. And not enough elite heroes . The list goes on on.......

I'm convinced the "just like the ads" reviews are paid/bots/heavily incentivized to say this exact phrase. 99%+ of the game is NOTHING like the ads. It feels like it was designed by AI to be as addictive as possible. Winning doesn't feel possible w/o spending money, but there is no "win." You move to harder and harder servers to spend more and more to move money, rinse/repeat without end. The best thing I've ever done related to video gaming was to delete this game.
not like the ad. ad claims gameplay is what you see. first thing you have to do is build a base not start like the ad shows. another disappointing game that promises one thing but doesn't deliver.

The idea of the game is good and technically it works. For me this game has too major problems: it's virtually impossible to be competitive if you don't spend money. If you don't spend money you're basically part of the foodchain for the big spenders. The other problem is that game activities that provide big bonus are group, scheduled activities and especially at times that are incompatible with family life. This is exactly the same game as Last Asylum with slightly amended graphics

The customer support team for this game is a complete joke. All they seem to care about is money—there’s no consistency, no real standards, yet they expect players to follow rules they don’t even enforce properly themselves. I wouldn’t recommend this game to anyone unless you enjoy spending a lot of money with nothing meaningful to show for it. Players deserve better than this.

In the last war I mostly liked the "High noon" mini game. Suggestion/Request: if possible make a separate game to play unlimited stages. Request you to create another separate Application for High Noon game....

Totally not what you're expecting. If you came here looking at the ads and thought that looks like a light game to have some quick fun, well think again. What they don't show you is that this is mainly one of those base building games that are a dime a dozen out there and requires a lot of management and time, not to mention the endless moneytization all over including locked units behind paywalls.

Pretty boring and repetitive after a while. The performance is decent on an older phone. You don't really need to do much with the base builder portion, but you have to progress the base to play the action component. The action component doesn't really change much, you get different heroes and there is some strategy to it, but you basically need to do the base builder so you can upgrade the heroes as the enemies level up each additional round, hence pretty boring and repetitive.
it's actually like the ad they show and not junk 5⭐ from me

Starts with some actual gameplay in the arcade modes, but after you finish it you are only left with a slow builder game, constantly waiting for upgrades so you become strong enough to finish the next stage (skill is no issue, you are either to weak to break a barrier or you can finish the level without moving your dudes) All that you are left with is a crapton of chores which are not fun at all. Overall, very low effort in the gameplay, high effort in keeping you in the app.

This could have been the best mobile single player game of the decade...sadly, players are forced into alliances for protection from other players. I would gladly pay $100 for a single player version of this game. The sad thing is this game would have been a shitload more profitable if it was marketed as a single player game with a free 2 day trial and then the final price kicks in. This is an incredibly well polished game...and is ruined by the multi player aspect.

This game was fun in the beginning when upgrades only took a few minutes. Pretty quickly upgrades started taking hours. Now there is verry little playing and wayyyyy too much time spent waiting on upgrades. Now I'm further in the game and buildings are taking 12 hours or longer to upgrade. I played this game for hours in the beginning. Now after 5 minutes there is nothing left to do but go away and wait until tomorrow for upgrades to to complete and there are tons of upgrades needed.

Not worthy of time. This is another reward collecting app. I am surprised I had literally zero ads (except ongoing paid offers), but it's another game where you build base and 10% of gameplay is the actual zombie shooting. The rounds are primitively easy and extremely short. Tried this for two days and I'm out Two stars just for no ads. Suitable for players with low IQ.

Yes, the general play is different than I expected. We do get access to the minigames you see in the ads, but we're limited to one successful round. I personally would love a way to replay old levels, especially after I made it past 40. Several boards do feel impossible but if you plug away at it eventually you get the hang of it. I am very much enjoying the alliance aspects of the game. I like doing events. I love that you don't have to spend money to level up. Time invested works just as well.

It's the game from the commercial that slowly morphs into a base building game, if you have a good alliance, it can be fun. However, they change the warzone duel scoring where a single whale can buy invasion rights for a server by massively increasing the points for one single player objective and discounting all points earned by a team. I think I'm done spending money.

This game will try to nickel and dime you at every moment with packs and battle passes. The game is mostly about base building and collecting heroes that are used to fight enemies. The grind isn't too bad the first day. After a day or two of building. Upgrades will start taking up to 6 to 10 hours to complete or spend real money. Pvp is a big part of the game, which is horrible in any game that has pay to win. Save your time and money and dont play.

I uninstalled to take a break, as I was annoyed by their tactics to get me to pay for things; eventhough, I was able to get characters to Lvl 45 without paying, and had a handful of top tier characters. When I reinstalled the Game, all my progress was gone. WHAT!? What kind of bullcrap is this?! Or, is this what happens, when your settlement is completely destroyed? I wasn't notified as such! Also, the YouTube adverts, look nothing like this "fake Game". Isn't baiting and switching illegal?!

The most pay to win gave I've ever come across. It's been out for a while now and everyone is stronger than you. You don't have the money to spend to keep up, and if you did they just introduce some new mechanic to wipe out most of your progress to force you to spend money again. Don't bother starting to play as it will only frustrate you and rob you of your spending cash. Find something different to kill the time. I wish I did earlier. Also no how-to, wiki, or real support can be found anywhere

it's very nice in the beginning, but after level 40 (if not wrong) to make some progress takes a long time if we don't buy packages. What turned me off was that the slow progress is even worse when big players attack small players all the time.... there should be protection, big players should only attack big players... we can buy protection... but well not everyone can't spend so much money..., if you like slow paced games this is for you.... but not as fun as advertised

The game isn't like the ads. You only get a little bit of the actual running and doing the quests. But it's mainly about building alliances, and people in servers putting NAP (Non aggressive passivity) into play. The game is made for you to attack trucks, plunder secret tasks and attack other commanders & alliances. But when certain alliances get together and plan that they don't want you attacking on the very server you're on its not the way the game was created. And it's cliqueish.

Started off really fun. A lot to do , building ,recruiting fun mini games and a true sense pf progression. A day later however everything came to a stop, having to wait 10-15 hours to complete a building , progression totally halted as there is nothing else to do even being in an allience , my heroes are too weak to progress unless i keep buying packs which would be fine i occasionally do but here occasionally doesn't apply you have to keep buying.Not paying 100+€,this ain't Assasins Creed!!

There needs to be a patch dealing with Frontline Breakthrough level 13 and 16. Take a look online and see if you're getting positive or negative feedback about these two levels. This is the only part of the game that's fun to play, and you've set up two levels so that you have to play them 1,000 times each and maybe luck works once. Your tutorial video is a complete lie because the zombies die in only two shots (which they do not) and the rate of fire is twice as fast as it is in game.

gets really grindy after a while to play the game advertised. It incorporates a whole bunch of other games within the world you play in, only one really requires skill to in both dexterity and puzzling, unfortunately they choke down how much you can play that game, I suppose to try make money or draw it out. I was pleasantly surprised how tricky some of the levels were. was fun for a bit, but got so bogged down in all the other sides of the game and clicking all the reward things so deleted it.

Fun... for a couple days, then you hit the pay wall. Once you've cleared tiles around your base, the time for building upgrades becomes days and the "fun" gameplay stops. Much of your time will be spent clicking red dots to clear notifications for the myriad of daily achievements and free rewards. The rewards are largely meaningless and do nothing to get you back to the advertised gameplay. To progress, you will need to spent a lot of money or wait weeks for building upgrades.

This is a pay to win game. No, you can't play free. Installing and playing like a farm game a war game isn't optional. Prepare to spend at least 1000 dollars per week, if you want to really play and be competitive. Otherwise you would only be around and do nothing. It's by design that way. All events, all activities, would be useless if you don't spend a lot of money. Yes, below they will write, that can be played free. But it's a lie. You would need months for things wales get in weeks.

Its sole purpose is to hook you into an endless cycle of addiction and drain your wallet at every turn. There’s no real enjoyment, no meaningful progression—just a carefully designed trap that pushes you to keep spending, again and again. It doesn’t feel like a game; it feels like gambling disguised as entertainment.

Wish I could enjoy the game with a single purchase...instead you need to pay constantly to keep playing. They may say the game is free to play, but with all of these scam games, you reach a point where you cannot advance without a purchase. You can technically keep playing, but I don't understand why anyone would. My advice is to go pay a developer a one-time fee and enjoy playing the game you purchased!

I really wanted to enjoy this game, but the core mechanics end up encouraging toxic behavior. Stronger players can easily dominate and bully entire servers, and there’s little to no system in place to prevent it. It becomes frustrating, especially for players who spend money expecting a fair and competitive experience. Without proper balance or protections, the game feels less like strategy and more like survival against whales. This needs to be reported to the authorities.

I would just like to ask why is it that my Taiwan and Hong Kong friends playing the game are unable to see the flag next to all the names? I am able to see my flag and all their flags next to their names but they are not able to. is there a reason? just curious since they are asking too. Other than this, great experience playing it and getting to know new friends

Looks kind of like the ads, base building sucks, filled with micro transactions (that don't work), clash of clans time based base-building, time based world map, 24 hour timed quest that you can't complete. This game isn't worth the time. Spent a dollar to get the blonde bimbo with the aa missile battery, didn't get the pfp or anything that came with the purchase except the unit. The items are still in my inbox, saying they are claimed, and yet I own zero.

This is the best Mobile strategy game i ever played i recommend everyone to play this game it's has some rules that where it gives fun everyone from the age of 18 and above should play course it crossed server war system that give more fun to compete ourselves course of the rule in war with server i recommend from teenagers, adult, and mature people should play this game the more i played by knowing the game system the more fun u get. The game has president system like the politics. Its fun.

All the advertising is fake.. the game has nothing to do with what you see in the videos that pop up on social media, there is no strategy in the game, you just upgrade heroes and do attackes that you have no control over.. if ur troop has more power than the other troops, then u win. It is a math game, not a war game. U collect .. upgrade .. press attack.. and you don't even see the battle that supposedly took place 🤣 Silly game.

Boring, this game tried to be clash of clans + some other empire game + the ads game. And it's junk all over the place. People just want and endless version of the ad game, using the temple run formula of open, play, repeat. No menus, no cities, no building. Edit: and where would that part of the game is? How much time do I need to spend until it is unlocked? Edit: Nobody cares if it's in "special ops" of you need to waste your time doing everything else before unlocking that mode.

Another game that has a strong premise and fun gameplay, and then proceeds to paywall you with timegates, damage numbers, and lootbox heroes to the point where the gameplay no longer matters. Even the for 'fun' side missions are designed to not be puzzles but practically random chances at progression. This game just wants your money. Pass.

Un-installed 5 minutes after downloading. How can you advertise explicitly "this is actual gameplay footage". The devs are responding to negative reviews saying that the advertised gameplay is in the "special operations" part of the game. I've played that and it's not the same. What a scam. It has to be illegal to explicitly lie in an ad, right?

This game is a lot of fun, but I do think the ads are pretty misleading. The "running soldier" thing with multipliers etc. is a very, very small part of this game after the first few days. Imo the "Clear the District" and "Frontline Breakthrough" modes should have a weekly reset so you always have something like that to do while you wait for a dozen timers to tick down.

It's an ok game but it's honestly frustratingly impossible to play unless you're planning to spend thousands of dollars. It can take weeks to complete buildings and power ups needed to progress to the next level which leads you to spending hundreds a week to speed through it. The devs make a killing from it so it's not something they'll ever fix/change.

99% of the game is pay-to-win base building attack/defend garbage you can get in a million other games. No, you don't HAVE to pay to play, but if you don't, you will get bent over and reamed by people who do. The advertised part of the game is locked behind HQ level, and will eventually take literal days to unlock the next set of levels, which have zero replayability as far as I've seen. Not worth your time, definitely not worth the money they want for new heroes and battle passes.

I just wanted an app to run through the levels and try to choose the right path like you see in the videos. This does a pretty good job of that, but then you have to star building stuff and upgrading it. You get materials by completing some kind of task, but every time I log in all my soldiers are missing or everything is on fire with no explanation why. Uninstalling and trying another one. Why is it so hard to build a game that does what the ad says?!?

This game is NOT like the ads or pictures. It's a pile of different kinds of trash. Micro transaction everywhere and has no real gameplay. This game consist on tapping random stuff to get like million stuff that I'm not sure what the stuff is for. No gameplay whatsoever and it's not fun at all. When you finally get the action shooter part, it lasts like 30 seconds and it does not matter if you move or not. It automatically shoots at everything. Character design is great.

The building part is fun and not that bad. the only reason for 1 star ( was 3 star ) is breakthrough. Some of the levels are stupid hard, you don't start firing until the objects are halfway to you, and by then, it's all on luck. They make it almost impossible to win, i can understand to make a level challenging but some make the game not fun. Coming close to uninstalling just because of breakthrough.

The "exposing fake games" ads are lies, well more like exaggerations. The "spec ops" or stages are just 30 seconds and you don't even have to move to win. Then you start building a base but none of it makes sense. You just spam unlock some buildings but you still get the same boring 30 second spec ops. The heroes have some lines to push an absolute bare bones narrative. Tic tac toe against a computer is more fun and engaging than this.

Great game at first. Leveling up, building your safe home, battling foes, great side games. Nothing like the ads but whatever. Way to overpriced!!!! Had a club that just sat on top of our club and just hammered us completely! Shields are difficult to buy and don't last long. I club got hit 4 times in a matter of 4 hours and don't seem to be moving on. Oh well fun while it lasted

Not the game from the ads, it's a lie. Don't bother. The soldier lane part is just a mini game in the first 3 minutes and occasionally later in. The majority of the game is yet another reskin of the base building attack opponents game which has been around since the 90s. The rare occasions soldier lane is present is repetitive and boring - most of the time I don't even need to press a button and it just walks to the end.

This is game is 90% base building and alliance focused with very few actual zombie battling levels, especially once you clear the initial zone. After that it becomes almost completely base building focused, which after a certain level pretty much grinds to a halt unless you pay (with actual money) for unlocks/bonuses/etc. since some actions take 24 hours or longer to complete. They definitely hook you early with the zombie battling but quickly turn it into pay to play. Unless you like waiting.

I knew going in that the ads only show a fraction of the game. The game revolves around building up a base to fight off the zombie hoard. When you first start building, you are attacked with ad deals that claim to be 99% off and offer great savings. The base building aspect is fast at first but grinds to a halt after level 7. Then, the repetitive aspect gets boring if you don't spend your soul for this game to progress. The hero leveling costs pennies then jumps to millions. Do not even download

Fun ... Addictive ... EXPENSIVE! As many have pointed out, it's a great game that will hook you quick, but if you want to get anywhere or even survive, get ready to grind and spend $. I would gladly give this game more stars, which would be deserved, if they changed a few aspects. Stop charging so much Gold for EVERYTHING! If I'm already spending all of my EXP, Steel, etc, don't take all my gold! Reduce the wait time for free Stamina, and give us better options to collect it on our own.
