The first several levels expanding the base are exactly what I wanted to play and why I downloaded the game. But then they relegate the actually fun part to a side quest partway through. And you get about 6 levels of fun at a time, then you have to spend the next 3-5 days upgrading your base before you can have any more fun. The building wait takes longer and longer for each level. This is a waiting simulator... But the game I want to play is buried in there somewhere, so I gave 2 stars.

This game is great. Easy to play and learn. The serious complaint I have is the troop training times kill your play time. I'm considering quitting the game over it. If you lose your troops in battle it takes 14 hours to retrain 1/4 of your total troops count. It's the worst thing ever. You literally can hardly play for 2-4 days as you rebuild troops. And if you get attacked and lose troops again. There is another 2-4 days. They need to reduce troop training times. 8 hours max to have full troops

This game was decent in the beginning. After 100 days, I'm less than impressed. Devs seem more concerned about adding new servers than fixing the constant issues in the game. Every update breaks something else. Only way to truly excel is to spend hundreds of $$. Login issues with no announcements of an update. If it weren't for the people, this game would've been un-installed by now.

Misleading ads. Those actions parts that you see in the ads, that only takes up a minor part of the game. Even so, it looks totally different from the ads. What a joke because they have a cringy ad that explicitly says it is the same as the ad. The rest of the game is just the usual grindy CoC style game. Lots of upgrading, pay to reduce cool down time.

I recently changed my mobile phone. And after installing the game on my new phone, it is starting again from base lvl 1. Although I had updated my base to level 13. I don't know I am not able to switch to my old version of the game.

The most stupid thing I've ever tried to play. I spend 20 minutes just clicking everywhere just to try and make so ething happen. Managed to get one shoot out then that was it nothing else, I tried clicking everywhere and could not get a game started. the demo looks luke fun but to hard to work out how to play. Uninstall as it was a waste of time.

The game they advertise is present, sort of. It's actually a base builder with timers to force you to pay to be able to do *that*, plus some multi-player something I couldn't be bothered with. Jump through enough hoops and you can play a few levels of the game they advertise before the game prevents you from doing so again.

The game is not as advertised but you do get some features to play what is advertised. The game is a slow building game and to progress it's about spending money, which would ad up significantly over time, as some of the packs are very expensive. The is no instructions or manual to learn more about the features of the game, it is fun to kill time and if you have patience.

Initial stages and upgrading headquarters was quick. Now, the more you upgrade and level up your headquarter, the more time needs to be spend to level up buildings and other parts. Moreover, we can't level up 2 or 3 things simultaneously. When you reach at level 15 or more, it take more than 24 hours to level up. Pathetic. Now the game is getting boring day by day.

Ok. This game is solely based on p2p. The more money you spend, the better you will be. Why can't games just be based on doing the work and skill. You want to make money off the game. Make skins that add the ability to change the appearance of something. Not the ability to make your character extremely strong and overpowered. The average Joe just wants to play the game and kill some time. Do better.

Very good game, I had a problem with in-game purchases and asked customer service and they responded well and in less than 1 day, my money was returned and I was able to enjoying this game again, with relief I hope this game continues to develop further

I downloaded it, the mini games in the games are similar to the ads they have. There are packs for you to purchase but they aren't necessary. This game is pretty much a more animated version of Guns of Glory, there are a lot of similarities. These types of games aren't new and have been around forever. There are some bugs which make the game worse for others. The biggest one is not every alliance member shows as apart of your alliance and you can attack them, which is straight up unfair.

The advertisement gave the impression that it was great for solo play from the initial minigame, but that is a small part of the game. Progressing the game solo is very difficult. The shields to protect the base from high level players cost too much for the short time they last unless you want to pay a fortune of money to get them. There needs to be an option between PvP or PvE servers. PvP only servers make it very difficult to progress in the game. Forced base relocation needs to be removed.

Fun at first. You might grind to level 15 without spending any real cash but progress halts abruptly at that point if you don't spend money. Non paying players essentially become cannon fodder for paying players. Once progress stops because everything in game becomes so expensive in game currency, the fun is gone. That's maybe a week of play top. If you're prepared to pay real dough, then it could be a fun game. I'm not.

Ad campaign is about how this game is "real" but ironically that's also a big lie. This is a horrible "game" that should be avoided at all costs. Update: they keep responding to people trying to convince them that the game is totally real and not a lie, but it's a very very small side mode that you can play with no benefit to the main game. A dishonest studio with a garbage product trying to con whales into paying. There isn't a single creative bone in this studios body.

Great for a week or two, then very slow. Pay to win game. Stuff from adds are fun but become rare to play and very frustrating. Level up and play a few more frustrating rounds. Battles are automated, no skill needed. A few fun events to play, but pay to win. Mostly click and wait to level...days for higher level buildings. Wallet Warriors rule, making hard to keep up unless you buy stuff.

Not what's shown in the ads at all. Maybe it eventually gets there but I'm not going to waste hours/days to find out. Here's a novel idea, deliver the game you show people in the ad EDIT: the developer claims there is another game play mode where you can play the advertised game but I have yet to find it. If it does exist it's so well hidden that you're better off playing their core base building game. Good luck if you choose to download, just not for me.

It was too good to be true. This isn’t an offline, single-player game for relaxing. No ads, but they push in-game purchases and alliances—groups that expect you online 24/7, grinding for power to fight endless wars. Want to level up solo? Not without wasting lots of money. Those ad games? Real but last seconds, and only if you're strong enough. Otherwise, it's endless grinding, waiting HOURS to upgrade—if no one burns your base first. Not worth it unless you're ready to no-life the game.

Played for a week and uninstalled. The actual and soldier/hero control combat games are very fun, but everything else kinda stinks. You only get to do more gameplay as you level up your base, and base management is a chore. I know this shouldn't be a surprise, but literally E V E R Y T H I N G is geared toward making you impatient and wasting money on micro transactions. Fun gameplay, but once I realized that I had waited a full day just to do the actual fun gameplay, I was out.

As others have said, nothing like the ads. this is mostly a base building PVP game. It has most of the same gameplay problems as those pay2win base building games. It's very pay2win with "whales" farming free players. It lacks many features that are typical of games like this.Shields are very expensive, so protection is low. The in game chat, or anything text based, is absolutely horrible to the point of dysfunctional. Unless you want a zombie theme "Game of War" wallet vacuum.

The funny thing is, the game Antony plays in the Ad is not the same as this game. It's similar in a few ways, but he's not playing this game. This game is a predatory in app purchase clicker with occasional scrolling sequences, it is not a scrolling sequence puzzle shooter. There's very little game play in this game, and a lot of slots-machine-app like predatory in app purchase spam 1 star, boring garb, there's no thought in the actual gameplay sequences, just pay to power up

I liked the game in the beginning. I still do play, but I don't spend money on the game anymore. One thing that gets me mad... I accumulate these red stones to get new survivors because that's the only way survivor for your base. So the survivor cost 500 red stones, they'll have legendary and exotic, but you'll never get the best. The game is just a money pit.

I'm not sure why this and other games have an increased time per level scheme. It makes the game unattractive quickly. Sure it's fun for a moment... but that passes and frustration overtakes that.... not sure how or why developers even consider that route. It's basically self-sabotaging your own game. The inconsistencies that have shown up over time in the game seems as though a trap to get people to throw away money. the game won't load.

Giving it a 3/5 because it's fun if you play with the right folks. The gameplay has NOTHING to do with the ads and screenshots. The game starts you off with a similar gameplay but that quickly goes away. There are tutorials on stuff that never shows up again. The actual game is more of a server war between your alliance vs other alliances on the same server or even different servers. It'd be actually more fun if it were skill based but it's just waiting a lot. Pay money and wait less to level.

You do minor bs all week to go to war once a week. Takes 2 weeks to fill up on troops so you can either participate with half a base and gotta pick and choose which war to participate in. If your not a high level (I'm level 28/30) then get used to getting destroyed. Pretty much it's a rich man's game, you don't put money in then your not having that much fun once a week

Do not play until fixed!!! We all know it's a money pit, which is fine as you know what you're walking into. The issue is The game system is broken, and people report people all the time with fake reports to constantly get players muted for 24-72 hours at a time. They will not fix this issue. Run as fast as you can. We have a server with multiple fake accounts that submit fake reports and fake photos to Custome service.

I deleted my previous review of five stars and if I could give zero Stars I would now, the customer service and development team are horrible, I did not receive a single season point for season 3 and they are trying to tell me that I received it and spent the points, I did not spend the points and did not receive them because the time that they said I spent my points I was offline dealing with medical emergencies in the family, showed them proof that I did not spend anything but still was wrong

It's a cash grab. In some ways I'm fine with that if the game is good. In this case they can't manage higher level game play where you input hours on hours to progress for them to create a situation where you option is to rebuild for 2 weeks or pay 300$. Ultimately they got some money out of me and that's the point of the game. If you make it to become competitive then things fall apart, the contests glitch and don't assign points or the wars become a free for all with zero strategy.

this game is a trash don't download it in ad it's different and when you install it then different this game only needs to extract money and nothing else if I could then I would give soo many bad words to this filthy game the only good thing for this game is it made me some good friends except that nothing else just wasted my time
the actual game play they show is fun to figure out but the rest of the game is way to busy and too many points to manage and the interface has way to many alerts.

Bloated. Ad says it's just a red/blue shooter game and nothing else, unlike other gsmes. Funny enough, it is just like all the other bloated trash. It has extra garbage like alliances, buikding up village or whatever. Steep learning curve, so I deleted it. Ran in to it's ad on tiktok and forgot I had downloaded it before. So I deleted it for the second time. I wouldn't leave this 1 star review if they didn't make such misleading advertisements.

This have is nothing as advertised, when you first start it send as though it could eventually be but it ends up being a time based base building game more than anything where you wait for hours to days the father you develope and game progress is locked behind level progression. It's a good time waist if you just want to log on here and there throughout the day to collect resources the accomplish basic tasks
Fun game overall. a lot of scammers trying to refer you on discord for other games. can become pricey to play. expect to spend about $20 overall to unlock useful features.

as most games things take time to build, but you're restricted by having to join a team, you loose soldier's and resources to quickly and it then takes too much time to heal and gain resources, it's more geared up for those who enjoy paying for it, you can watch video to get free stuff, but again it takes time and for little rewards, often not getting the rewards after watching rubbish and you end up watching it again, I'm now going to uninstall it, I got to level 25, without paying

Good at the start and is as advertised. Later loses the advertised game and, more frustratingly, becomes unbalanced PVP. Uninstalled it after multiple alerts I'm about to be attacked after a higher level has killed all my troops. Need to spend 1,000s of in-game currency to avoid being attacked for A DAY. Once your troops are too low, you're stuck with passive building and research.

The ads for this game are so misleading. The stuff portrayed in the ads is certainly in the game. But what they don't tell you is That's not the central part of the game, it takes some time to get there and when you do get there; the part of the game featured in the ad is a grand total of about 10 minutes of gameplay a week. Worse yet, this is one of those games where your regularly encouraged to go attack other players. So you either spend money, or you just get picked on and destroyed.
too much loading. Takes forever. Game play ok. Same adventure build a city set up as all the rest. Nothing special except how frustrating it is to not get anywhere

Last war survival game is a "game" where you tap on a screen to watch numbers go up then wait 5 hours realtime to watch them go up again all so you can stare at poorly animated renders of mediocre ai generated "art". You want a superior experience to"last war" go type in ai generated on rule34 while playing cookie clicker in the other hand. There I just saved you time, money and I helped you get your jollies off. Your welcome.

Connection Errors, game is quite different from ads, it encourages purchases of strong heroes to get anything done. Zombies can end up beside and behind you. Base building is a slog, which is typical of free to play games. +units banners/powerups start in the steep negatives, I've never been able to geab those when positive unless they intentionally want you too. Three upgrade barrels that require a lot of damage to destroy just barrel you over causing you to fail. Zombies have insane hitpoints.

Keep your kids away from this game. There are endless places and notifications to buy worthless items costing $5, $20, $50 a pop. It is possible to play without buying anything but just know youre playing 10x's as hard as everyone else being robbed. Items should be more like 50 cents, not $20. The game is built to be addictive and to rob you blind every chance it gets. You have been warned.

When you reach level 20 you'll have to wait 3 or 4 days to upgrade ONE THING and you'll have about 70 things that you need to upgrade. They ruin this game by forcing you to spend A LOT OF MONEY in order to speed up upgrades or you'll be waiting weeks just to upgrade your things. I'm level 22 and the average wait time for an upgrade now is 6 DAYS!!! And you can only upgrade one thing at a time!!! I have about 70 things, so I would have to wait about 419 days to upgrade everything!

Click bait to the extreme. Very clever ads to hide the boring, stupidly, long base building component. The game is also laggy and takes like 3 minutes to load up on my phone. Really just trash. Might give you fun for ten to fifteen minutes, with the run and gun aspect, but it gets old fast, and the story is also equivalent to a flaming pile of dog Doo.
1 Star for slow upgradation. when I upgrade & wait 4-5 days. and hero upgradation is so hard. materials is in so less quantity. game is fine but once I'm upgrade , & nothing doing from 4-5 days

Don't know why such a game has high ratings. Mechanics is complex and illogical. U don't need to understand and all you have to do is click and pay. Mostly pay to win, but with much "hard work" you can make it somewhere.

If I could give this game 0 stars I would. Toxic players, allowed to terrorize players from another server. No support from the developers or customer service. Multiple complaints sent in and they have been ignored with standard bs responses from support. Money drives this game and if you are a top spender they dont care. This player goes against community standards but they are still allowed to play without consequences. They have made this a miserable gaming experience.

The game is really fun and interesting to play. But like almost always it is not fun anymore if you want to play without spending money. It is just a money machine. I'd pay a fixed amount to buy the game rather than being constantly tempted to spend money. Money for what? To be able to play instead of waiting. I know this way the publisher makes lots of money of course, although I can't imagine they'll build a loyal fanbase over the years because it is not attractive on the long run this way.

The shooter as advertised is actually just a mini game packaged inside a Clash of Clans/Lords Mobile MMO clone. I'd play the game if it's what was actually advertised but I'm definitely not interested in any kind of multiplayer game at all. Uninstalled.

So much in this game.. A Should be like, It must balance Personal Life and Digital Life. So many events create problems in the balance. If you don't play for a few days, it will be demotivated to continue the game. I will sure leave the game by this means.

The "temple run" style gameplay you think you've been promised (and shown in the main page here) is actually available in the first 3-4 days, after that it's nonexistent. It surves just as a mini game in most of the tutorial of the game. The whole app is really a base building, hero upgrading MMO pvp style game that closely resembles State of Survival, and other similar to that... Another false advisement in other words... Edit: The screenshots posted by the devs btw aren't even real gameplay...
I like the combination of action and strategy in this game. Base building and tech research take a little too long, but otherwise, I'm having fun playing.

I dont mind spending some money, but this game is way to expensive. Its like $15 bucks to upgrade 1/8th of a star for a hero, each hero has 6 stars, that aint cheap. Especially with a team of 5 heros. And the game is not polished and very unresponsive to player commands, swipe right to move? Nah, ill stand in the way of the barrels. It has so much potential, it can be fun, but the paywalls and unresponse is frustrating.

i think this is one of the best strategy game, but ive some suggestion for improvement, like allow game to run on landscape mode, enhance the sound quality of guns on fire, tune some environment for more realistic

Game was average. I played to do the movement/running as advertised. I also played for 2 months (daily). But the bad part was being attacked. They hit you but don't wipe out your resources. They take out your troops. Which takes a day to replenish, which makes you wait. Also the first 10-20 days you get great toons, but plateau quickly. So then I just watch pay people hit u. Kinda runs it's course after 30 days. Glad I didn't waste $$.

it is a wonderful game, i played the first stage and got the result well . Initially i play like a kid but after some time i understood I have submitted my age ,then i understood it was not simple ,then i focused more and completed all stages successfully.Thanks , i downloaded the game and had a wonderful time pass game. Thanks to all the team members of the game but one thing it's very heavy to download, almost half Gb otherwise it's quite a wonderful game for kids and adults too.

This game lies. It's not like the ads. They put a 30 second level that looks like the ads, but is cheaply made. The real game is making buildings and gathering resources. If you don't want to build settlements, waiting for timers to count down to gather resources, then don't bother. This game sucks.

This game is designed to get you to pay to play. If you don't pay, you'll spend 100x more time clicking around collecting resources and waiting to play the game than actually playing the game. If you do stick around long enough to make any real progress eventually you will just get non stop attacked by other players who are stronger than you, and lose all the resources you waited so long for. Edit: there's nothing to edit. The developer didn't even read my review.

I think this game is great except for 2 reasons that drive me crazy. 1. - no matter how good you are you need to pay alot to be a top team 2. - worse part of part 1 is I live in Canada and in the US the packs that are $4.99, $10.99 & $19.99 are $6.99, $13.99 & $27.99 in Canada so I have to spend WAY more to get the same items, massive disadvantage based on location, tax situation and Currency.
thanks for making a game that is actually like the ads

This is a good rendition of Game of War and several other games that have copied this format. Unfortunately, the upgrades are so expensive that the majority of players will never experience this game the way it was intended to be played. The first company to successfully mix a strategy that is focused on the middle class players will reign supreme in this genre and be around for a long time. This game is not it. Soon all the mid tier players will get bored of playing Farmville and quit.

False advertisement!!! Battling through zombies with math problems is only part of the game. Initially, that's how they hook you. You build stuff, and battle for upgrades. But you plateau quickly, and either need to wait long periods or pay actual cash to proceed at a reasonable rate.

Season 5 is by far the WORST game design and balance yet. Everything about the way this game is structured is pay to win. Unless you spend thousands of dollars, you will only be run over in combat and game modes. There is ZERO matchmaking to balance power, and in fact it seems the game intentionally feeds the weak players against the people spending so they get easy wins. There are few redeeming qualities to the game, and even the minigames from the ads are rare and short lived events.

starts off as advertised. it quickly begins to throw up road blocks to get you to buy their overpriced resource packs, but once the core game play is done the entire thing morphs into an mmo. was fun for a bit, but they introduced a vs. mechanic that encourages high level players to eradicate newbies once a week unless you paid for their shield packs. fun for a week or two but don't waste any money on this game.

It is fun for a day, after that everything goes too slow and its too overwhelming with new options, which doesn't help your progress but just make you lose time. Even if you have resources you can't expand faster because workers are only bought with money. Uninstalled the game, because I don't see a reason just to open it, start a building upgrade and close, which should be repeated many times before you go further on the map. Overall I wouldn't download the game again.

Unless you're willing to shell out ridiculous amounts of money don't waste your time. It's not the fun puzzley scroller it wants you to think it is. As others say it's a basic base builder with the puzzles tacked on. Also, there's nothing to prevent level 20+s from decimating your level 8 base so be prepared to be constantly on fire. The puzzles are fine (though several require near-perfect timing) but the base part is typical boring drek.

It's fun but predatory. You start with basic units until the game takes away your best unit and puts a 24 hour FOMO system where you have to play to get your unit back. The game offers in game purchases (pay to win) right after 7 minutes of gameplay on a fresh account. Took me 1 hour to build the tavern, which kept me busy playing a bad farm building minigame instead of actually playing the advertised game.

Good game but is very pricey, they get you to buy packs all the time to upgrade and level up and you don't even level up as much unless you keep on buying and spending more, if you choose not to buy packs you can, but you fall far behind everyone else and you can't keep up with anything or anyone and your alliance, also if no one spends as much in your alliance you get very low to little rewards to gain too and get wiped out fast! Keep your money, wish I knew this beforehand, in too deep now...

after playing this game more than 2 months I'm gonna delete my account. this game all about pay to win you can't even get all the heros without purchasing. if you're a free member don't come. i think this game funny but needs to be more balanced.

the fun part is over very quickly, you start with cleaning and expending the base by playing the street shooting things but after that is over the main game focuses on building your stronghold and keeping alience rather then the shooting game which gets boring

The ads and screenshots for this game are VERY misleading. If you thought you'd be playing a lot of scrolling action you are wrong, that is only about 2% of the actual game. Most of your time will be spent building a base and an army to fight other players. Not what I was looking for at all. Lots of sitting around waiting for Energy to replenish or the next Event to start instead of playing an actual game.

So I decided to download this game because I have quite literally seen it everywhere, TikTok,YouTube,insta, EVERYWHERE! And the one major thing they tote about it is that it's just like the ads, the ads aren't fake, this is real game play. WOAH! did you see that. Ugh I grabbed the nerf instead of the buff. Anyway this is not really like the ads, the gameplay is more complex but in a brain dead sort of way where the game tries to be more complex but just hands the stuff to you.

This game lacks any real strategy. You can't control your troops or heroes during attacks since they act automatically. There's no skill involved in troop placement or planning. Researching feels pointless since you don’t see its impact. The whole game is just farming resources and upgrading buildings. It’s more of a waiting simulator than a game, and honestly, it feels more like a chore than fun.

The app itself is fun enough but many descriptions are not clear as far as rules for the events inside the game. The worst however is the customer service. I wrote them several times, once in regards to something I paid for which was incomplete and and couple of times to help them by telling them about a bug and they did not even reply (it has been over a week now and no reply at least). Very poor especially for a game that makes a lot of money from people purchasing items inside the game. Sad!!

The game is great in so many aspects, but the reason for two stars is that it is P2W. You won't think so in the beginning if you play accordingly. I was top of my alliance grinding. Than some random comes along, buys packs and soars passed me in levels/strength. Not to mention their "roulette" game has 8/12 chance to win "Legendary" yet I haven't landed on anything rare. Rigged, pathetic to see how greedy some creator's have got.

I know this is just one big money grab but given all that could you invest just a little in the gameplay? The only thing I can do now at level 23 is click a bunch of buttons, upgrade buildings, and wait. There is no skill remaining, none of the skill based levels left to beat (except for a rare "event" where there is a math based one). Booooooo

Most of the things are very good. It is a very nice game. Some people say that this game is pay to win but in my opinion, if you invest your time, you can upgrade your heroes. But I have a problem and that is nearly all the base's skins are paid and one base skin is there which is only for female players and in my alliance, some male members also like that base skin but are not able to get it. This game needs some more base skin which we can get for free or by an event.

Please read this review before playing this game. Unlike many Freemiums this game has one of the most deceiving and sneaky ways they exploit you for your wallet. This entire game is just an exploitation at every turn from the moment you started the game. I was an idiot thinking it was only at the start, as that's the case for many games in this market. You will not only pay for additional builders, you will need to pay for a 2nd science centre, season passes, and so much more just to catch up.

Unless you want to spend a lot of money don't play. You will just get robbed of resources by higher level players and there is nothing you can do about it. Shielding cost real money. Game is terrible when all you do is repair or wait for the resources to repair only to be attacked again over and over. Uninstalled after 4 days of play and over 100 attacks from people 10+ more powerful then me. Wish I could get a refund for the money I spent in game.

Aside from the pure rage-bait advertisements, the game itself is very limited. It takes a long time to load in. There is no option to switch off the music or sound effects. The game isn't clear about what the objective is before starting a round, and most taps on the screen don't even register.

It was great until the events started picking up. The app keeps shutting down and kicking me offline, and since this is a time based game, these glitches will cost you opportunities and resources that you have to spend even more time to get back. It's fun, but it's frustrating. Oh, and support is almost non-existent. If you write them about a problem it'll take DAYS to get a response and the response is pretty much, "we're sorry to hear that" then nothing is done.

I was really having fun at first so I spent a bunch of money in the first few days because I thought the game would be about teamwork. instead the server was Ruined by a bunch of people that wanted to make everyone's life hell in the game. so I assumed you could just pack up your purchases and not interact by going to a new server. no, you loose EVERYTHING you spent your money on and if the people that want to be mean have more money, good luck ever playing the game.

Literally cannot play this game as I encountered a bug that it turns out multiple people have had for months and devs even noted but haven't fixed. When I download the game and hit play I am taken to a screen whose only button is "sign in" where I can either log in with google or log in via email. Mid game. When I do play the content I care about, its either locked behind MORE base building, timegated, or level gated. Got bored in less than 5 days

The game is fun. There are no ads, which is great but you end up paying for it. Around Level 60 you begin to see this game for what it really is. "Last War: Survival" is a game that wants your money or your time to progress. Unfortunately, the ability to watch ads is not available so progress slows way down.

Pay to Play! Hours to build! If you are not paying to play - don't bother. Little things! Stamina to attack- Stamina for Radar Tasks = non left for anything else! Alliance Teleports great ya- if you can actually use it to port anywhere in your "zone" - In alot of games like this KOA for example- when I port my troops come with me. Nope not here! This gun shooting part of this game becomes <1% of the gameplay. Eventually it becomes a pay to win war game where you are in alliances and forced to invest money to build up a base and fighting squad. If you choose to continue, know that eventually devs will do something to screw you over.

the game is super fun and super addictive. but it is PAY to win. someone who chooses not to spend money will have a hard time being a force in the game. that's a problem. certain things just shouldn't be obtained through your wallet but based on your activity. I give this game 2 stars because: 1) very misleading advertising; 2) extremely pay to win; 3) despite the above - the game is well made, complex and engaging for the most part 4) they know exactly what and how to sell to make you spend a LOT of money If you dont like heavy pay to win games - better not start playing this one. Being free to pay or light payer puts you in a huge disadvantage in this game. Ill give the devs that - they made a really nice game, but not worth the money needed
